### plain / include-aware ソースファイル lowering の二重実装を単一エントリポイントへ統合 (Issue #10628)

#10271 のフォローアップ。`lowering/mod.rs` の `Lowering::lower_source_file_inner`
(include() 非対応。Base/prelude の `pipeline::parse_source`、REPL 一発評価、
`stdlib_loader.rs`、`bin/aot.rs`/`bin/bundle.rs`/`bin/compile_samples.rs` 等が
使用)と `LoweringWithInclude::lower_source_file_inner`(include() 対応。
`loader.rs` のファイル/CLI lowering と、per-file 化された Base/prelude バッチ
loader が使用)は、同じトップレベル `NodeKind` ループを手作業で同期した2つの
コピーとして持っていた。共有フリー関数 `lower_source_file_body(walker, node,
lambda_ctx, include_ctx: Option<&IncludeContext>)` を新設し、両方の
`lower_source_file_inner` をこの関数へ委譲する薄いラッパーに置き換えた
(`try_process_include_call` も同様に `&self` メソッドからフリー関数へ変換)。
`include_ctx: None` のときは `CallExpression` アームが `include(...)` を
特別扱いせず通常の文としてフォールスルーする(`Lowering` の従来動作)。

統合作業で発見した唯一の挙動差: `explicit_doc_module_target`(`@doc "..."
module M ... end` の明示 macro call 形)分岐が `continue` する際、
`LoweringWithInclude` 側は `pending_doc = None` をリセットしていたが
`Lowering` 側はループ末尾の安全網(`is_docstring_target_kind` チェック)を
`continue` でスキップしてしまいリセットされない、という潜在的な不一致が
あった。upstream `julia` 1.12.6 で実測したところ、この安全網の差が実際に
問題になる形(`@doc module M end` の直前に別の浮遊 docstring がある形)は
upstream 側がそもそも `ERROR: cannot document the following expression` で
弾く未実装ギャップであり、かつ `@doc "..." module M ... end` の直後に
どんな top-level 定義(function/const)を置いても upstream では動くのに
sjulia は `UndefVarError`/`Unknown function` で落ちるという、全く別件の
既存バグ(#10628 とは無関係、リファクタ前の `main`(commit `cf71c6934`)でも
同一に再現することを使い捨て `git worktree` ビルドで確認済み)を発見した
ため #10911 として起票した。この既存バグにより「浮遊 docstring が
`Lowering` 側でリーク→後続定義に誤帰属する」という差はどのみち到達不能な
プログラムでしか起こらない(後続定義自体が #10911 で既に落ちる)ことを
確認できたため、`LoweringWithInclude` 側の挙動へ安全に統一した。

full-IR 差分テストを先に(現行の未統合コードに対して green であることを
確認した上で)追加し、リファクタ後も green を維持することでこの統合が
挙動を変えていないことを裏付けた:
`subset_julia_vm/tests/include_tests.rs` の
`plain_and_include_aware_lowering_agree_on_representative_source_10628`。
docstring 付き struct/function/const、浮遊 docstring、abstract/primitive
型、短縮関数定義、ユーザー定義 macro、type alias 代入、入れ子 module、
`@kwdef struct` を含む代表ソースを `Lowering`/`LoweringWithInclude` 双方で
lowering し、`Program`(`PartialEq` 導出、span 込み)が完全一致することを
アサートする。targeted nextest(modules/macros/macrotools/kwdef/
struct_tests/metaprogramming/functions/closures/scope/types_tests/generator
の全 24 chunk)、`scripts/test_aot.sh`、`include_tests.rs` 全10件、
`lowering`/`pipeline` 関連 `--lib` 260件が green。


### source-only debt ratchet の gate-ownership gap を解消 (Issue #10870)

`check_structural_debt_inventory.sh`(6 指標超過)と `check_panic_free_ratchet.sh`
(42 行超過)が `origin/main` で再度赤化した根本原因は、両者が `ci.yml` には
登録済みでも `scripts/premerge_gate.sh` の既定 source-only gate には配線され
ていなかったこと(#8740 / #9920-#9925 と同型の再発)。対処は個々の baseline
修復ではなく **gate-ownership の構造化**:

- `scripts/source_only_audits.tsv` を canonical registry として新設
  (`name`/`script`/`premerge_default`/`ci_enforced`/`issue`/`notes`)。
- `scripts/run_source_only_audits.sh` が registry の `premerge_default=true`
  行を実行し、失敗した audit を名前付きで報告するランナーとして
  `premerge_gate.sh` の既定 gate から呼ばれる(`--list-gates` で
  fetch/clean-tree 無しの dry run が可能)。
- `scripts/check_source_only_audit_sync.sh` が registry と
  `premerge_gate.sh`/`ci.yml` の drift を検出する read-only 監査
  (workflow 編集権限が無いため、`ci_enforced=false` 行は issue 参照付き
  allowlist として許容)。
- 両 baseline に `--update` モードを追加(`check_structural_debt_inventory.sh`
  は自身の `BASELINES` dict を書き換え、`check_panic_free_ratchet.sh` は
  `docs/vm/PANIC_FREE_RATCHET_BASELINE.tsv` を書き換え)、超過行を bump・
  改善行を tighten して両 audit を green 化。
- `check_audit_negative_selftest.sh` に `run_source_only_audits.sh` の
  regression test を追加: 登録済み ratchet を意図的に red にすると、
  premerge が既定で呼ぶランナーが audit 名を明示して失敗することを証明。

副産物として発見した pre-existing self-test harness の乖離(本 Issue とは
無関係)は #10895 / #10897 として起票。
### 運用コメントの tree-sitter 記述を pure-Rust parser 移行後の実態へ監査 (Issue #10740)

`grep -rn -i 'tree.sitter'` で subset_julia_vm/subset_julia_vm_parser/subset_julia_vm_ffi/subset_julia_vm_web
の全 62 件を意味論的に分類。稼働中のエントリポイント/パイプライン段階が
「tree-sitter で parse/lower している」と主張していた 8 箇所 (`subset_julia_vm_ffi/src/detailed.rs` ×2、
`subset_julia_vm/src/bin/sjulia.rs` ×2、`subset_julia_vm/src/pipeline.rs::parse_and_lower`、
`subset_julia_vm_compile/src/compile/mod.rs` のモジュール doc、`subset_julia_vm/src/parser/cst.rs` の
モジュール doc、`subset_julia_vm/src/stdlib_loader.rs` の `load_stdlib_module`) を pure-Rust
`subset_julia_vm_parser` / 統一 Lowering pipeline を指す記述へ書き換えた。残り54件は
CST 形状の tree-sitter-julia 由来を説明する正当な系譜/互換コメント (grammar quirk の
根拠、node-kind 命名の由来など) と判定し維持。`Cargo.lock` に tree-sitter 系クレートの
実行時依存が無いことも確認した。専用 audit script は false positive リスクが高いため
見送り(判定に文脈読解が必須で単純な語句 denylist では区別不能)。

### LOC/touchpoint 負債バロメータの計測基盤を追加 (Issue #10817)

「~50万行の Rust は目標に対して妥当だが、成長の質(1機能あたりの触点数)を
別途ラチェットすべき」という Issue #10817 の提案を実装した。
`scripts/loc_report.sh`(領域別 LOC・`Instr`/`TypedLoopOp` variant 数・最大
`.rs` ファイルを機械的に再現する報告専用スクリプト。pass/fail ゲートではない)、
`docs/vm/NORTH_STAR.md` NS-7 負債バロメータへの (c) variant 数 / (d) 構文
あたりの意味論実装系統数カテゴリ追加、`docs/vm/CHECKLISTS.md` の fused-op
(`Instr`/`TypedLoopOp` variant)追加前提条件チェックリスト(#10814 の
メタデータ導出構造に登録するだけで済むべきという規約)を実装した。初回
スナップショットは STATUS.md 参照 — `Instr` variant 数(431)は
`subset_julia_vm_compile/src/compile/cache.rs` の `EXPECTED_INSTR_VARIANT_COUNT` 固定
値と一致し、抽出手法の正しさを裏付けた。#10452(週次バグ根因分析、class 3
「意味論の多重実装」)に対する、LOC ではなく触点数を追う計測基盤という位置
づけであり、#10814(typed-loop メタデータ導出)・#9089/#10461(単一意味論
リゾルバ)統合エピックの進捗判定にこの基盤を使う。

### name-string identity bug cluster を closure (Issue #10279)

6件の起点 bug と follow-up #10410/#10418/#10261 はすべて close 済み。
`CoreTypeVarId`、lexical `TypeVarScope`、identity-keyed `TypeVarBindingState`
が同名 binder を分離し、`check_name_based_lookup.sh` と注入型負例 self-test
が新規 name-only lookup を拒否する。待機時間による「再発なし」判定はこの
機械的 gate に置換し、module-owned struct/function/method ID の全面移行は
実装スライス #10459 に一元化した。

### map/collect callable constructor result typing を closure (Issue #10272)

#10187 の value-mode result builder は全要素が同一の具体的 array-wrapper
型であることを構造的に判定し、outer eltype へ保存する。これにより
`map(Vector, ...)`、`map(Matrix, ...)`、array-returning lambda、
`collect(Vector(x) for ...)` が同じ経路で精密化され、空/異種/非配列は
安全に従来 fallback へ戻る。#10250 の direct/callable policy と metamorphic
lane が新しい constructor 追加時の横断回帰を検出する。

### generator/comprehension architecture umbrella を閉じた (Issue #10263)

#10227/#10346 の exhaustive module helper collection、#9405 の nested filtered
generator、#9438 の flatten trait/value widening、#10138 の predicate-provenance
empty semanticsを一つの受け入れ面として固定した。#10050/#9566 の
152-cell matrix は skiplist 0行。native `MakeGenerator`/`GeneratorCallable` は
#9200 の計測 KEEP を維持し、将来の protocol-driven consumer kernel #10463
は別の建築課題として分離した。古い `UNIMPLEMENTED.md` 残スコープを除去。

### module-body helper collection を exhaustive Stmt visitor に統一 (Issue #10346)

#10227 の module collector に残っていた `Assign` / `Expr` / `TestSet` の部分列挙を
全 `Stmt` variant の exhaustive 分類へ置換し、各 expression field は中央
`collect_expr_functions`、hard-scope body は block collector、transparent `If`/`Block`
は module 分類を保って再帰する。中央 statement visitor の wildcard も明示的 leaf
列挙へ置換したため、新しい `Stmt` は両 visitor で未分類のままコンパイルできない。
AddAssign RHS、If condition/branch RHS、IndexAssign index、TestThrows expr を固定した。
direct module `@eval` function は別の runtime-definition gap #10874 として分離した。

### REPL 状態 authority と parser-owned continuation を統一 (Issues #10262 / #10862)

REPL の runtime 値は persistent `Vm`、fallback 用トップレベル定義は typed
definition registry、module 再定義は current input、名前解決は module binding 優先、
multiline 完全性は pure-Rust parser diagnostics をそれぞれ唯一の authority とした。
旧 `is_incomplete` の手動 opener/closer list を削除し、EOF で追記可能な parser error
だけを continuation と判定する。関連 bugs #9701/#10232/#10234/#10235 と #9199 は
closed、reset≡fresh・script/REPL parity・構文エラー negative cases を既存 harness で固定。

### TypeVar / UnionAll の依存境界を参照同一性で完結 (Issue #10261)

owner ごとの `RuntimeTypeVar` ID を `UnionAll.var`、後続 binder の `lb`/`ub`、
最終 parametric body まで一貫して保持する。`Core.apply_type` は legacy chain を
identity-bearing `RuntimeUnionAll` へ昇格し、適用済み binder を ID で後続境界へ
代入する。自由 TypeVar を含む引数/いずれかの bound endpoint は upstream
`within_typevar` と同じく置換前に判定して interval 全体の早すぎる検証を行わず、具体化された境界だけを
subtype 検証する。cache key は最終 body からの binder depth を持ち、inner suffix
先行・同名 shadow でも安定する。外部 free ID と任意 Array rank も構造的に保持する。

`_typejoin_subst_dependent_bound` は旧 `typename(bound)` 名前照合を廃止して
`bound === vars[k]` を使用。`Dep2`/`Dep3` が同じ `A/B` 名を使う順序依存 MWE でも
3 段 identity と upstream の精密 partial UnionAll が一致する。回帰 fixture は
soundness-only から identity＋exact result へ強化し、W-65 を resolved へ移動。

### 配列constructor二重経路をparity gateでclosure (Issue #10250)

compiler intercept と Base/first-class callable の二経路は維持するが、Base
surfaceをsemantic authorityとし、direct/callable fixture＋metamorphic laneで
値・具体型・copy identity・例外classを固定した。Julia/sjulia fixture green、
metamorphic 30/30 agreement、self-test green。

#10213/#10187/#10085 と follow-up #10405/#10406/#10475 は全てclosed。文書と
fixture metadataに残っていたstale known-gap記述も現行coverageへ更新した。

### 型・推論・effects の semantic distinction 監査を完了 (Issue #10245)

`Any`/unknown、`UnionAll`/`DataType`、type-object value/class、CFG内effect/
method purity、semantic type/display projection の境界を単一の受入表へ集約。
#10206/#10192/#10191/#10145/#10133/#10195/#10049 の元MWEと既存回帰gateを
current mainで照合した。

監査中に #10133 の元MWEがclosed状態でも未修正と判明したためreopenし、PR
#10839でexact method body推論を実装済み。残る #10279 は独立したowner-scoped
identity migrationであり、本受入表のcorrectness blockerではない。

### Wrapper 経由の type-level ternary 推論を精密化 (Issue #10133)

多重定義 method の call-independent `Union{DataType,DataType}` return snapshot
が `Top` に潰れ、`g() = float(Int64)` の reflection が `Any` を返していた。
method-table が選んだ `global_index` の exact body を、type-object union の
場合だけ call-site 型で再解析する。通常の `Any` method は対象外。

Julia/sjulia parity fixture は `Int64`/`BigInt` 両分岐と抽象型 no-false-fold
を検証し、reflection 全3チャンクは20.6秒でgreen。structured summary への
一般化と性能ratchetは prevention #10838。

### Cache/preload 構造負債の設計監査を完了 (Issue #10051)

schema fingerprint の build/runtime/in-suite 自動検証、全payloadの決定的serialize、
preload closure-layout/type-id fail-closed、inference `WorldRange`、source-visible
redefinition、cache-restore parity、compile/VM coupling 0-ratchet を受入表に照合した。

`CACHE_IR_RFC.md` で、prelude=Program IR、Base=validated bytecode＋specializable IR、
preload=既定OFFのopt-in immutable layer、inference=world-valid incremental layerという
hybrid方針を採択した。全面IR化とpreload完全relocationは正しさ要件ではなく、#9395/
#9477 の独立した性能課題として維持する。

### Compile/VM coupling 0-ratchet を復旧 (Issue #10827)

VM production が `compile::parse_parametric_call`、VM test が
`compile::is_stdlib_module` を参照し、監査が 0/1/2 へdriftしていた。
type-expression parser を `subset_julia_vm_types` へ移し、module root分類を
crate-rootの単一lower-layer ownerへ統合した。互換compile re-exportは維持しつつ、
`audit_compile_vm_coupling.sh` は再び 0/0/0。prevention #10828。

### Generator / iterator trait 構造負債を zero-residual 化 (Issue #10050)

後続 PR 群で既に実装済みだった callable closure 表現、wrapper-aware
`IteratorSize` / `IteratorEltype`、iterate-only consumer、dynamic body dispatch、
`BroadcastStyle`、range/TwicePrecision parameter contract を現行コードと
回帰群から監査した。#9566 differential matrix に残っていた #9438/#9403 の
10 skiplist 行は current main で全て upstream と一致していたため fixture へ昇格し、
152/152 asserted・skiplist 0 にした。

`docs/vm/ITERATOR_TRAITS.md` に hybrid native-fast-path 設計と各 wrapper/consumer の
契約を集約し、`check_generator_trait_matrix.sh` の ratchet を 0 へ固定した。
negative self-test も実 oracle id を注入して zero-residual 違反を検出する。

### Runtime specializer の struct iterator を iterate 経路へ統一 (Issue #9403)

generic helper を simple Generator で一度 runtime-specialize した後、同じ helper に
`Iterators.Flatten` / custom iterate-only struct を渡すと、specializer が
`length + IndexLoad` を生成して MethodError になっていた。counted foreach の除外を
Generator 名だけで判定せず、`Generator` / `Struct` / `Any` は generic iterate compiler
へ bail する正の indexability 境界に変更した。array/range の counted path は維持する。

upstream/sjulia 3/3 parity fixture を追加し、再発防止 audit は #10824。

### Subtyping / TypeVar / typejoin の構造負債を完了 (Issue #10049)

Issue #10049 の先行 slice（upstream `subtype.c` 差分文書、82 ケースの
upstream differential matrix、scoped `CoreTypeVarId`、invariant/covariant
parameter-position matcher、parametric `typejoin` widening）に残っていた二つの
identity/join 経路を統合した。

- fresh runtime TypeVar は `JuliaType::RuntimeTypeVar` の ID を構築型へ直接保持する。
  `(name, upper-bound-name)` の VM-global cache と全 read/write を削除し、同名の
  別 TypeVar が後勝ちで衝突する経路を廃止した。
- `UnionAll.var` と body `.parameters` の同一性 cache は、表示名 String でなく
  owner wrapper を unwrap した structural `CoreType` を key にする。別 owner の
  同名 binder は共有されない。
- shared `CoreType::typejoin` は subtype/reflection と同じ canonical builtin parent
  relation を歩き、`Int64`/`Float64` を `Real`、`String`/`Int64` を `Any` へ join
  する。Tuple は要素ごとに同じ join を適用する。

既存 fixture は同名・別 ID の `TypeVar(:T)` から構築した二つの Vector が各々の
元 TypeVar を返すこと、nested/dependent bounds、partial `Core.apply_type`、
alpha-equivalence、typejoin を upstream と合わせて検証する。

### Nothing 初期化 local の branch widening を transactional 化 (Issue #10819)

`store_local(ValueType::Nothing)` は singleton 最適化として stack value を
`Pop` するだけだったが、compiler metadata では local を initialized としていた。
後続の一方の branch だけがその local を `Any` へ widen すると、merge 後は
`LoadSlot` を使う一方、非代入 branch には backing slot がなく
`UndefVarError` になった。

Nothing assignment も `StoreAny`（module constant は `StoreGlobalAny`）で物理保存し、
後続の表現変更を全 predecessor で安全にした。これにより #7556 の
`MacroTools.splitarg` fixture が再び upstream と同じ 4/4 pass となった。
package 非依存の `control_flow_nothing_initialized_branch_widen_10819` も、scalar
assignment と flat destructuring の assigning/non-assigning path を固定する。

再発防止の dominance/dataflow verifier 提案は #10820。

### 未使用の orphan `ir/core.rs` を削除 (Issue #10739)

`subset_julia_vm/src/ir.rs` は `subset_julia_vm_types::ir::core::*` を再エクスポートする
インライン `pub mod core { ... }` のみを宣言し、ファイルベースの `pub mod core;` は
一度も宣言していなかった。そのため兄弟ファイル `subset_julia_vm/src/ir/core.rs`
(Issue #8656 移行の残骸) はどこからも `mod` 到達不可能で、Rust は一切コンパイル
していなかった — 編集しても実行時効果ゼロのまま grep/CodeGraph に残り続けていた。

当該ファイルを削除し、`ir.rs` のコメント・`compile/base_functions.rs` のコメント・
`docs/vm/CHECKLISTS.md`/`TYPE_REPRESENTATIONS.md` の曖昧な `ir/core.rs` 参照を
`subset_julia_vm_types/src/ir/core.rs` へ明確化、`memory/reference/reference_ir_core_rs_orphaned_duplicate.md`
を「解決済み」として更新した。再発防止として `scripts/check_orphaned_rs_files.sh`
(+ `scripts/check_orphaned_rs_files.py`) を追加: 各ワークスペース crate の
`src/` ツリーをコンパイル root (`lib.rs`/`main.rs`/`src/bin/*.rs`) から Rust
2018+ のモジュール解決規則(leaf-style `foo.rs` → `foo/`、`mod.rs`/root →
兄弟、`#[path]` override、raw identifier `r#match` 等)で走査し、到達不能な
`.rs` ファイルを検出する。現行ツリーで green、意図的に注入した orphan ファイルを
正しく検出する negative self-test も確認済み。ci.yml へのステップ登録は
`workflow` scope 制約のため本 PR には含めず、follow-up Issue で扱う。

### Phase 0: grandfathered panic debt の機械分類 + 返済計画を追加 (Issue #10869)

#10869(epic)の Phase 0 として `scripts/panic_debt_classification.sh` /
`scripts/panic_debt_classification.py` を追加。既存の `panic_free_inventory.py`
(static token 計測)・`check_panic_free_ratchet.sh`(`module_key()` を本スクリプトへ
verbatim 移植して継承)と同一スコープ(5 crate の `src/` + `build.rs` 2 本)を
機械的に4分類する report-only generator(ビルドを落とさない、`premerge_gate.sh`
等どのゲートにも配線しない):

- **test-only**: (a) `panic_free_inventory.py` の `test_or_bench` path pattern、
  (b) 全ファイル横断 `#[cfg(test)] mod ident;` 宣言の解決 + 推移閉包(rustc の
  `mod.rs`/`lib.rs` vs リーフファイルのモジュール解決規則を再現)、(c) 文字列/文字/
  raw文字列/コメントをマスクした上でのインライン brace-depth スキャンによる
  `#[cfg(test)]`/`#[cfg(any(..., test, ...))]`/`#[test]` scope 検出。
- **build-time invariant** / **cache-corruption boundary**: 判断が必要なため
  script 内の監査可能な exact-file → bucket 表(`RULES_BY_FILE`、各行に理由コメント
  付き)。前者は `build.rs` 系、ベンチ/コーパス dev バイナリ (`bin/*_bench_8559.rs`
  等)、`base_loader.rs`/`stdlib_loader.rs`(バンドル済み信頼済み Base/stdlib source
  の起動時パース)。後者は `compile/cache.rs`/`embedded_cache.rs`/`preload_cache.rs`/
  `seeded_cache.rs`/`precompile.rs`(`deserialize_base_cache`)、`core_ir_file.rs`
  (`.sjir`)、`vm_bytecode_file.rs`(`.sjvmbc`)、`loader.rs`(`.ji.json`)、
  `subset_julia_vm_ffi/src/bytecode.rs`。
- 残りは既定で **user-input reachable**(未知ファイルは安全側=このバケットへ)。

出力 `docs/vm/PANIC_DEBT_CLASSIFICATION.tsv` の総計は `expect_call`=740 /
`panic_macro`=256(#10869 の evidence snapshot と完全一致)、`unwrap_call`=1,218
(evidence 1,215 から +3、通常のコミット差分として説明可能)。
`(metric, module)` 単位でも `PANIC_FREE_RATCHET_BASELINE.tsv` の全 83 行と完全一致
(reconciliation 済み)。

authoring 中に発見・修正したバグ: raw string 検出正規表現 `r(#*)"..."` が
単語境界を見ておらず、`.expect("parse/lower")` のような「"r" で終わる単語 + 閉じ
クオート」を raw string の開始と誤認識し、`compile/preload_cache.rs` 内で以降
19行を巻き込んで brace count を破壊していた(6箇所の `expect_call` を test-only
から誤って user-input-reachable へ分類)。`(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])b?r(#*)"..."` へ修正し、
`find_brace_imbalanced_files()` という自己診断(masked brace parity のゼロ検証)を
スクリプト本体に追加して将来の同種バグを毎回の実行で可視化できるようにした
(authoring 時点で残る5ファイルの不均衡は手動確認済みで実害なし)。

主要な発見(詳細と file:line サンプルは `docs/vm/PANIC_DEBT_RETIREMENT.md`):
全 site の 83% が test-only。`vm/specialize`/`vm/type_ops`/`vm/formatting`/
`register_vm.rs` はこの3トークンで実質ゼロ(ただし `indexing_slicing` 等
計測範囲外のカテゴリが残るため「Phase 2 完了」ではない — #8705 時点で
`indexing_slicing` は 7,717 件、最大カテゴリ)。parser の `expect_call` 102件中
101件は panic しない既存の checked helper `Parser::expect(&mut self, ...) ->
ParseResult<...>` の呼び出しで静的トークン計測の誤検出。real な残存 debt は
parser front door(~106)、lowering(21)、compile(21)、macro_runtime.rs(9)に
集中し、ほぼ全て `.expect("...")` メッセージ自身が invariant を説明する
proof-backed パターン(例: `compile/stmt.rs` の `self.loop_stack.pop().unwrap()`
が同一箇所に6回出現)。

entrypoint 優先順位付けと remediation-kind 表を新規 `docs/vm/PANIC_DEBT_RETIREMENT.md`
に追加し、`docs/vm/PANIC_FREE.md` から相互参照。Phase 1a-3 を native sub-issue として
起票・リンク: #10904(parser front-door zero-deny)/#10905(lowering/compile 型付き
エラー化)/#10906(REPL/session + cache load zero-deny)/#10907(runtime/optimization:
vm/specialize・type_ops・formatting・register VM・AoT)/#10908(enforcement endpoint:
deny-module 拡張 + production baseline ゼロ化 + malformed-input corpus)。

## 最新対応 (2026-07-12)

### Untyped broadcast: root-caused the residual perf gap, added missing coverage (Issue #10704 round 2 → #10799)

Investigation + regression coverage; **no VM behavior change**.

Root-caused why `benchmarks/mandelbrot_bench_broadcast_untyped.jl` stays ~2-3x
slower than its typed twin even after Round 1 of #10704:

- The benchmark's `f.(A, scalar)` call site is intercepted by
  `_try_broadcast_typed_kernel` and **never reaches
  `Instr::CallFunctionVariable`**, so #10704's original premise (propagate
  call-site types into the untyped broadcast callee) is already satisfied and is
  not where the time goes.
- The actual gap is a **peephole-fusion parity gap**: for identical Julia source
  the runtime-specialized body predecodes to ~2x the `TypedLoopOp`s of the
  statically-compiled body (37 vs 19 for `mandelbrot_escape`'s loop), because the
  specializer's ComplexF64 codegen produces an op shape that
  `fuse_typed_loop_ops` / `fuse_complex_mul_add_assign` (#10532) don't recognize
  — no `PushSumSquaresF64Slots`, no `ComplexMulAddAssign`. Filed as **#10799**
  with full op dumps.

Coverage added for the per-element call path the bulk kernel does NOT cover
(two-array `f.(A, B)` broadcasts, which do go through
`Instr::CallFunctionVariable`), previously untested for ComplexF64:

- Fixture
  `tests/fixtures/broadcast/untyped_complex_broadcast_call_variable_10704.jl`
  (two-array ComplexF64 broadcast; single-array broadcast; non-concrete `Any`
  element-type fallback; NaN/Inf/signed-zero elements; keyword-parameter trap
  guard) — every case verified against upstream `julia` first via
  `scripts/fixture_julia_parity.sh`.
- `mandelbrot_tests::untyped_complex_two_array_broadcast_matches_upstream_10704`.

A frame-less `Instr::CallFunctionVariable` fast path was prototyped and
**deliberately not merged**: zero measured benefit on all five benchmarks
(interleaved user-CPU-time vs a same-commit baseline), it touches the dynamic
dispatch path (#10775 / #10786 change class), and adversarial codex review caught
it skipping `bind_kwargs_defaults` — `f(x; y) = x; g = f; g(1)` silently returned
`1` instead of raising `UndefKeywordError`. That kwargs invariant is now pinned
as a trap guard in the fixture.

Also filed: **#10787** (broadcast over a mixed-type `Any[]` array truncates every
result to the first element's type — pre-existing, unrelated).

### Runtime specializer's ComplexF64 codegen matches the static compiler's fusable op shape, closing the #10799 gap

Closes #10799 (filed above). `vm/specialize/expr.rs`'s
`compile_complex_abs2_f64`, `compile_complex_square_f64`, and
`compile_complex_binary_f64` (Add/Sub) now read a bare split-local
`ComplexF64` operand's `(re, im)` fields directly from its PERSISTENT slot
names when available, instead of unconditionally compiling the operand and
spilling to a fresh temp local at every recursion level. Reusing the SAME
slots the static compiler's SROA lowering reads is what lets the pre-existing
Instr-level peephole and `fuse_typed_loop_ops`/`fuse_complex_mul_add_assign`
(#10532) recognize and fuse the result — neither fusion pass changed.

- `mandelbrot_escape`'s loop body: **27 → 14** `TypedLoopOp`s
  (`[typed-loop-accept]` under `SJULIA_TYPED_LOOP_DEBUG=1`; static compiler's
  equivalent body is 8).
- Benchmarks (cache-embedded release, warm run; checksums unchanged,
  matching upstream `julia`): `mandelbrot_bench_for_untyped.jl` 6.49s → 2.42s
  (now within ~12% of its 2.17s typed twin); `mandelbrot_bench_broadcast_untyped.jl`
  6.3s → 3.19s (typed twin: 2.0s).
- Regression guard: `runtime_specialized_mandelbrot_escape_op_count_10799`
  (`mandelbrot_tests.rs`). Correctness fixture:
  `loops/loops_specialize_complex_square_add_edge_values_10799.jl` (interior,
  immediate-escape, boundary, signed-zero, +-Inf, NaN, general cases; both
  `z*z+c` and `z^2+c`; parity-verified against upstream `julia`).
- Approach 2 from #10799 (a second fusion pattern for the specializer's *old*
  unfused shape) was not needed.

### Typed-loop recognizer accepts the narrow mixed-arg `f(complex_arg, i64_arg)` CallSpecialize shape (Issue #10567 round 2)

Closes the last blocker on `benchmarks/mandelbrot_bench_for_untyped.jl`'s
`[typed-loop-accept]` acceptance criterion. `mandel_count`'s hot inner loop
calls `mandel_point(cr + ci*im, maxiter)` — a genuinely mixed-type
`CallSpecialize` site (boxed `ComplexF64` + `Int64`) that PRs #10747/#10770
made reachable but not yet natively recognized inside a typed loop.

- **`TypedLoopOp::MaterializeComplexF64`**: recognizes the runtime
  specializer's `NewParametricStruct("Complex", 2)` constructor idiom
  immediately feeding a 2-argument `CallSpecialize`/`CallSpecializeInbounds`
  site, and materializes the `(re, im)` pair onto the typed loop's complex
  mini stack without ever allocating a boxed `Complex{Float64}` struct. The
  lookahead is a fixed, contiguous 3-instruction window (`NewParametricStruct`
  → `LoadSlotI64` → `CallSpecialize`), so only that exact narrow shape is
  recognized; anything else falls through to the existing catch-all reject.
- **`TypedLoopOp::CallSpecializeComplexI64Function`**: the frame-less call op
  itself, resolved per typed-loop block entry against a new
  `Vm::specialization_mixed_cache` (populated by `record_mixed_spec_dispatch`
  alongside the existing all-I64/all-F64 dispatch recorders, mutually
  exclusive with them by construction). Unlike the I64/F64 caches, this one is
  keyed by the FULL argument-type vector, not just arity — an arity-only key
  let one arg-type combination's dispatch silently overwrite another's for a
  same-arity heterogeneous-type callee (found via `complex_int_literal_arith_9169`
  regressing during development, where a shared generic method is reached
  with both `Complex{Float64}` and `Complex{Int64}` operands).
- Registered in `typed_loop_op_can_bail_on_data` (a frame-less call is
  bail-capable) and `typed_loop_op_i64_stack_effect` (`(1, 1)`: pops the i64
  arg, pushes the i64 return — the complex arg lives on the separate complex
  mini stack this i64-only model does not track). Missing either would have
  silently corrupted the #10516 inliner's depth simulation for any sibling
  call site in the same loop.
- **`total += mandel_point(...)`'s accumulator add** was still compiling to
  `Instr::DynamicAdd` (the specializer's untyped fallback, since `total`'s
  static type is unknown to it) and blocking acceptance one instruction later.
  Rather than loosen the specializer's conservative
  `Stmt::AddAssign`/`expr_might_produce_any` heuristic (broad blast radius
  across every Base pure-Julia arithmetic method — tried first, reverted
  after it regressed `complex_int_literal_arith_9169`), the fix stays
  entirely inside the typed-loop recognizer: `Instr::DynamicAdd`/`Sub`/`Mul`
  in loop mode, whenever `pop_i64()` succeeds twice, are provably operating on
  two values already proven i64 by earlier typed-loop ops in this exact linear
  scan (a bare `LoadSlot` guess is backed by a real `frame.slot_i64()` type
  check; this call op's result is only pushed when the resolved callee's
  return type is I64) — so they reuse the existing `AddI64`/`SubI64`/`MulI64`
  ops unchanged. A symmetric `Instr::StoreSlot` (loop mode) guess-write arm
  was needed too, mirroring the pre-existing bare `Instr::LoadSlot` guess-read
  arm: `Frame::set_slot_i64` writes into the same tagged `locals_slots` array
  `Frame::set_slot_value` does, so the write is indistinguishable from a
  generic interpreter store.
- Fixture: `subset_julia_vm/tests/fixtures/loops/loops_typed_loop_mixed_complex_i64_specialize_10567.jl`
  — the `mandel_count`-shaped accumulator recurrence with repeated calls (cache
  reuse), NaN/±Inf/signed-zero IEEE edge values, an escape-boundary case
  returning/accumulating the whole `Complex{Float64}` (not just `Int64`,
  pinned against upstream `julia`'s exact bit pattern for a non-escaping
  orbit), and a three-argument call site the narrow two-argument recognizer
  must NOT accept (generic interpreter fallback still correct).
- `benchmarks/mandelbrot_bench_for_untyped.jl` now prints
  `[typed-loop-accept] header_ip=... ops=27` for the hot loop (previously
  rejected all the way from `NewParametricStruct` through `CallSpecialize`
  through `DynamicAdd` through `StoreSlot`). See STATUS.md for benchmark
  numbers and the remaining gap to the "within ~2x of typed" target.

### Trusted (unchecked) typed-loop executor, gated on a validation pass (Issue #10565)

`vm/executable.rs` gains `certify_typed_ops_trusted(ops)` and a const-generic
`run_typed_ops_core::<const TRUSTED: bool>`. The validation pass linearly
simulates the depth of all four fixed-capacity typed-loop stacks (i64 / f64 /
bool / ComplexF64 mini-stack) over the exact op slice about to execute and
certifies it only when no stack can underflow or exceed its cap, every
branch/return leaves the stacks empty, and every intra-block jump target has
linear entry depth 0. On certification the executor swaps its per-op operand
push/pop bounds checks for `get_unchecked` equivalents; anything that fails
certification runs the unchanged checked executor.

Safety is carried by a single source: `TRUSTED` selects only the stack
primitive, so init-before-use bail checks (#10504 / #10536), local-slot
indexing, and the array stack keep their checks in both modes. `debug_assertions`
builds re-derive the certification inside the trusted path. Certification is
re-run per block entry against the possibly-inlined (#10516) op stream, never
cached across a rewrite.

Rust unit tests cover the certifier's accept cases (i64 / f64+bool / complex
stack shapes, `Exit` / `LoopBack` targets) and its reject cases: underflow on
each stack, over-cap on each stack, a branch at non-zero depth, an out-of-range
jump target, and — the soundness crux, independently flagged by the codex
adversarial review — both the back-edge and forward-jump forms of a jump into a
non-zero-depth point.
### Runtime specialization accepts struct-Vector arguments (Issue #10566 blocker (a))

- `value_type_for_struct_instance` maps a MemoryRef-backed `Array{T,N}` wrapper to
  `ValueType::ArrayOf(elem, rank)` instead of `ValueType::Struct`, so the runtime
  specializer's `IndexAssign` path (#6346) matches struct Vectors. Untyped
  `fillmul!(a, n)` no longer lands in the `specialization_failure_cache` (#8603);
  its body now compiles to `LoadSlotArray … IndexStoreTyped … StoreSlotArray`.
- `IndexLoadTyped` / `IndexStoreTyped` delegate Array-wrapper receivers to the generic
  `IndexLoad`/`IndexStore` arms (which own the #6806 MemoryRef fast path and the
  user-`getindex`/`setindex!`-override gates), passing `indices.len()` as the arity so
  `CartesianIndex` expansion stays correct.
- The specializer's `compile_index` now rejects type-object-prefixed array literals
  (`Any[x]`, which parse as `Expr::Index`) as `Unsupported`, falling back to the generic
  body. Latent bug, newly reachable once array-argument functions became specializable.
- Fixtures: `array_specialized_store_{fill,compound,mapcopy,alias,errpath}_10566`
  (upstream-verified; alias fixture pins that aliased locals observe each other's writes,
  errpath pins that stores preceding a mid-loop `BoundsError` stay visible under try/catch).
- Perf-neutral by itself; it is the prerequisite for #10566 blockers (b) `StoreSlotArray`
  narrowing and (c) transactional write-back, which remain open.
  narrowing and (c) transactional write-back.

### Typed-loop array stores: `StoreSlotArray` narrowing + transactional buffers (Issue #10566 blockers (b)(c))

- **(b)** The typed-loop decoder's blanket `StoreSlotArray` reject (the #7538 workaround)
  is narrowed to accept exactly the *same-slot identity rebind*
  (`LoadSlotArray(s) … IndexStoreTyped(1); StoreSlotArray(s)`, recognized via
  `array_slot_stack.last() == Some(s)`) — the shape blocker (a) now generates for every
  untyped array-store loop. No typed local needs rebinding, so the op is elided; only the
  new `TypedLoopOp::DropArray` is emitted, to pop the array value `IndexStoreTyped` pushed
  back onto the runtime array mini-stack (omitting it leaked one entry per iteration and
  overflowed `TYPED_LOOP_STACK_CAP`). Cross-slot array stores (`tmp = a`) keep the #7538
  reject — that is genuine aliasing, not this rebind.
- **(c)** `IndexStore*` now writes a **private transactional buffer** per stored array
  local (`ArrayWriteOrigin`), resolved at block entry: an `ArrayRef` clone for ExprArgs
  carriers, a `snapshot_numeric_vector_for_store` copy for MemoryRef-backed `Vector{T}`
  structs. Every non-`Bail` outcome (clean completion, `EarlyReturn`, `UndefLocal`, and a
  propagated `VmError`) commits the buffer back through the origin —
  **elementwise into the EXISTING `Memory`** for struct Vectors
  (`write_back_numeric_vector_buffer`; never reallocating, so other aliases observe the
  writes) and in place for ExprArgs `ArrayRef`s (preserving `Rc` identity). A `Bail`
  discards the buffer unread, so the generic re-run from the loop header starts from
  pristine arrays and cannot double-apply.
- **Aliasing rejection, keyed on BACKING STORAGE.** At block entry each live-in array
  local's storage identity (`Vm::numeric_vector_storage_id`: the `Memory`/native-carrier
  `Rc` pointer plus the `[start, start+len)` element window) is compared pairwise; an
  OVERLAP with at least one side stored rejects the whole block to the generic
  interpreter, which handles aliasing correctly. The first cut keyed this on the `Array`
  wrapper's `StructRef` index and was caught in adversarial (codex) review: `reshape` /
  `view` produce DISTINCT wrapper structs over ONE backing `Memory`, and the write-back
  commits *through that `Memory`* — so wrapper-keyed identity missed them (stale reads;
  two stored buffers clobbering each other = a LOST STORE). Related: a native `ArrayValue`
  with a `shared_parent` (reshape) writes THROUGH to its parent inside `ArrayValue::set`,
  so a `Clone` of it is not a private buffer at all — such a local now rejects the block
  outright whenever a store is in play. Pinned by
  `array_typed_loop_store_alias_storage_10566` (upstream-verified).
- **#10504 / #10536 interaction, updated coherently.** `IndexStoreI64`/`IndexStoreF64` are
  no longer in-place side effects (`typed_loop_op_is_in_place_side_effect` is now
  `RandF64` only) — a bail after one is discardable. They ARE now bail-capable
  (`typed_loop_op_can_bail_on_data`), because an out-of-bounds index or element-type
  mismatch must **bail rather than raise**: only the generic `setindex!` dispatch produces
  the upstream-compatible Julia-level `BoundsError`, whereas the raw `ArrayValue::set`
  guard returns an internal shape error (the exact trap PR #10756 hit in blocker (a);
  `array_specialized_store_bounds_10566` pins it). `RandF64` still sets
  `side_effect_applied`, so `loops_typed_loop_uninit_local_bail_after_rand_10536` is
  unaffected.
- Fixture: `array_typed_loop_store_bail_10566` (upstream-verified) — a block mixing an
  array store with a bail-capable `ModI64` (`7 % (i - 3)`) discards its buffer on the bail
  and the generic re-run applies each `+= 1` exactly once.
- Reach today: **fill/store loops** (`a[i] = f(i)`) run as native typed blocks
  (`[typed-loop-accept]` on `benchmarks/array_store_fillmul_bench.jl`'s `fill_mul!`).
  Loops that also **read** an array (`y[i] = x[i] + 1`, `x[i] *= c`) stay generic: the
  runtime specializer emits an untyped `IndexLoad` (not `IndexLoadTyped`) and the
  predecoder cannot resolve a specialized body's array param element type. Tracked as a
  follow-up.

### Rename runtime-dispatched `Intrinsic` variants away from `…Float` (Issue #10754)

The `Intrinsic` variants backing the runtime-dispatched `+ - * / ^` operators
were renamed `AddFloat`/`SubFloat`/`MulFloat`/`DivFloat`/`PowFloat` →
`DynamicAdd`/`DynamicSub`/`DynamicMul`/`DynamicDiv`/`DynamicPow`. The old
`…Float` `Debug` spelling made `--dump-bytecode` output such as
`CallDynamicBinaryBoth(AddFloat, …)` read as if the op were floating-point-only,
when it actually dispatches over every argument type (Int64, Float64, Complex,
BigInt, …) at runtime. For `f(x) = x + 1` the dump now reads
`CallDynamicBinaryBoth(DynamicAdd, …)`.

- Stable wire IDs (8–12) are unchanged — only the variant identifiers moved, so
  the serialized bytecode is byte-identical. At runtime the `strum::VariantNames`
  `enum_variant_fingerprint` already auto-rejects stale caches on the rename.
- Even so, `intrinsics.rs` / `wire_ids.rs` are listed in
  `base_cache_schema_files.txt`, so the content-hash audit guard
  (`schema_fingerprint_guard`, Issue #10051) requires `CACHE_VERSION` to move
  with any change to those files: bumped `118 → 119` and refreshed
  `base_cache_schema_fingerprint.txt` via
  `scripts/audit_base_cache_schema_fingerprint.sh --update`.
- The `name()`/`from_name` wire strings (`add_float`, …) are kept, so
  `Core.Intrinsics.add_float(…)` still resolves and executes as before.
- Updated all compiler/VM/specializer references, the profiler label test
  (`CallDynamicBinaryBoth::DynamicAdd/1`), and
  `BINARY_DISPATCH.md` / `NUMERIC_TYPES.md` / `TYPE_PRESERVATION.md` /
  `benchmarks/README.md`.
### ComplexF64 broadcast call-site specialization for untyped callees (Issue #10704)

`_try_broadcast_typed_kernel` now resolves the per-element callee with the
first concrete element and scalar arguments, then asks the runtime specializer
for a call-site-specialized body before predecoding the frame-less typed scalar
block. This lets `mandelbrot_escape.(C, maxiter)` with
`C::Matrix{ComplexF64}` and untyped `mandelbrot_escape(c, maxiter)` run the
callee as `(::ComplexF64, ::Int64)`, including the ComplexF64 SROA split-slot
preamble. The typed-function predecoder also accepts the runtime-specialized
`LoadSlot(param); GetField(0|1)` preamble shape in addition to the existing
`LoadSlotStruct` form.

Regression: `mandelbrot_tests::untyped_complex_broadcast_uses_typed_kernel_10704`
pins that the typed-kernel path returns an array for an untyped ComplexF64
broadcast callee. Release VM benchmark on 2026-07-12:
`mandelbrot_bench_broadcast_untyped.jl` improved to ~20.1s on this machine,
versus ~6.0s for the typed twin and ~45s reported before the fix.

### Intern `Expr::Call.function` callee names (Issue #10184)

`Expr::Call.function` now stores `InternedStr` and has an `Expr::call`
construction hub, mirroring the #10124 `Expr::Var` / `Expr::FunctionRef`
migration. Direct `Expr::Call` constructors across lowering, compile, AoT, VM
specialization, macro expansion, and REPL conversion now convert the callee name
with `.into()`, while lookup sites normalize with `as_str()` or `to_string()` at
API boundaries. Focused tests verify repeated call names share one allocation
and serialize byte-identically to the old `String` field.

### Remove owned `String` allocation from CST field labels (Issue #10188)

`CstNode.field_name` uses `Cow<'static, str>` and `push_field` stores parser
field labels as borrowed static strings. `child_by_field` and
`children_by_field` remain unchanged at the API level, and serde round-trips
owned field names back into lookup-compatible CST nodes.

### build.sh の sample-union preload cache 既定生成を停止 (Issue #10160)

`build.sh` は `SJULIA_PRELOAD_PACKAGES` が明示された時だけ
preloaded-package bytecode cache を生成・埋め込むようになった。未指定時は
`PRELOAD_PACKAGES_FOR_BUILD=""` のままにし、preload cache generation と
`SJULIA_PRELOAD_CACHE` export/embed を skip する。これにより、全 iOS sample の
`using`/`import` root union から作った、実 sample の exact closure/order と一致せず
runtime gate で使われない dead cache を既定ビルドに含めない。監査:
`scripts/check_build_preload_packages_explicit.sh`。

### Frame-less mixed-type fast path for `CallSpecialize` call sites (Issue #10567)

Added `try_execute_typed_scalar_function_call_from_values`
(`subset_julia_vm_vm/src/vm/executable.rs`): a genuinely mixed-type argument
list at a `CallSpecialize`/`CallSpecializeInbounds` call site (e.g. a boxed
`ComplexF64` struct plus an `Int64` counter, as at `mandel_point(c,
maxiter)`'s call site) now runs the already-specialized body frame-lessly by
reusing the existing `TypedScalarFunctionBlock` / `bind_typed_function_param`
machinery, instead of always falling through to the generic frame-allocating
path. Extended the shared typed-op predecoder to recognize the runtime
specializer's `LoadSlot(param); GetField(0..=1)` ComplexF64 param-decompose
shape (function-mode only). Pure additive optimization with unchanged
fallback semantics on any input that does not fit. See STATUS.md for the
benchmark numbers and the related #10704 broadcast specialization note.

### `replace` upstream-parity surface: SubstitutionString / Function / multi-pair / count=0 (Issues #10174/#10175/#10197)

`replace(s, pat => repl, ...)` now matches upstream `Base.replace` on the three
gaps found in the Issue #10080 regex audit:

- **#10174 SubstitutionString expansion.** `s"..."` lowers to a new
  `SubstitutionString <: AbstractString` (mirroring upstream `@s_str`) so
  `replace(s, re => s"\2 \1")` expands `\1`..`\9`, `\g<name>` (named or
  numeric), `\0` (whole match), and `\\`, instead of copying the reference
  verbatim. Expansion runs at the regex boundary (`_expand_substitution`
  builtin) where capture names are available, matching upstream
  `_replace(io, ::SubstitutionString, …)`.
- **#10175 Function values and multiple pairs.** A `Function` replacement is
  called per matched substring (`re => uppercase`), and
  `replace(s, p1 => r1, p2 => r2, …)` (Julia 1.7+) applies all pairs in a single
  left-to-right combined scan for both String and Regex patterns — mirroring
  upstream `_replace_`/`_replace_finish`. Regex patterns are re-found at each
  position with a new `_regex_match_from` (`findnext(re, str, i)`) primitive so
  a greedy pattern re-matches from the current position.
- **#10197 count=0.** `count == 0` returns the string unchanged (0 is no longer
  an unlimited sentinel).

Incidentally filed while reworking the boundary: `setindex!` corrupting a stored
`Function`/`Regex` (Issue #10720) and a plain-`String` regex replacement wrongly
expanding `$1` (Issue #10721).

### String-op loops in the typed-loop recognizer (Issue #10559)

typed-loop recognizer が `String` スロットの読み書きを含むループを native block 化するように
なった。新規 typed op: `LoadStrSlot` / `StoreStrSlot` / `PushStrConst` / `ConcatStr` / `EqStr` /
`StrLen`。`TypedLoopBlock` に `str_slots` (String スロットクラス) と `str_consts`
(コンパイル時文字列リテラルプール) を追加。

- 実測 (release-fast, 同一バイナリ A/B, min-of-5): 文字列比較ループ 4.52x、
  `prefix * suffix` 連結ループ 3.02x、固定文字列連結 2.28x。
  無制限累積 (`s = s * "x"`, O(n²)) はアロケーション律速で 1.10x。
- `Value::Str` が `Rc<str>` (Issue #8630) なので slot load/store は refcount bump。
  純増アロケーションはゼロ。
- UTF-8: `StrLen` はコードポイント数 (`chars().count()`)。バイト長ではない。
- Fixture: `subset_julia_vm/tests/fixtures/loops/loops_string_typed_loop_10559.jl`
  (UTF-8 / マルチバイト を含む)。Benchmark: `benchmarks/string_typed_loop_bench.jl`。

### Typed-loop direct calls inline mixed-type callees (Issue #10542)

`typed_loop_f64_call_op` / `typed_loop_i64_call_op` (the direct-call arms
`Instr::Call`/`CallResolved`/`CallInbounds`/`CallResolvedI64Slots` inside the
typed-loop recognizer) now fall back to the mixed-type
`TypedScalarFunctionBlock` decoder (`try_predecode_typed_scalar_function`,
Issue #9693) when the pure single-type decoder
(`try_predecode_f64_function`/`try_predecode_i64_function`) rejects the
callee body — the common "F64 math + I64 loop counter" (or I64-shaped mirror)
helper shape. Two new frame-less typed-loop ops,
`TypedLoopOp::CallTypedF64Function` / `TypedLoopOp::CallTypedI64Function`,
execute the resolved block via `run_typed_scalar_block_with_f64_args` / the
new `run_typed_scalar_block_with_i64_args`. The existing shape gate keeps
every declared param the same type as the call site's argument stack, so no
new mixed-argument-type call shape is accepted (a genuinely mixed
declared-param-type callee, e.g. `f(a::Int64, b::Float64)`, still cannot be
staged onto either direct-call arm's homogeneous argument stack and stays on
the interpreter frame path — correct, just not natively inlined). The new
fallback recursion is capped to one extra level via an `allow_typed_fallback`
flag threaded through `try_predecode_typed_ops_range`, reusing the existing
cycle-guarded pure predecoders for any further nested call inside a fallback
callee's own body.

Fixture:
`subset_julia_vm/tests/fixtures/loops/typed_loop_call_typed_mixed_10542.jl`
covers both the F64-shaped and I64-shaped mixed-body callees, an
argument-order-sensitive (non-commutative) binding check, and the
genuinely-mixed-declared-param-type rejection case, all verified against
upstream Julia (`scripts/fixture_julia_parity.sh`).

`benchmarks/f64_scan_typed_helper.jl` — previously on the per-instruction
interpreter (`[typed-loop-reject]`) and ~4× slower than its untyped twin
`benchmarks/f64_scan_untyped_helper.jl` — is now accepted
(`[typed-loop-accept]`) and on par with the untyped helper.
### Int128/UInt128 string macros + excess API surface tightening (Issues #10320, #10324)

Aligned four upstream-subset surfaces with Julia 1.12:

- **`int128"..."` / `uint128"..."`** (Issue #10320): the lowercase `@int128_str`
  / `@uint128_str` string macros now lower to `Int128` / genuine `UInt128`
  literals (the `uint128` arm wraps a range-checked BigInt so values above
  `typemax(Int128)` up to `typemax(UInt128)` are exact). The non-upstream
  capitalized `Int128"..."` / `UInt128"..."` spellings were removed from the
  three string-macro lowering arms (`lowering/expr/mod.rs`,
  `quote/cst_to_constructor.rs`) and now fall through to the generic
  `@Prefix_str` path, erroring like any undefined string macro (#10324 item 4).
- **`bytes2hex`** now requires `eltype === UInt8` (`ArgumentError` otherwise) and
  **`hex2bytes`** returns `Vector{UInt8}`, matching upstream and keeping
  `bytes2hex(hex2bytes(s))` round-trips valid (#10324 item 1).
- **`rsplit`**: the positional 3-arg `rsplit(s, delim, limit)` helper is now
  underscore-private (`_rsplit_limit`); only the `limit=` keyword form is
  user-callable, so the positional spelling is a `MethodError` as upstream
  (#10324 item 2).
- **`Memory{T}(n)`**: single-argument `Memory{T}(n::Int)` / `Memory{T}(undef)`
  now compile to a catchable runtime `MethodError`; only `Memory{T}()` and
  `Memory{T}(undef, n)` are valid, matching upstream `base/genericmemory.jl`.
  All internal Base callers and the affected fixtures were migrated to the
  `undef` form (#10324 item 3).
### Typed-loop uninit-local bail raises directly instead of double-drawing rand() (Issue #10536)

`run_typed_ops_core` tracks a `side_effect_applied` flag (set by `RandF64`/
`IndexStoreF64`/`IndexStoreI64`); every uninit-loop-local-load guard
(`Load*Slot`/`AddF64Slots`/`JumpIfI64Slots`/... with `!*_init[local]`) now
routes through a shared `bail_or_undef_local!` macro that returns the new
`TypedOpsOutcome::UndefLocal { kind, local }` once the flag is set, instead of
`TypedOpsOutcome::Bail`. `execute_typed_loop_block` resolves the local back to
its frame slot name and raises the matching `UndefVarError` directly (the
Issue #10406 catchable-routing pattern), so the generic interpreter is never
re-run from the loop header after an already-applied side effect — closing
the residual documented in `typed_loop_op_can_bail_on_data`'s guard comment
since #10504/PR #10533. Fixture:
`subset_julia_vm/tests/fixtures/loops/loops_typed_loop_uninit_local_bail_after_rand_10536.jl`.

### `eachmatch(re, s; overlap=true)` yields overlapping matches (Issue #10199)

`eachmatch` now threads the `overlap` keyword through the compile boundary to
the runtime. The new `RegexValue::find_all_overlapping` mirrors upstream
`Base.RegexMatchIterator`'s `overlap=true` branch: after each match the search
restarts one character past the match START (`nextind(s, m.offset)`) rather than
past its end, so `[m.offset for m in eachmatch(r"aa", "aaaa"; overlap=true)]` is
now `[1, 2, 3]` instead of `[1, 3]`. Empty-capable patterns advance one
character per position (no infinite loop) and the full-string context is
preserved so anchors/look-behind still work across restarts. The default and
`overlap=false` forms are unchanged (non-overlapping `find_all`). Fixture:
`regex/regex_eachmatch_overlap_10199.jl`.
### `ispunct` が非 ASCII の Unicode 句読点も分類する (Issue #10321)

`ispunct` を C ロケール ASCII 表から upstream 完全準拠へ拡張。upstream は
`UTF8PROC_CATEGORY_PC <= category_code(c) <= UTF8PROC_CATEGORY_PO`
(Pc/Pd/Ps/Pe/Pi/Pf/Po) で判定するが、sjulia には utf8proc バインディングが
無いため、参照 julia の utf8proc から生成した P* カテゴリのコードポイント範囲表
(`_ISPUNCT_RANGE_LO`/`_ISPUNCT_RANGE_HI`、198 レンジ) を埋め込み、`isnumeric`
と同じ二分探索で判定する (`subset_julia_vm/src/julia/base/strings/basic.jl`)。
これで `ispunct('¡')`/`ispunct('«')`/`ispunct('…')` などの非 ASCII 句読点が
upstream 同様 `true` を返す (以前は ASCII 以外すべて `false`)。0..0x10FFFF 全域で
参照 julia と一致 (真部分集合 855 コードポイント / FNV ハッシュ一致) を確認済み。
`strings/char_classification.jl` に非 ASCII の Pc..Po と Sm/So/Ll 反例を追加。
### Record regex PCRE2 permissiveness-divergence policy (Issue #10183)

Recorded the policy decision for the three regex cases where sjulia
(fancy-regex) is *more permissive* than upstream Julia (PCRE2) — variable-length
lookbehind `(?<=ab*)c`, `\x{...}` under `PCRE2_ALT_BSUX`, and catastrophic
backtracking / match-limit `(a|a?)+$`. Upstream errors on all three; sjulia
accepts/completes. Decision: **declare all three permanent DIVERGENT — do not
enforce error parity**, aligning with the Native Boundary ADR (regex surface is
Policy A, pure-Rust fancy-regex, PCRE2 not a native dependency; Issues #8992 /
#9570). `\x{}` ALT_BSUX rewriting and PCRE2 match-limit accounting are intrinsic
engine differences we do not reimplement, and rejecting variable-length
lookbehind would need an ad-hoc, false-positive-prone pattern analyzer (against
"General Over Ad-hoc"). `docs/vm/REGEX_PCRE2_PARITY.md` now carries the decision;
a `test_pcre2_permissiveness_divergences_10183` characterization test in
`subset_julia_vm_bytecode/src/value/regex.rs` pins sjulia's current behavior so a
future fancy-regex bump that changes it is caught.

### `split(s, ::Regex; limit, keepempty)` reaches the regex splitter (Issue #10176)

`split("a1b22c333d", r"\d+")`, `split("a,b,,c", r","; limit=2)`, and
`split("a,b,,c", r","; keepempty=false)` now return
`SubString{String}["a","b","c","d"]`, `["a","b,,c"]`, and `["a","b","c"]`,
matching upstream julia 1.12. Root cause: the `RegexSplit` builtin was mapped to
name `split` with an empty route list, so it was unreachable, and the pure-Julia
`split` methods shadowed the name without a `::Regex` method. Fix: added
`split(::String, ::Regex; limit=0, keepempty=true)` in `base/strings/util.jl`
that delegates to the `_regex_split` builtin; `RegexValue::split_with` now
implements upstream `SplitIterator` semantics (`limit`/`keepempty`, borrowed
slices materialized as `SubString{String}`). `rsplit(::Regex)` left unsupported
(upstream `MethodError`s on it). Fixture: `regex_split_10176.jl`.
### findfirst(::Regex, s) / findnext(::Regex, s, i) (Issue #10177)

`findfirst(r::Regex, s)` and `findnext(r::Regex, s, i)` now return the 1-based
byte `UnitRange` of the next match (or `nothing`), completing the public regex
search API alongside `findall(::Regex, s)` (#6749). The pure-Julia wrappers in
`base/strings/search.jl` build on a new `_regex_findnext` builtin — a positional
`fancy_regex::captures_from_pos` search that runs against the FULL string, the
sjulia analog of upstream's `PCRE.exec(re, str, idx-1)`. Because the search is
positional (not an `eachmatch`/substring scan), overlapping matches
(`findnext(r"\d\d","123",2) == 2:3`) and `^`/`\b`/lookbehind context behave like
upstream, and an out-of-range `idx` throws `BoundsError`. `findlast(::Regex, s)`
is intentionally left undefined (upstream itself throws `MethodError`). Pinned by
`regex_findfirst_findnext_10177.jl`; all values verified against upstream julia
1.12.
### Tighten generator trait matrix skiplist negative control (Issue #10325)

The generator trait matrix skiplist ratchet is tight at the current committed
10-row residual count. The audit-the-audits harness now has separate
injections for the unknown-id branch and the row-growth branch, so the row
ratchet cannot be hidden by an unrelated stale fixture comparison when the
skiplist shrinks.

### Use origin-aware struct type conversion for residual raw-table sites (Issue #10383)

The two residual `julia_type_to_value_type_with_table(..., struct_table)` sites
from #10258 are now routed through `julia_type_to_value_type_with_origin_table`:
struct field annotations in `build_struct_tables`, and inner-constructor
parameter annotations in `register_inner_constructors`. `CorePipeline` carries
per-struct origin with `all_structs`, derived structurally from Base/user merge
order and loaded-module provenance, so Base-origin structs prefer
`base_struct_table` after a bare-name alias collision while user-origin structs
continue to use the live `struct_table`.

### Complete the metamorphic equivalence-lane matrix (Issue #10465)

`scripts/metamorphic_equivalence.sh` now supports all five #10465 lanes:
direct/callable, module-wrap, fresh/cache, generic/optimized, and VM/AoT. The
generic/optimized lane compares `SJULIA_SSA_PIPELINE=0` against the default
optimized SSA pipeline. The VM/AoT lane compares release VM output against a
`juliars --minimal-prelude --emit-binary` generated binary for the canonical AoT
acceptance manifest. The full curated corpus currently compares 40 lane-pairs
with zero known-divergence rows.

### Deduplicate VM stack push/continue arms (Issue #10260)

The VM stack executor now uses one `push_continue` helper for constant/value
push instructions that previously repeated `self.stack.push(...);
Ok(DispatchAction::Continue)`. This completes the #10260 A1 helper slice in
`subset_julia_vm_vm/src/vm/exec/stack.rs` and adds a focused unit test for the
helper contract.
`scripts/metamorphic_equivalence.sh` now supports `--lane fresh_cache`, running
each curated case under a fresh no-persistent-cache lane and a primed/restored
persistent-cache lane with isolated target/cache directories. The initial case
`tests/equivalence/fresh_cache/weakref_gc_10092.jl` pins the #10092 WeakRef/GC
cache-restore shape as a small semantic parity check. The harness docs and
audit registry now list three implemented lanes: direct/callable, module-wrap,
and fresh/cache.

### `Regex(pattern[, flags])` constructor と 3引数 `match(re, s, start)` を配線 (Issue #10178)

`Regex("ab+c")` / `Regex("abc", "i")` を関数として呼べるようになり、パターンを
動的に構築できる (`Regex(escaped_user_input)`)。従来は 1 引数形が
builtin-type-name コンストラクタ経路を素通りして `Unknown function: Regex` で
失敗していた (2 引数形のみ `CallFunctionVariable` 経由で偶然成功)。
コンパイル時ハンドラ `compile_regex_new` を `special_case_handler` テーブルに
追加し、1〜2 引数の `Regex(...)` を `RegexNew` builtin に直接ルーティングする
(`RegexNew` が唯一の `Regex` コンストラクタ)。
3 引数 `match(re, s, start)` は 1 始まりのバイト位置から検索する: `RegexValue`
に `find_from` (fancy-regex `captures_from_pos`、絶対 1 始まりオフセットを保持)
を追加し、`RegexMatch` builtin と `compile_regex_match` を 2〜3 引数対応に拡張
した。`match(r"bc", "abcbc", 4).offset == 4` が upstream julia 1.12 と一致。
既存の `match(a, b, c)` ユーザメソッド (Issue #7502) は第1引数が Regex でなく
`match` メソッドテーブルが存在する場合に fall through するガードで保護される。
Fixture: `regex/regex_constructor_3arg_match_10178.jl` (20 assertions, julia parity)。
### Struct-typed comprehension iterables stay on iterate (Issue #10607)

The #10442 prevention surface is pinned directly in
`compile/expr/collection.rs`: a new unit guard asserts that
`ValueType::Generator` and `ValueType::Struct(_)` comprehensions use the
iterate-protocol loop, while arrays and ranges remain on the indexed loop. The
Generator Consumer / Public Indexing checklist now requires the
`comprehension/partition_iterate_protocol_10442.jl` parity fixture, which covers
`Iterators.partition` plus a custom length+iterate/no-getindex struct.
### Reject PCRE2 regex recursion / subroutine calls (Issue #10181)

Detect and reject PCRE2 pattern-recursion constructs in `RegexValue::new`
(`subset_julia_vm_bytecode/src/value/regex.rs`): `(?R)`/`(?0)`, numbered and
relative `(?n)`/`(?+n)`/`(?-n)`, and named `(?&name)`/`(?P>name)` subroutine
calls now raise `regex recursion is not supported (Issue #10181)` at
construction instead of `fancy-regex` silently mis-matching `(?R)` or failing
`(?1)` opaquely. Detection is escape- and character-class-aware, so `\(?R\)` and
`[(?R)]` are not mistaken for groups and legitimate `(?:…)`/`(?i)`/`(?>…)`/
lookaround/named-capture constructs are unaffected. Regression fixture
`regex/regex_recursion_reject_10181.jl` (marked `skip_julia_test = true` — a
deliberate sjulia-vs-upstream divergence) plus `detect_regex_recursion` unit
tests. Parity rows moved to UNSUPPORTED in `docs/vm/REGEX_PCRE2_PARITY.md`.

### Any-carried missing dynamic binary operations propagate `missing` (Issues #10612/#10693)

Runtime dynamic binary paths now propagate `Value::Missing` operands for
arithmetic and comparisons, matching upstream Julia when values are loaded from
`Vector{Any}`. `CallDynamicBinaryBoth` covers the common `==`/`+`/ordering
surface, sjulia's `div(x, y)` bridge covers `÷`, and `DynamicPow` covers `^`.
This fixes `Any[missing][1] == Any[missing][1]` returning `true` and
`Any[missing, 1][1] + Any[missing, 1][2]` raising `MethodError`; both now
propagate `missing`. Bitwise `Bool`/`Missing` truth tables remain tracked
separately in #10692.

### TupleEquals nested array-like equality has a direct guard (Issue #10615)

The #10296 nested readable-array equality regression is now covered directly at
the shared `TupleEquals` element fold. A new unit test verifies that
`array_elements_equal_tristate_with_shapes` recurses through
`array_like_logical_view` for nested readable carriers instead of falling back
to reference identity, and still rejects mismatched nested contents or outer
array shapes. The array equality checklist now calls out the nested-carrier
case so future `TupleEquals` / wrapper-boundary changes do not rely only on
top-level `try_equal_array_like` coverage.

### Retire the ComplexF64 resolved-call fast path for `abs2` (Issue #10530)

Removed `try_complex_f64_resolved_call_fast_path` from `vm/exec/call.rs` and the
now-unused `try_complex_f64_abs2` helper from `vm/exec/binary_both.rs`.
`Base.abs2(::ComplexF64)` already runs through the normal
`execute_direct_call_fast` → `try_execute_typed_scalar_function_call` path:
the concrete method has a `Struct` parameter, so it is not a runtime-
specialization candidate, and its body (`GetField`, `MulF64`, `AddF64`,
`ReturnF64`) predecodes cleanly to a `TypedScalarFunctionBlock`. No guard
bypass is required.

Generic `Base.:*` and `Base.:+` for `ComplexF64` remain handled by the
remaining `CallDynamicBinaryBoth` fast path (`try_complex_f64_binary_op`) and
normal frame dispatch; making their generic bodies predecodable so they can
also run frame-lessly is tracked as Issue #10645.

Benchmark results are recorded in `benchmarks/results/results_10530.md`:
`mandelbrot_guard` with/without the resolved-call fast path stayed within
noise (~1.8 ms), the post-change untyped Mandelbrot CLI run produced the same
checksum as the typed run in ~11 s, and VM profiling confirmed no
`try_complex_f64_resolved_call_fast_path` events remain.

### Empty filtered generator eltype provenance has deterministic prevention coverage (Issue #10621)

The #10138/#10618 empty filtered-generator provenance rule is now pinned by a
consolidated Rust regression test and the generator checklist. The test fails if
the compiler starts trusting a body-only `result_element_type` when the filter
predicate contains a nontransparent/user call, or if either runtime empty
filter-map path stops erasing an inlined-predicate eltype to `Union{}[]`.

Regression coverage also extends
`generator/filtered_generator_empty_user_predicate_10138.jl` with `first(...)`
as a non-`sum` user-call all-filtered consumer. The reduce/mapreduce behavior
found while looking for additional consumer coverage is intentionally split to
bug follow-up #10672.

### Empty filtered generator sum distinguishes mapped bodies (Issue #10618)

`sum(g::Generator)` keeps the existing collect-backed path for non-empty
generators, but routes empty generator reductions through a VM helper that still
has the native generator callable. This preserves upstream's mapreduce-empty
split: identity mapping keeps the additive identity
(`sum(x for x in xs if false) == 0` for a known integer result type), while
non-identity mapped bodies such as `f(x)` or `x + 0` raise a catchable
`ArgumentError` like upstream Julia.

Regression coverage: `generator/filtered_generator_empty_sum_mapped_10618.jl`
checks the Issue #10618 MWE, an operator-body variant, the identity-body zero
case, `init` seeding, and a non-empty mapped generator.

### Pair diagonal UnionAll preserves repeated invariant slots (Issue #10635)

`Pair{T,T} where T` now prints as `Pair{T, T} where T` and remains mutually
subtype-equivalent to the same diagonal schema with a different binder name
(`Pair{S,S} where S`), matching upstream Julia. The display formatter no longer
treats a repeated where variable that still appears in the retained prefix as a
left-prefix partial application, while fully generic aliases such as
`Pair{K,V} where {K,V}` still print as `Pair`.

Regression coverage: `pair/pair_diagonal_unionall_10635.jl` checks display,
generic alias equality, alpha-equivalent diagonal schema equality/subtyping, and
the concrete `Pair{Int64,Int64}` / `Pair{Int64,String}` subtype boundary.
Prevention follow-up: #10650.

### Union reflection FieldError closes the static dot-access and typejoin paths (Issue #10606 follow-up)

The initial #10606 fix restricted Union-kind receivers to the `a`/`b` fields on
the dynamic `getfield`/`GetFieldByName` path (and made `fieldnames(Union) ==
(:a, :b)`), but two paths still leaked: (1) when the compiler statically narrows
the receiver to `DataType`, dot access lowers `parameters`/`var`/`body`/`lb`/`ub`
to the dedicated reflection builtins (`_TypeParameters`, `_UnionAllVar`,
`_UnionAllBody`, `_TypeVarLowerBound`, `_TypeVarUpperBound`), which still answered
with an svec of branch types (`.parameters`) or a wrong-name
`FieldError(DataType, ...)`; and (2) `typejoin` indexed `.parameters` off a Union
operand — now a `FieldError` — so `typejoin(Union{...}, Union{...})` errored.

Each of the five reflection builtins now funnels the receiver through a shared
`union_reflection_field_error` helper that raises `FieldError(Union, :field)` for
a Union-kind `DataType` value, and `typejoin` gained the upstream
`isa(a, Union)` / `isa(b, Union)` case (`promotion.jl` ordering) that collapses a
Union operand through its `a`/`b` branch fields before the DataType-assuming
paths run. `typejoin` over Union arguments now returns the correct join
(`typejoin(Union{Int8,Int16}, Int32) === Signed`).

Regression coverage: `reflection/union_reflection_static_typejoin_10606.jl`
(static-path FieldError with the `Union` receiver name + typejoin over Union
operands, verified against upstream Julia 1.12).

### Tuple equality compares nested arrays by value across element types (Issue #10631)

`TupleEquals` now uses the same heap-aware `==` fold for tuple, named-tuple, and
struct fields that array equality already uses for array-like operands. This
keeps nested array elements on Julia value equality instead of falling back to
concrete element-type or heap-carrier identity, so
`(Any[1, 2], Any[3, 4]) == ([1, 2], [3, 4])` returns `true` like upstream
Julia. The fold still propagates `missing` for tuple `==`.

Regression coverage extends `tuple/vector_element_equality_7803.jl` with the
different-element-type nested array MWE from Issue #10631 plus a missing
propagation guard.

### Generator trait query inside hard local scopes keeps lifted body callable (Issue #10137)

Lifted generator helper functions (`__gen_body_N` / `__gen_pred_N`) are now bound
as local callable values when they are introduced inside hard local scopes such
as `let` and macro-expanded `@testset` bodies. `let` binding RHS expressions are
compiled under the same hard-scope depth, and `let` local cleanup tracks nested
function definitions so helper names do not leak after the block. This fixes
`Base.IteratorSize((f(x) for x in xs))` inside `@testset` / `let`, which
previously attempted `LoadAny("__gen_body_N")` and failed with `UndefVarError`.

Regression coverage: `generator/generator_trait_testset_lifted_body_10137.jl`
checks both `@testset` and plain `let` trait queries. The filtered-generator
runtime callable path also preserves compiler-provided empty result eltype hints
even when the runtime callable captures a local function value, keeping the
Issue #9127 empty `collect(sqr(x) for x in xs if x > 100)` invariant intact.

### Static-vs-dynamic type-application parity matrix + opcode-coverage audit (Issue #10556)

Prevention deliverable for the drift class behind #10554 / #10587 / #10586 /
#10422: static `ConstructParametricType*` and dynamic `ApplyTypeDynamic*`
construction converged only on name-based success and never shared a negative-case
contract. Added the table-driven parity fixture
`subset_julia_vm/tests/fixtures/types/type_application_matrix_10556.jl`
(`types_type_application_matrix_10556`) exercising `T{args...}` and
`Core.apply_type` across static syntax vs runtime-held bases (local / function
parameter) and positional vs one-or-more-splat forms, over valid full/partial
applications and invalid upper-bound, lower-bound, over-arity (leftover params
after all binders consumed), non-type-base, and concrete-base cases, comparing
success values or thrown exception classes against upstream julia. Includes a
user parametric type with upper+lower bounds and ≥2 binders. Every
`PushDataType` / `ConstructParametricType{,Splat}` / `ApplyTypeDynamic{,Splat}`
opcode is emitted from a named helper and pinned. New audit
`scripts/check_type_application_matrix.sh` discovers the type-application opcodes
from `subset_julia_vm_bytecode/src/instr.rs` and fails when one is unrepresented
in the matrix (source-only cross-check; opportunistic bytecode-emission check when
a `sjulia` binary is present); registered in ci.yml, pr-fast's `check_*.sh` batch,
`docs/vm/CODE_AUDITS.md`, and `scripts/check_audit_negative_selftest.sh`.
The fixture asserts only upstream-matching cases so it stays parity-comparable;
currently-diverging cases live in `docs/vm/TYPE_APPLICATION_MATRIX_SKIPLIST.tsv`
(the audit validates its format): #10643 (chained-literal `T{a}{b}` mis-bind),
#10654 (literal bare non-parametric base), and #10586 (under-applied builtin
family). Fixed on main and now asserted here on both the static and dynamic
paths: #10554 (static `Core.apply_type(KnownName, ...)` now enforces bounds/arity,
PR #10653), #10642 (lower-bound `>:` supertype acceptance, PR #10653), and #10587
(`Core.apply_type` bare-base path, PR #10638). Filed during this work: #10642,
#10643, #10644 (double-bounded struct param `{Lo<:T<:Hi}` parse gap), and #10654
(literal bare-base residual).

## 最新対応 (2026-07-11)

### Anonymous covariant/contravariant bound shorthand validates its bound name (Issue #10373)

Value-position `Vector{<:Name}` / `Vector{>:Name}` (and nested forms such as
`Dict{String, <:Name}`, `Vector{Vector{<:Name}}`, `Type{<:Name}`) now raise
`UndefVarError` when the bound names a genuinely undefined identifier, matching
upstream Julia — previously the whole expression was classified static by
`is_dynamic_type_arg` and parsed permissively as one compound type-name string
by `subset_julia_vm_types` (`parse_covariant_bound` builds an anonymous
`TypeVar` with no existence check; sibling gap of Issue #10226). The shorthand
now stays static only when its bound resolves against the static tables
(builtin/static type names, registered aliases, compound bound expressions);
an unresolved bare-identifier bound routes through the dynamic type-construct
path whose #10226-fixed lowering resolves it via ordinary runtime global
lookup — still resolving user structs / abstract types / runtime type-valued
globals (`B = typeof(1); Vector{<:B}` now yields `Vector{<:Int64}` like
upstream). The same rejection was added to `extract_type_alias_from_binding`
so a bare top-level assignment (`x = Vector{<:Name}`) no longer freezes the
unresolved name into a static string alias, and
`RuntimeTypeVarValue::projection()` now projects an anonymous contravariant
TypeVar's lower bound as the `>:`-prefixed bound string used by the static
parser (single-parameter `Vector{>:UserStruct}` previously collapsed to
`Vector{_}` on the dynamic path). `value_enum.rs` is an audited base-cache
schema file, so CACHE_VERSION was bumped to 104. Regression fixture
`types/covariant_shorthand_undef_bound_10373.jl` (25 assertions, julia-parity
verified) plus `covariant_shorthand_undef_bound_10373_tests` in
`regression_runtime_tests.rs` for the bare top-level assignment shape a
fixture cannot pin. Discovered value-level `isa` divergence filed as #10576.
### where-binder shadowing a builtin type name becomes a fresh method TypeVar (Issue #10407)

`h(x::Float64) where {Float64} = Float64(2)` now matches upstream: the binder
is a fresh method-local TypeVar shadowing the global `Float64` both in the
signature (so `h(3)` dispatches — previously a spurious
`MethodError: no method matching h(::Int64)`) and in the body (so `Float64(2)`
calls the per-call TypeVar binding — `h(3) === 2 :: Int64`,
`h(3.5) === 2.0 :: Float64` — previously the lazy runtime specializer baked the
builtin conversion into the specialized body). Two coupled fixes:
`parse_type_name` resolves an active where-binder name (via the Issue #7847
`ScopedExclusion` mechanism, exposed as `is_scoped_type_param`) as a plain
`Struct` so `convert_params_with_type_vars` rewrites it into the TypeVar with
declared bounds (name-based shadowing: `x::Int` under `where {Int64}` still
resolves to the global alias target); and `specialize_function` registers
`func.type_params` as `Any` locals so `compile_var`/`compile_call` emit dynamic
`LoadAny` consulting the per-call frame `type_bindings` (extending the Issue
#10146 local-callee gate to where binders). Fixture
`dispatch/where_binder_shadows_builtin_type_10407.jl` (18 assertions, verified
against julia 1.12, fails 9/18 pre-fix) plus lowering and specializer unit
tests.
### Bare `Bottom` identifier now raises UndefVarError like upstream (Issue #10304)

Upstream defines `const Bottom = Union{}` in Base *without* exporting it, so a
bare `Bottom` in Main is `UndefVarError`; sjulia resolved it to `Union{}`. Two
resolution paths removed: (a) the prelude's `base/essentials.jl` mirrored the
upstream const, and the flat・unqualified type-alias table (Issue #5065 の登録
機構) leaked the binding into user scope — the const is intentionally no longer
defined (nothing in sjulia's Julia sources referenced it); (b) the static
type-name parser `JuliaType::from_name` (parsing.rs) and compile-side match
arms (`compile/types.rs`, `type_helpers.rs`, `expr/mod.rs`, `expr/collection.rs`,
`expr/infer/mod.rs`) accepted the spelling `"Bottom"` as an alias for `Union{}`
— removed; only the canonical `"Union{}"` spelling remains (internal producers
render `JuliaType::Bottom` as `"Union{}"`, so nothing round-trips `"Bottom"`).
`Union{}` semantics (subtype universality, typeintersect zero element, Union
normalization) and user-defined `const Bottom = Union{}` (upstream-valid) are
unchanged. Fixture: `tests/fixtures/types/types_bottom_undefvar_10304.jl`;
`regression_scope_session_tests.rs` の #5065 テスト群は #10304 準拠に書き換え。
Follow-ups filed: 非 export Base alias の一般的リーク (`BitSigned` 等,
Issue #10578)、qualified `Base.Bottom` アクセス未対応 (Issue #10579)。
### isa resolves chained different-name where bounds (Issue #10410)

`Float64[1.0] isa (Vector{T} where T<:S where S<:Real)` now returns `true`,
agreeing with `Vector{Float64} <: r` and upstream (`Any[1,2] isa r` stays
`false`). The subtype engine already resolved the outer binder `S` through
`T`'s upper bound; the `isa` route broke earlier, at the string layer:
`JuliaType::from_name`'s `Vector{...}`/`Tuple{...}` prefix arms mis-split the
rendered brace form `Vector{T} where {S<:Real, T<:S}` into a garbage element
type, and `normalize_type_for_isa`'s space-stripping fused the top-level
` where ` keyword (`MyWrap{T}where{...}`) so user-struct targets lost their
where chain and fell into the registered-family hard-`false` arm. Both now
consult the new `has_top_level_trailing_where` scanner and leave UnionAll
surface forms intact for `CoreType::from_julia_name`. Fixture
`types_where_chained_bound_isa_10410` pins the Vector and user-struct
chained/single-bound cases plus the #10274/#10302 same-name regression.
### Core.apply_type rejects concrete parametric DataType bases (Issue #10422)

`Core.apply_type(Vector{Int64}, Float64)` and its variants (`Dict{String,
Int64}`, `Complex{Float64}`, `Tuple{Int64}`, a fully-applied user struct, or
the same base traced through a variable) now raise a catchable `TypeError`
("expected UnionAll"), matching upstream `jl_apply_type`. The compile-time
static path used to strip the `{...}` parameter list from the resolved base
name and emit `ConstructParametricType`, silently discarding the bound
parameters (yielding `Vector{Float64}`). `compile_apply_type` now only keeps
the static path for bare family names; brace-bearing bases defer to the
runtime `ApplyTypeDynamic` validator, which instantiates partial `UnionAll`s
(Issue #10192 unchanged) and rejects concrete instantiations. Follow-ups:
builtin partial instantiations as trailing UnionAlls (#10586), bare
non-parametric base validation (#10587). Fixture:
`types/apply_type_concrete_datatype_typeerror_10422.jl`.

### Core.apply_type rejects bare non-parametric bases (Issue #10587)

`Core.apply_type(Int64, Float64)`, `Core.apply_type(Real, Int64)`, and
`Core.apply_type(PlainStruct, Float64)` now route through the runtime
`ApplyTypeDynamic` validator and raise the upstream-shaped catchable
`TypeError` ("expected UnionAll") instead of emitting the static
`ConstructParametricType("Int64", 1)` path and fabricating nonsensical type
objects such as `Int64{Float64}`. The compile-time fast path is now restricted
to actual parametric families: curated builtin families, user parametric
structs, and user parametric abstract types.

### Union type values expose only upstream Union fields (Issue #10606)

`Union{Int64, Float64}.name`, `.parameters`, `.var`, `.body`, `.lb`, and `.ub`
now raise catchable `FieldError(Union, field)` instead of leaking DataType /
UnionAll / TypeVar reflection fields from the `Value::DataType` carrier.
Both field-access paths were fixed: dynamic `getfield(u, field)` in
`builtins_reflection` and compiled dot access (`u.name`) in
`GetFieldByName`. The previously added Union branch fields remain intact:
`.a` and `.b` return the two branch types, and `fieldnames(Union)` /
`fieldnames(Union{...})` now report `(:a, :b)`, matching upstream Julia.
Fixture: `reflection/union_reflection_fields_10606.jl`.

Regression coverage extends `types/apply_type_concrete_datatype_typeerror_10422.jl`
with bare concrete, bare abstract, non-parametric user struct, and runtime-traced
base cases, while keeping positive controls for `Vector`, user parametric
structs, and partial `UnionAll` application.

### Direct-vs-callable parametric constructor parity audit (Issue #10502)

Prevention follow-up from #10405/PR #10487 — test/docs only, no VM behavior
change. New fixture
`tests/fixtures/dispatch/parametric_ctor_callable_parity_10502.jl` pairs
direct parametric constructor syntax with first-class `DataType` callable
forms (bound variable, `map`) for the public parametric constructors beyond
the array coverage in `array/ctor_direct_vs_callable_parity_10213.jl`:
`Dict{K,V}` (varargs / empty / vector-of-pairs), `Rational{T}` with
Bool/Int32/BigInt sibling parameterizations each resolving to their own
instantiation, `Complex{T}` including the default-constructor-fallback-
after-dispatch-miss class, a generic TypeVar user ctor shared across
instantiations, and concrete-instantiation sibling isolation. Negative
guards: `InexactError` for `Rational{Bool}(2)` and catchable `MethodError`
for String arguments to Rational/Complex callables. Added the "Parametric
DataType callable constructor dispatch" checklist to `docs/vm/CHECKLISTS.md`
(runtime `DataType` candidate augmentation must only add generic TypeVar
methods, never concrete instantiation siblings; generic candidates must not
suppress the default constructor fallback). Two gaps discovered while
verifying fixture lines against upstream were filed instead of asserted:
Issue #10592 (a user outer-ctor method on a concrete instantiation
suppresses the default constructor and crashes) and Issue #10593
(non-convertible argument to a parametric default ctor: uncatchable compile
error at top level / silent corrupt instance in function context). Codex
review follow-up on PR #10601: added a `CtorAuditSib10502` scenario whose
sibling-only method takes an argument shape (Bool) that the sibling's
default constructor also handles, so a candidate-augmentation leak is
caught as a wrong value/type instead of requiring the #10593-blocked
MethodError direction. All asserted lines verified value-for-value under
julia 1.12 and sjulia (`fixture_julia_parity.sh` green). Closes #10502.
### Numeric fast-path operand failures raise MethodError like upstream (Issue #10481)

`sqrt("a")` / `floor("a")` / `ceil("a")` / `round("a")` (and the same failures
per element via `map`, `sum(f, itr)`, broadcast, and dynamic in-function calls)
now bind a `MethodError` in `catch`, matching upstream's dispatch miss, instead
of the internal conversion `TypeError("expected numeric value, got ...")`.
#10406 で catchable 化済みの失敗の例外「型」の精緻化。実装は error path 限定:
`SqrtF64`/`FloorF64`/`CeilF64`/`CallBuiltin(Sqrt|Round|Trunc)`/
`CallDynamicOrBuiltin` の丸め arm は変換失敗時のみ intended function 名で
`MethodError("no method matching f(::T)")` を構築し (`intrinsics_exec` の
named ヘルパー)、HOF/callable の intrinsic fallback (`try_call_intrinsic`) は
sin/cos の #4341 パターンに合わせ非数値 operand で `Ok(None)` を返して呼び出し
元の本物の dispatch-miss MethodError に落とす。DomainError (負の実数 sqrt) と
数値結果は不変。fixture:
`exceptions/numeric_fastpath_methoderror_10481.jl`。完全な fast-path/dispatch
統一は #10461 で継続。掃引で発見した `abs2("a") == "aa"` の別バグは #10602 に
起票。Closes #10481; refs #10461, #10405, #10406。
### Prevention: runtime specializer name-keyed callee fast paths vs. local shadowing (Issue #10418)

Prevention follow-up for #10146/PR #10417 (a parameter named `Float64` was
compiled as the builtin constructor inside runtime-specialized bodies).
Added (1) a shadowing matrix over representative name-keyed `compile_call`
arms — `Float64` / `Int64` / `sqrt` / `round` — both as a `vm::specialize`
unit test (shadowed → `LoadAny` + `CallFunctionVariable`, never the builtin
instruction; unshadowed → the builtin instruction) and as fixture legs in
`functions/parameter_shadows_numeric_constructor_10146.jl` (verified against
upstream julia); (2) a CHECKLISTS.md section requiring every new name-keyed
specializer fast path to run after the front-door local-callee guard; and
(3) `scripts/check_specializer_callee_guard.sh`, a fail-loud audit that
extracts the `compile_call` body and rejects a name-keyed dispatch placed
before the guard (registered in ci.yml, CODE_AUDITS.md, and
`check_audit_negative_selftest.sh` with an injection-based negative control).
Closes #10418.
### Declaration-position where-bound undefined names raise UndefVarError (Issue #10396)

A function-signature `where`-bound naming an undefined identifier
(`h2(x::T) where T<:UndefZZZ = x`) now raises `UndefVarError` when the method
definition executes, matching upstream's eager signature-bound evaluation —
the declaration-position sibling of Issue #10226's value-position fix. The
compiler emits a `LoadAny` + `Pop` resolution probe per unresolvable
bare-identifier bound name (lower bound before upper, mirroring upstream's
`TypeVar(:T, lb, ub)` evaluation order) right before the definition activates:
at the `Stmt::FunctionDef` / `Stmt::EvalFunctionDef` arms and at the top-level
source-order activation flush, with a span-keyed dedupe so a definition inside
a top-level `try` is probed once inside the handler region (catchable, as
upstream). Names statically resolvable as type objects (builtins, user
structs/abstract types, aliases) and the method's own where-binders are
skipped. Regression fixture:
`types/where_decl_bound_undefvarerror_10396.jl` (14 tests, julia-parity
verified). Remaining accept-more-than-upstream gaps: `where T<:T` with no
outer `T`, reversed braced order (`{S<:T, T}`), and module-body definitions
(module bodies do not flow through the probed paths).
### Bare-identifier assignment of a parametric alias application (Issue #10501)

`z = AliasG{Float64}` (after `const AliasG{T} = Vector{T}`) was mis-detected by
`extract_type_alias_from_binding` as a NEW static alias whose target was the
verbatim RHS text, so `z` printed the frozen string `AliasG{Float64}` instead
of `Vector{Float64}` (upstream: plain assignment of a type value). Fix in
lowering: (a) for a bare-identifier LHS the stored target is alias-expanded
(`type_alias::expand`) so an application of a registered static alias freezes
the RESOLVED type — the compile-time consumer `resolve_visible_type_alias`
resolves exactly one level; (b) a new thread-local runtime-type-binding set
(`type_alias::register_runtime_type_binding` / `is_runtime_type_binding`,
covered by `clear`/`snapshot`/`restore`) records names bound at runtime to
`UnionAll` values (`where`-clause parametric aliases from Issue #10372 and
bare where-RHS bindings); when the RHS base of a bare-identifier binding is
such a name, extraction declines and the statement lowers as an ordinary
runtime assignment that applies the `UnionAll` at runtime. Legitimate alias
definitions (`const IntVec = Vector{Int}`, user-struct applications like
`const IntWrapper = Wrapper{Int64}`) keep registering for annotation/dispatch
use. Fixture: `types/alias_application_assignment_10501.jl` (const/plain/where
alias forms, const-of-application, chained assignment, regression guards).
