  で、exec ループの `match` ディスパッチを関数ポインタテーブル
  (discriminant→行番号 match + 122 hot 行 + fallback 行、両経路とも同一の
  `execute_*` group handler を呼ぶためセマンティクスは乖離不能)に差し替え。
  デフォルトビルドはコード自体を含まずディスパッチループは不変。
- 3 ターゲット計測(host / iOS Simulator / Wasm、#8559 と同一ハーネスパターン
  + per-iteration call でインタプリタに留まる `calc_pi_call` を追加):

  executable-block 支配のループ(calc_pi/lorenz)は両者同着。
- **判定: DROP**(`match` 維持)。決定的カウンタは 3 ターゲット完全一致、

### Inference work-budget re-evaluation with attributable widening ✅ (Issue #8546)

- Added opt-in `compile::budget_metrics` counters
  (`SJULIA_INFER_BUDGET_METRICS=1` / forced override; one relaxed atomic load
  per site when off) that attribute every widen-to-`Top`/cutoff event to its
  trigger: work budget, depth limit, loop/recursive/block fixpoint
  exhaustion, union-split bailout, or genuine lattice join to `Top`.
- Measurement harness (`budget_metrics_8546` `--lib` tests; dumps are
  `#[ignore]`d, run with `--run-ignored all --no-capture`) compiles Base
  prelude / `using Optim` / `using Plots` / `using Symbolics` from source
  with the persistent Base cache disabled; the `sjulia` CLI also reports the
  counters when the env gate is set.
- True before/after vs the pre-#8601/#8689 baseline (`45b3072c0`): zero
  budget-exhaustion widenings on every workload both sides; loop fixpoints
  converge in ≤ 3/10 iterations, recursive in ≤ 2/4, peak root work 693 vs
  the 2M cap; only `MAX_METHOD_UNION_SPLIT_VARIANTS` binds (261 → 287
  bailouts, upstream parity). **Decision: keep all budget values** —
  numbers and rationale in `docs/vm/INFERENCE_BUDGETS.md`.

### HCubature/QuadGK non-Float64 endpoints ✅ (Issue #8541)

- Fixed the bundled QuadGK `Float32` 7-point rule cache so
  `cachedrule(Float32, 7)` returns `Vector{Float32}` nodes/weights instead of
  taking the generated cache path that exposed `#undef`.
- Fixed HCubature's one-dimensional evaluator to use the floated endpoint
  scalar type, preserving integer endpoint promotion while supporting
  `Float32`/`BigFloat`, and filled the BigFloat support gaps needed by bundled
  HCubature: `float(BigFloat)`, BigFloat `sqrt`, boxed BigFloat assignment,
  and typed `SVector` copying.
- Added package fixture coverage for `Float32` hquadrature and BigFloat 3-D
  cubature. BigFloat performance is intentionally left to Issue #8603.

### BigFloat tiny positive zero-boundary comparisons ✅ (Issue #8604)

- Normalized BigFloat comparison against zero when either operand is zero,
  avoiding the `astro_float` rhs-zero ordering pitfall for tiny positive
  values.
- Added a BigFloat fixture covering tiny positive/negative comparisons around
  `big"0.0"` in both operand orders. Follow-up prevention coverage is tracked
  by Issue #8607.

  アクセサ/limit_type_size 境界を固定。#8185 予算ガード

  テーブル) は互換シムとして維持。撤去は親 #8437 スライスの後続作業。

### Fused Int64 global-slot reads inside typed functions ✅ (Issue #8598)

- Fixed the `LoadAddI64` / `LoadSubI64` / `LoadMulI64` / `LoadModI64`
  fused name op handlers so they use the same slot-aware current/global lookup
  as `LoadI64`. Module-level globals that were slotized at frame 0 now remain
  visible from `function f(x::Int64)` bodies after peephole fusion.
- Added `scope_fused_i64_global_slot_8598` covering `x + K`, `x - K`,
  `x * K`, `x % K`, and `const` global reads from `Int64`-typed methods.

### Partial-return if inference joins implicit tail ✅ (Issue #8600)

- Fixed the abstract interpreter's non-final `Stmt::If` return channel so an
  `if` with only partial explicit returns reports `MaybeReturn`, not an
  unconditional `Return`. The enclosing block now joins later implicit tail
  values into `Base.infer_return_type`, preventing typed return routing from
  coercing a reachable `"s"` tail through an inferred `Int64` result.
- Added `type_inference_partial_return_if_implicit_tail_8600`, including a
  both-arms-return guard to keep unconditional `if` returns precise.

### Parametric default-constructor reflection re-inference ✅ (Issue #8638)

- Fixed `Base.infer_return_type` for fully typed methods whose return expression
  is a parametric default constructor. Reflection now lets specializable bodies
  bypass the typed-parameter snapshot gate and re-run body inference, and the
  bytecode fallback also recognizes concrete `NewStruct(...); ReturnAny`
  tails. This recovers returns such as `PW9_8638{Float64}` instead of a stale
  `Any`.
- Added `reflection_parametric_default_ctor_reflection_8638` covering the typed
  method, the untyped control method, and a post-execution re-query.

### Register VM vs stack VM cross-target measurement matrix ✅ (Issue #8559)
### Per-call-site inline caches for dynamic dispatch ✅ (Issue #8561)

- `CallTypedDispatch` / `CallTypedDispatchOrBuiltin*` ファミリに per-call-site
  インラインキャッシュを追加(従来は毎実行フル解決)。キャッシュは命令アドレスを
  添字とするメモリ内サイドテーブル `Vec<CallSiteCache>`(シリアライズされた
  `Instr` レイアウト不変 = bincode キャッシュ/#8444 fingerprint 影響なし)で、
  既存の #6345 exact-scalar フィンガープリント(I8..I128/U8..U128/F16/F32/F64/
  BigInt/BigFloat/Bool/Str/Char/Nothing/Missing/Symbol/Regex/RegexMatch のみ。
  parametric struct・`Type{T}` シングルトン・関数値・コンテナ・タプルは
  タグ化不能 = 常にミスで除外)をキーに 2-way LRU で
  `(type_tags, resolved_target)` を保持。混在 `Int64`/`Float64` 配列上の
  ホットループでも thrash しない。
- **無効化 (正しさの要)**: `Vm::dispatch_generation` 世代カウンタを追加し、
  ランタイムのメソッドテーブル変異(`activate_eval_function` = eval 時の
  メソッド定義/再定義)で `note_method_table_mutation` が bump + 既存
  HashMap 系ディスパッチキャッシュを一括クリア。各エントリは充填時世代を持ち、
  世代不一致はミス。`clear_runtime_caches` (#8453) も世代を bump。#8555 の
  `refresh_cached_base_dispatch_candidates` は Vm 構築(=スロット確保)前の
  コンパイル時に走るため、refresh 前の候補リスト由来エントリは構造上存在しない。
  エッジ単位の精密 flush は #8553/#8554 の backedge graph に委ねる(コメント済)。
- 計測: #8559 の opt-in `StackVmMetrics` に `dispatch_inline_cache_hits/misses`
  を追加。`bin/dispatch_inline_cache_bench_8561`(release, 400k 動的呼び出し):
  monomorphic site hit 率 100.000% (399999/400000)、mixed 2-type site 99.999%。
  wall 中央値 mono 497ms → cache-off 913ms、mixed 510ms → 942ms(約 1.84 倍)。
  A/B 用オフスイッチ `SJULIA_DISPATCH_INLINE_CACHE_OFF=1` /
  `set_call_site_inline_cache_disabled`(#8558/#8559 のゲートパターン踏襲)。
- テスト: `--lib` (2-way LRU / 世代失効 / `activate_eval_function` 無効化 /
  `clear_runtime_caches` 無効化)、`tests/dispatch_inline_cache_8561_tests.rs`
  (monomorphic hit 率・決定的カウンタ・mixed 2-way・**warm-up 後の @eval
  再定義が新挙動を観測**)、fixture
  `dispatch/eval_method_redefinition_after_warmup_8561.jl`(upstream Julia
  パリティ 5/5)。

- #8448/#8558 のレジスタ VM プロトタイプに対し、host / iOS Simulator
  (`aarch64-apple-ios-sim`, `simctl spawn`) / Wasm (`wasm32-unknown-unknown`,

### Flow-sensitive isa/=== narrowing across blocks and function boundaries ✅ (Issue #8545)

- 早期リターン narrowing (intra-procedural): 一方の腕が必ず終了する
  (`return`/`throw`/`break`/`continue`) 分岐の合流点では、両腕の join では
  なく生き残った腕の環境をそのまま維持する (upstream `Conditional` の
  早期リターン挙動)。構造的終了判定 `block_always_terminates` は
  `StmtResult::Return`(部分リターンでも発火する) と独立で、ネストした
  片腕 `if` を誤って終了扱いしない。文位置の短絡ガード
  (`isnothing(x) && return 0`, `cond || return v`, `cond && throw(...)`)
  は否定条件を fall-through 環境へ適用し、ガードされた `return` 値を
  `StmtResult::MaybeReturn` として返却型に合流させる。
  `f(x::Union{Int,Nothing}) = (isnothing(x) && return 0; x + 1)` が
  `Base.infer_return_type` で `Int64` を返し、ガードの連鎖 (≥2 ブロック) や
  外側分岐内のネストしたガードでも narrowing が生存する。
- InterConditional (inter-procedural): 単一引数の述語呼び出しの本体を
  呼び出し元フレームへ書き換える既存機構 (upstream
  `InterConditional`/`from_interconditional` 相当) を一般化 —
  `&&`/`||`/`!` 合成本体 (非 narrowing 葉は中立プレースホルダ化)、他述語への
  委譲 (`isnil(x) = isnothing(x)`) を `MAX_PREDICATE_INLINE_DEPTH`(=3) で
  有界に再帰解決。書き換えは純構文的で callee 再推論を伴わないため #8185
  作業予算とは独立に有界。`LatticeType` 自体は不変更 (キャッシュスキーマ
  影響なし)。fixtures: `type_inference/early_return_narrowing_8545.jl`,
  `type_inference/interconditional_predicate_8545.jl` (upstream julia
  パリティ確認済み)。
### SSA IR → スタックバイトコード lowering (`SJULIA_SSA_PIPELINE=1` ゲート) ✅ (Issue #8552)

- `compile/ssa_ir/lower.rs`: 最適化済み `SsaFunction` を既存スタック VM
  バイトコードへ lowering する最初の SSA バックエンド。ブロックスケジューリング
  /phi 配置/値のマテリアライズは lower.rs 側、命令選択は既存 `CoreCompiler`
  エミッタへ委譲(新 `Instr` 追加なし、slotize/peephole は従来どおり後段)。
  スタック形状の定義は式ツリーへ再構成(逐次コードは legacy と同一バイトコード)、
  それ以外は `#ssaN` 合成ローカルへスピルし `vm/slot.rs` がスロット割当。
  Phi は入辺でのスロット書き込み(Branch 辺はトランポリン、干渉並行コピーは
  `#ssatmpN` 2 ラウンド)。
- ゲート ON 時のみ、user スコープ関数が Core IR → SSA build → opt パス →
  lowering を通る(Base/prelude は常に legacy = Base キャッシュ不変)。
  `SsaBuildError`・opaque barrier・捕捉変数・kwparams・maybe-undef phi・
  ローカル束縛名経由の呼び出し・モジュール値グローバル・eager 化した
  `&&`/`||` 右辺などは**関数単位で無エミッション fallback**
  (`SJULIA_SSA_PIPELINE_LOG=1` で理由をログ、`take_ssa_pipeline_stats()`
  でカウンタ取得)。ゲート OFF は env チェック 1 回のみ。
- 往復パリティハーネス `tests/ssa_pipeline_parity_8552_tests.rs`: 直線/
  if-else phi/while phi/break・continue/三項/短絡/暗黙 return 変換/再帰/
  グローバル読みの各形状と、`const_prop`・`closures`・`dispatch` 3 カテゴリ
  全 fixture を両経路で実行し、最終値・出力・エラー文字列を diff。
  デフォルト反転の go/no-go 基準は `docs/vm/SSA_IR.md` に記載。
- 発見した既存バグ: `f(x::Int64)` 型注釈付きパラメータ + モジュールレベル
  グローバル読みが legacy 経路で `UndefVarError`(Issue #8598、untyped/
  Int32/Float64 は正常)。
### Base-cache-disable fallback retired for promote_rule / iterator traits ✅ (Issue #8555)

- ユーザープログラムが `promote_rule` を拡張しても Base キャッシュ全体を
  無効化（フル再コンパイル）しなくなった (#4048 の bypass を退役、#8442
  slice 3/3 の promote_rule スライス)。根因はキャッシュ済み Base バイトコード
  内の `CallTypedDispatch` 系命令に焼き込まれた候補メソッド index リストが
  コンパイル時凍結であること。マージ後に
  `pipeline_ctx::refresh_cached_base_dispatch_candidates` が Base セグメントの
  該当呼び出しサイト（`CallTypedDispatch`, `CallTypedDispatchOrBuiltin*`,
  `PushResolvedFunction`）へユーザーメソッドの global index を追記し、フル
  コンパイルの emitter が焼き込む内容（arity フィルタ + テーブル順）を再現する。
- 安全ゲート: ユーザーメソッドの各スロットが「プログラムローカル型
  （Base prelude が見たことのない型）を必ず要求する」場合のみキャッシュ路。
  Base 既知型ペアを乗っ取れるメソッド（type piracy / 素の TypeVar のみ）は
  Base バイトコード内の静的 promotion fold を汚染しうるため従来通り bypass
  (`program_extends_promotion_rules_over_base_types`)。
- 回帰: `tests/promote_rule_cached_base_8555_tests.rs`（キャッシュ路の
  semantics = フルコンパイル路 = upstream、`is_cache_initialized()` による
  「ロードされ bypass しなかった」テレメトリ、warm-cache チャンクシナリオ、
  後続コンパイルへの候補リーク無し、piracy は bypass 維持）、fixture
  `promotion/user_promote_rule_cached_dispatch_8555.jl`（julia 1.12 パリティ）。
- IteratorEltype/IteratorSize (#4088) も同スライスで退役: hook セットに
  `IteratorEltype`/`IteratorSize`/`eltype` を追加（`eltype` は cached
  `_collect` の要素型決定に必須 — 無いと SizeUnknown+HasEltype collect が
  `Vector{Any}` に退化する）。value-form trait メソッド
  （`IteratorSize(::MyIter)`）は名前を持たない `CallDynamic` /
  `CallDynamicOrBuiltin` サイト経由なので、fallback/候補 index の
  `FunctionInfo` 名から generic 関数を復元して候補を追記する。
  SizeUnknown/HasShape{2}/value-form の collect パリティを
  fixture `iteration/user_iterator_traits_cached_dispatch_8555.jl` と
  integration test で固定。
- コールドスタート実測（embedded-cache release バイナリ, mean of 5, 中立
  プログラムの床 ~83ms）: promote_rule 拡張 1238ms → 85ms、iterator-trait
  拡張 1226ms → 86ms（~14x）。piracy プログラムは bypass のまま ~1.2s
  （正しさ優先）。
- keys/values/pairs (#4671) の disable は後続スライスとして継続
  （`BASE_DISPATCH_REFRESH_HOOKS` に追加していく）— follow-up Issue #8602。

### Precise transitive invalidation via backedge traversal ✅ (Issue #8554)

- Method/binding mutations now consume the #8553 precise backedge graph:
  directly affected specializations are seeded by signature-intersection +
  dispatch-winner tests on recorded call edges (`CoreType::type_intersect`
  over a trusted core fragment; every uncertainty over-invalidates) and by
  `binding → readers` edges, then closed transitively over the reverse call
  graph with a cycle-safe worklist (`BackedgeIndex::transitively_affected`),
  capping `max_world` of exactly the reached entries — upstream
  `reinfer.jl`/`bindinginvalidations.jl` semantics.
- Cache entries not covered by the precise graph (persisted Base-cache
  seeds, declared-return-type fast-path commits, first-definition names that
  recording skipped) keep the conservative name/edge scan, and
  `SJULIA_INVALIDATION=broad` restores the pre-#8554 behavior wholesale for
  differential testing. Per-mutation telemetry (`InvalidationTelemetry`)
  counts broad-affected/invalidated/precise-survivor entries; tests assert
  unrelated cached functions survive, precise ⊆ broad on the trusted corpus,
  and strategy-independent re-inference.
- The parametric inner-constructor body walk now attributes its precise
  edges to the enclosing specialization so covered callers stay transitively
  complete in the graph.

### Reflection builtins decoupled from the compile-time InferenceEngine ✅ (Issue #8556)

- `vm/builtins_reflection` no longer names `compile::abstract_interp`: the
  exception-classification contract (`BaseCalleeExceptionClassifier`,
  `ExceptionType`, `TypeEnv`) is re-exported through the `runtime_types`
  facade, and engine construction/seeding goes through the new narrow
  `ReflectionInferenceSession` trait
  (`runtime_types::build_reflection_inference_session`) instead of the
  concrete `InferenceEngine` handle.
- Ratcheted `scripts/audit_compile_vm_coupling.sh` from `vm_to_compile = 13`
  to `10`; reflection output unchanged (`reflection::` fixtures green) and
  iOS/Wasm cross-target checks still pass.

### Typed varargs diagonal specificity ✅ (Issue #8565)

- Preserved typed-vararg annotations from splat-shaped CST nodes and made
  method-table dedup vararg-aware so `f(xs::T...) where T` is not collapsed into
  `f(xs...)`. Compile-time CoreType dispatch, runtime value dispatch, and
  reflection-side method sorting now prefer the diagonal typed vararg for
  homogeneous tuples, including `f()`.
- Removed the #8565 dispatch parity allowlist entries and added a dispatch
  fixture for homogeneous typed-vararg selection, fixed-arity override,
  zero-argument selection, and heterogeneous fallback.

### Keyword forwarding fallback dispatch ✅ (Issue #8566)

- Keyworded method-table calls now use runtime keyword dispatch when the
  positional winner cannot definitely accept the call-site keywords but an
  arity-compatible keyword method may. This makes `g(1; opt=1)` select
  `g(xs...; kws...)` over the positional-only `g(x::Int)` method, while
  declared keyword methods and no-fallback MethodError behavior remain intact.
- Added kwargs fixture coverage for unqualified, declared-keyword, numeric
  fallback, module-qualified, and no-keyword-method cases, and removed the
  #8566 dispatch parity allowlist entry.

### Tuple-wrapped invariant Union params ✅ (Issue #8582)

- Changed the CoreType binding-aware matcher so invariant-position `Union`
  patterns compare against the whole union type with mutual subtyping instead
  of accepting any single union member.
- Added subtype parity and `types` fixture coverage for the `Type{...}` and
  `Vector{...}` MWE from #8582, including exact-Union positive guards.
### Register VM prototype runs real fixtures behind a gate ✅ (Issue #8558)

- `subset_julia_vm::register_vm` now lowers real compiled function bodies to
  the in-memory register form: jumps and fused compare-and-branch families,
  typed I64/F64/Any slot loads/stores (including the loop superinstructions),
  I64/F64 arithmetic, comparisons, conversions, and returns. Registers are
  operand-stack depths, so the register count is computed statically per
  function; translation stays total-or-explicit (`Err` names the first
  unsupported instruction).
- Calls trampoline into the stack VM (`RegisterVmHost`): a regular frame plus
  `run_until_frame_return`, reusing the `eval_dispatch_call` nested-dispatch
  discipline (ancestor-handler floor #5972, error unwinding #7687). Nesting is
  capped at 64 with graceful stack VM fallback for deeper recursion.
- `SJULIA_REGISTER_VM=1` gates eligible direct calls onto the register VM with
  per-function memoized translations; `SJULIA_REGISTER_VM_LOG=1` logs the path
  per function. Default execution is untouched (one `Option` check).
- Parity harness `register_vm_parity_8558_tests` runs `fib(20)` recursion,
  `calc_pi` while/for loops, and a 500-deep recursion through the gate off/on
  with identical output (pinned against upstream Julia) and records
  `RegisterVmMetrics`; numbers live in `docs/vm/REGISTER_VM.md` for #8559.

### Reflection keyword-value effect composition ✅ (Issue #8441)

- Reflection-side callee arity collection now recurses into keyword argument
  values for direct `Expr::Call`, matching module-qualified call traversal.
- Body-derived effect propagation now composes `Expr::LetBlock` binding and body
  effects, covering the inline-expanded keyword value shape used by reflection.
- Whole-program call graph extraction now records calls inside `LetBlock`
  bindings and bodies, so callers are requeued when those callees refine.
- `_compose_effects` can prove direct keyword-value wrappers total without
  depending on fixed name-table hints, shrinking another fallback path.
- Added RED/GREEN unit regressions for direct-call keyword values and `LetBlock`
  composition plus a reflection fixture for the public `Base.infer_effects`
  surface.

### Bounded parametric dispatch rejects out-of-bound bindings ✅ (Issue #8567)

- Tightened the shared JuliaType/CoreType dispatch matchers so same-family
  parametric candidates that mention `where` variables do not survive a failed
  binding extraction when a known upper bound decisively rejects the binding.
  The concrete regression is
  `h(::Box{T}) where T<:Real` no longer matching `Box{String}` over
  `h(::Box)`.
- Removed `allow_mismatch = 8567` from the dispatch parity corpus case
  `struct_box_unconstrained`, making the upstream-compatible result mandatory
  for both compile-time direct calls and runtime closure-wrapped calls.

### Eval dispatch dev-stack guard ✅ (Issue #8572)

- Lowered `Vm::MAX_EVAL_DISPATCH_DEPTH` from 96 to 4. The previous bound was
  safe in release but still allowed dev-profile eval self-recursion to consume
  enough native Rust stack to SIGABRT before returning the intended VM
  `Stack overflow` error.
- Kept the guard on the existing `enter_eval_dispatch` / `exit_eval_dispatch`
  path, so successful bounded eval dispatch still works and runaway recursion
  fails through the VM error channel.
- Updated `PANIC_FREE.md` to record that native-stack-safe builtin re-entry
  bounds must account for unoptimized dev-profile frames.

### Benchmark warmup launch discard ✅ (Issue #8577)

- Added `WARMUP_RUNS` (default `1`) to the top-level reproducible benchmark
  runner and VM-only calc-pi/Mandelbrot scripts. Warmup launches are measured
  into separate files for inspection but excluded from raw timed series and
  min/median/average summaries.
- Updated the legacy AoT benchmark suite so Julia, sjulia, and generated AoT
  binaries use the shared `RUNS` / `WARMUP_RUNS` controls; generated AoT
  binaries now get a discarded warm-up launch before the measured loop.
- Documented the default warmup behavior in `benchmarks/README.md` so short
  wall-time comparisons use retained min/median/average samples instead of the
  macOS first-launch CPU warm-up outlier.
### SSA 最適化パス: 定数畳み込み・DCE・純粋呼び出し CSE ✅ (Issue #8551)

- `compile/ssa_ir/opt.rs` に #8550 の恒久 SSA モデル上の最初の最適化パスを追加:
  `fold_constants` (共有 `const_prop` 評価器による定数畳み込み + trivial/定数
  Phi 畳み込み + 定数 Bool 分岐の Jump 化)、`eliminate_unreachable_blocks` /
  `eliminate_dead_defs` (到達不能ブロック削除と liveness mark & sweep DCE —
  #8550 の未刈り込みループヘッダ Phi のデッドサイクルも回収)、`cse_pure_calls`
  (支配木 DFS スコープの値番号付け)。
- 削除は `Effects::is_removable` (:effect_free + :nothrow + terminates)、CSE は
  `Effects::is_foldable` (:consistent 必須 — fresh allocation を除外, #7176) で
  ゲート。呼び出し純粋性は #8441 の body-derived summary
  (`infer_program_effects`) を使用し、パラメータ名経由 (HOF) やネスト定義で
  シャドウされる callee 名は arbitrary 扱い。
- 支配木計算は `verify.rs` から `dom.rs` に括り出して検証器とパスで共有。
  エントリポイント (`ssa_ir::optimize` / `optimize_with_effects`) はテスト専用
  で、コンパイルパイプライン出力は不変 (lowering フリップは #8552)。`ir_opt`
  ブリッジ配線も不変。unit テスト 20 本追加 (合計 70)。ベンチ計測は SSA が
  パイプラインから到達可能になる #8552 で実施。
### Abstract-family subtyping derived from declared supertypes ✅ (Issue #8560)

- `struct_is_subtype_of_abstract_with_lookup` を「組み込み名テーブル
  (`builtin_struct_is_subtype_of_abstract`: VM ネイティブな Base 型名の
  array/range/Dict/Set/IOBuffer/`typeof(f)`/Core.Builtin)」と「宣言由来の導出
  (`declared_struct_is_subtype_of_abstract`: 登録済み `<:` 親チェーンの nominal
  walk、rank を持つ array 対象は parameter 代入付き instantiated walk)」に分離。
  ユーザ/バンドルパッケージの `struct S <: AbstractSet / AbstractRange /
  AbstractUnitRange / Function (functor) / IO / AbstractString / AbstractChar`
  が upstream と同じく `<:`/`isa` で解決 (Base 自身の `KeySet <: AbstractSet`,
  `Fix1 <: Function` 含む)。
- compile-time 選択も同じ導出に統一: `builtin_abstract_param_name` に
  AbstractString/AbstractChar/AbstractRange/Function/IO を追加、呼び出し側の
  引数 coercion は `JuliaType::is_abstract_with_struct_subtypes()` な抽象注釈で
  as-is コンパイル (`Cannot convert Struct to IO` を解消)。
- 検証: `parity_subtype.rs` corpus を 23 ケース拡張、fixture
  `abstract/builtin_family_declared_subtyping_8560.jl` (29 assert、
  `fixture_julia_parity.sh` で upstream julia 1.12.6 と一致)。生き残る
  hard-coded root は組み込み Base 型の名前テーブルと `Core.Builtin`
  (#5129: 宣言で builtin は作れない) のみで、理由コメント付き。
### CoreType-native typemap candidate filter owns dispatch filtering ✅ (Issue #8548)

- `inference_core/dispatch_resolver.rs` に `typemap_candidate_verdict` を追加:
  上流 `findall` 相当の候補判定を、arity 展開した正準
  `Tuple{...}`/`UnionAll` シグネチャに対する共有 `CoreType` サブタイプ関係で行う。
  精密な呼び出しタプル (`core_type_is_dispatch_precise`) は
  `Accept`/`Reject` を確定判定し、不精密タプル (`Any`/抽象型/`DataType`
  型オブジェクト/bare parametric/`Bool` 配列タグ曖昧性 #6663) は
  `DeferImprecise`、エンジン未対応シグネチャ形状 (ネスト `where` 変数・匿名
  `{<:X}` 束縛・下限/変数依存束縛・値パラメータ付き抽象 #7960・bare
  配列族・非トップレベル `Union` #8582) は `DeferSignature` として従来の
  scoring matcher に委譲する。
- `MethodTable::dispatch_inner` のステージ1候補選別を typemap フィルタに
  フリップ (scoring はランキング専用に降格)。`SJULIA_DISPATCH_COMPARE=1`
  デバッグ比較モードが両フィルタの候補集合と最終選択の差分を stderr に
  出力する。フリップ根拠: dispatch/closures + 15 カテゴリ (673 fixture) の
  スイープで selection-diff 0 件 (candidate-diff は upstream 不変性に照らし
  typemap 側が正しい 1 件のみ)、dispatch parity harness green、Base
  コンパイル差分 0。
- 比較モードで発見したエンジンの不変位置 `Union` バグを #8582 として起票
  (`Tuple{Type{Int64}} <: Tuple{Type{Union{Nothing, Int64}}}` が誤って
  true)。scoring 定数の削除は後続スライス。オーバーレイ・メソッドテーブルの
  設計ノートを `docs/vm/BINARY_DISPATCH.md` に追加。

### Dispatch parity harness vs upstream Julia ✅ (Issue #8547)

- Added `subset_julia_vm/tests/parity_dispatch.rs` + corpus
  `tests/fixtures/dispatch_parity/corpus.toml`: marker-returning method tables
  (diagonal/bounded `where`, typed varargs, kw-forwarding fallbacks, `Type{T}`,
  `Union`, ambiguity, parametric structs, no-method) run under both upstream
  `julia` (per-group sandbox process; skips cleanly without julia) and sjulia's
  compile-time (`#static` direct call) + runtime (`#dynamic` closure) paths.
- Mismatches fail unless allowlisted with an issue number; found and filed
  #8565 (typed-varargs diagonal), #8566 (kwcall forwarding fallback),
  #8567 (parametric upper bound not enforced).
### Bottom placeholder MethodSig confined to tests; production signatures total ✅ (Issue #8549)

- Added a `SignatureDefect` classification (`BottomPlaceholder` / `NonTupleBody` /
  `ArgCountSkew`) as the single availability gate behind the structured-signature
  accessors, closing the zero-parameter placeholder hole in the length-equality check.
- `MethodSig` deserialization now rejects wire payloads carrying a defective canonical
  signature (fail loudly, cache rebuilds from source); `add_method` /
  `from_julia_projections` carry debug totality assertions.
- New `--lib` gate `base_and_prelude_method_tables_have_total_signatures_issue_8549`
  pins zero Bottom/skewed signatures across the compiled Base+prelude corpus, plus
  one unit test per defect reason and serde rejection tests.
### Durable SSA IR model + Core IR → SSA conversion ✅ (Issue #8550)

- `compile/ssa_ir/` に恒久 SSA モデル (`SsaFunction`/`SsaBlock`/`SsaValue`/
  `PhiNode`/`Terminator`) と構造化制御フロー限定の Core IR → SSA 変換
  (`build_function`)、SSA 検証器 (`verify`: def-dominates-use / phi arity /
  edge 整合) を追加。直線コード・if/else・ネスト if・while (break/continue)・
  三項演算子・再代入で phi 配置をユニットテスト検証。
- try/catch や for などは opaque barrier (reads + BarrierReload) として保持。
  この slice はパイプライン出力を変えない (lowering は #8552、passes は #8551)。
  設計と制限は `docs/vm/SSA_IR.md` に記載。
### Precise inference backedges with stable specialization identity ✅ (Issue #8553)

- Added `engine/backedges.rs`: `MethodKey` (definition-derived method identity —
  name + canonical `CoreType` signature + vararg shape, never table insertion
  order) and `SpecializationKey` (≈ upstream `MethodInstance`), plus a
  `BackedgeIndex` recording `caller specialization → (callee method, call
  argtypes)` for direct, module-qualified, and attempted-static dynamic-fallback
  call edges, global-binding read edges, reverse name/binding indexes, and
  per-specialization `WorldRange` stamps.
- Record-only slice building on PR #8526: invalidation behavior is unchanged
  (#8554 consumes the graph); the index is in-memory only (no cache wire-format
  impact). Debug accessor `InferenceEngine::backedge_index_dump()` plus 12
  `--lib` regressions assert the recorded edges.

### Body-derived effect call graph coverage ✅ (Issue #8441)

- Extended whole-program effect propagation's call graph extraction to include
  `Expr::ModuleCall` callees, matching the body walker used to compose their
  effects.
- Added keyword argument value expressions to the call graph so fixpoint
  propagation revisits callers when a callee referenced only from a keyword
  value is refined.
- Added unit regressions for both cases with caller-before-callee ordering,
  proving the new graph edges are what trigger recomputation.
### Value type parameters as call arguments / range endpoints ✅ (Issue #8539)

- Where-clause integer value parameters (`N` in `SVector{N,T}`/`P{N,T}`) now
  compile in call-argument position (`fill(1, N)`, dims of
  `Vector{T}(undef, N)`) and range-endpoint position (`for i in 1:N`,
  `collect(2:N)`); previously the former hit a compile-emitted
  `MethodError (::Int64, ::DataType)` and the latter failed with
  `Cannot convert DataType to I64`.
- Static-dispatch misses with bare type-parameter-variable arguments now fall
  back to runtime typed dispatch (`has_value_type_param_arg` alongside
  `has_any_arg` in the `NoMethodFound` arms), and coercion accepts
  `DataType -> I64` through `DynamicToI64`.
- Retired the HCubature W-51 `length(a)` workaround; added fixture
  `types_value_type_param_positions_8539`.

### Bare parametric-struct argument defers value-parameter dispatch ✅ (Issue #8537)

- An inline-constructed parametric struct value is typed at compile time only by
  its bare family name (`SVector(1.0, 2.0)` → `Struct("SVector")`), so its value
  type parameters (`N` in `SVector{N,T}`) are unknown until runtime. Such an
  argument now defers to runtime dispatch whenever the method table holds a
  sibling method that pins a concrete value parameter for that family
  (`bare_parametric_struct_arg_has_value_param_sibling` → `CallDynamic` in
  `compile_generic_dispatch_call`).
- Fixes the reported StaticArrays mis-dispatch (`g(SVector(1.0,2.0))` returned
  `:zero` from `g(::SVector{0,T})` instead of `:generic`) and the analogous
  plain-factory-struct `MethodError`; real `SVector{0}` / `SVector{1}` values
  still select their concrete methods. Fixture:
  `dispatch_bare_parametric_value_param_dispatch_8537`.

### Shared promotion boundary extraction ✅ (Issue #8449)

- Moved the type-promotion registry and `promote_type` helpers from
  `compile::promotion` to the shared root `promotion` module.
- Kept `compile::promotion` as a compatibility re-export for existing compiler
  call sites while VM reflection now imports promotion through `crate::promotion`.
- Removed one direct VM runtime dependency on `crate::compile` and lowered the
  `vm_to_compile` audit ratchet from 14 to 13.

### VM-owned peephole optimizer ✅ (Issue #8449)

- Moved the stack-VM peephole optimizer from `compile::peephole` to
  `vm::peephole`.
- The main compile pipeline and runtime-specialized method installation now use
  the same VM-owned bytecode optimizer entry point.
- Removed the specialized runtime call to `crate::compile::peephole::optimize`
  and lowered the `vm_to_compile` audit ratchet from 15 to 14.

### typed scalar instruction table moved out of compiler paths ✅ (Issue #8449)

- Moved `typed_scalar_binary_instr` from `compile::expr::binary` into the
  bytecode boundary; it now lives in `subset_julia_vm_bytecode` with the VM
  path kept as a compatibility re-export.
- The main compiler now uses the shared instruction-selection table through its
  existing `typed_instr_for_intrinsic` adapter, while runtime specialization no
  longer imports it through `crate::compile`.
- Lowered the `vm_to_compile` audit ratchet from 17 to 15.

### Runtime constant boundary extraction ✅ (Issue #8449)

- Moved `float_special_constant_value` out of `compile::constants` into the
  shared `runtime_constants` module so compile-time lowering and VM runtime
  keyword-default evaluation use one non-compiler-owned helper.
- Removed the VM runtime call to `crate::compile::float_special_constant_value`
  from `vm/exec/call.rs`.
- Lowered the compile/VM coupling audit ratchets to `compile_to_vm=128` and
  `vm_to_compile=17`.
### HCubature generic n-dimensional cubature ✅ (Issue #8524)

- Replaced the 1-D/2-D-specialized HCubature shim with upstream HCubature.jl's
  generic n-dimensional structure: `combos`/`signcombos` build Genz-Malik
  points for any `n >= 2` (Combinatorics + gray-code sign flips), `GenzMalik`
  stores the dimension, and the adaptive subdivision, `initdiv` odometer, and
  endpoint `SVector{n,F}` conversion are dimension-generic.
- New fixture `packages_hcubature_ndim_8524` (3-D Gaussian issue MWE, 3-D/5-D
  separable cosines, 4-D polynomial, vector/integer endpoints, `initdiv=2`,
  buffer reuse, exact 3-D/7-D Genz-Malik evaluation counts 33/241) passes with
  matching values under sjulia and upstream julia; the existing smoke fixture
  stays green.
- Filed while porting: #8537 (0-d method captures first-time `SVector{N}`
  dispatch), #8539 (value parameter `N` unusable as call argument / range
  endpoint; W-51 workaround), #8541 (non-Float64 endpoints unsupported).

### Module-qualified reflection effect callees ✅ (Issue #8441)

- `Expr::ModuleCall` now participates in reflection effect callee collection
  and body-derived propagation, matching direct-call handling for effect
  summaries.
- Wrappers around `Base.min` / `Base.max` now infer the upstream total
  `Base.Effects` record without adding module-qualified helper names to the
  fixed Rust effect table.
- Added a reflection fixture covering module-qualified `Base.min` and
  `Base.max` wrappers over `Tuple{Int64,Int64}`.

### Compiler/VM coupling facade ratchet ✅ (Issues #8449/#8533)

- Restored `scripts/audit_compile_vm_coupling.sh` after `main` drifted to 23
  direct `vm -> compile` references against a stale baseline.
- Moved VM references to runtime-visible compiler metadata through the
  `runtime_types` facade for reflection, runtime type objects, and runtime
  compile context fields.
- Lowered the `vm_to_compile` audit baseline from 20 to 18 so future work must
  preserve or further reduce this boundary.

### `@assume_effects` optimizer eligibility ✅ (Issue #8441)

- `optimize_pure_expressions_user_only` now builds a user-function effect map
  from leading `Base.@assume_effects` metadata before running Core IR CSE/LICM.
- Safely pure/terminating annotations such as `:total` make repeated user
  function calls eligible for the same pure-call reuse path as built-in effect
  hints, including module-qualified user functions.
- Added a unit regression that proves repeated calls to an annotated user
  function are CSE'd, and added the first `effects` fixture category covering
  `Base.@assume_effects :total` runtime parity.

### Throwing `Base.:+` reflection effects ✅ (Issue #8441)

- Concrete reflection composition now uses method-table dispatch and direct
  `specializable_functions` indices, so user-defined `Base.:+` methods are
  walked instead of being masked by generic Base fallbacks.
- Base extension methods are registered for reflection body composition, and
  overloadable binary operators preserve concrete struct argument types when
  consulting the Base callee exception classifier.
- Added a reflection fixture where direct `Base.infer_effects(+)`, `+(a,b)`,
  and `a + b` all report `nothrow=false` for a throwing user-defined
  `Base.:+` method.

### Foldable callee-seeded reflection effects ✅ (Issue #8441)

- `_compose_effects` now seeds direct callee effect summaries from exact
  arity-matched `specializable_functions` entries before walking a matched user
  method body.
- This lets wrappers around pure Julia `min` / `max` infer the upstream total
  effect record without adding those helper names to the Rust fixed effect
  table.
- Added a reflection fixture covering `Base.infer_effects` for `min` and `max`
  wrappers over `Tuple{Int64,Int64}`.

## 最新対応 (2026-07-01)

### Reflection body-derived effect composition ✅ (Issue #8441)

- Added a reflection builtin that composes `Effects` from the matched user
  method body and returns the same field encoding used by `Base.Effects`.
- `Base.infer_effects(f, types)` now prefers that body-derived summary for
  walkable user methods, so visible side effects such as `println` no longer
  report as fully total/pure through the reflection surface.
- Verification: upstream Julia parity for the new fixture, direct sjulia RED /
  GREEN fixture run, `cargo check -p subset_julia_vm --features repl`, release
  `reflection::` fixture nextest, full release nextest, Wasm check, and iOS
  Simulator FFI build pass locally.

### Register VM iOS/Wasm decision record ✅ (Issue #8448)

- Added `docs/vm/REGISTER_VM.md` with the architectural decision for a
  side-by-side register VM backend targeted at iOS and WebAssembly.
- Kept the current stack VM as the default runtime and documented the prototype
  gate required before any default switch: host, iOS Simulator, and WebAssembly
  fixture parity plus bytecode-size, dispatch-count, VM-only timing, and frame
  memory measurements.
- Linked the register VM direction from `ARCHITECTURE_OVERVIEW.md` and the
  Issue #8440 SSA IR design note so future SSA lowering work has an explicit
  register-bytecode target.
- Added `subset_julia_vm::register_vm` as the first host-only prototype
  foundation. It lowers a small straight-line `Int64` stack-bytecode subset to
  register bytecode, runs it through a portable `match` interpreter, and reports
  bytecode-size/dispatch-count/register-frame metrics without touching the
  production stack VM.

### Method backedge index foundation ✅ (Issue #8442)

- Added `InferenceEngine::method_backedges`, a callee-to-cache-key index for
  method-table invalidation candidates.
- Cache insertion and seeding now stamp the index from each cached entry's
  function identity, conservative bare edges, and precise method edges.
- Method mutation invalidation now uses the index to enumerate candidates before
  applying the existing precise signature-match filter, and prunes expired keys
  from the graph after method or binding invalidation.
- Verification: RED/GREEN unit coverage for transitive backedge indexing, the
  full `cache_invalidation` unit filter, and full release nextest pass locally.

### SSA-shaped Phi fold bridge ✅ (Issue #8440)

- Added `docs/vm/SSA_IR.md` with the long-term SSA representation, lowering
  path, temporary bridge scope, and remaining work for the full Issue #8440
  migration.
- Added `compile::ssa_ir` and wired it after user-only Core IR CSE/LICM to fold
  identical literal assignments in both `if` branches into one joined
  assignment.
- Measured effect is pinned by `ssa_ir_8440_tests`: `same_branch_phi_8440`
  keeps only the initializer and one joined `StoreSlotI64` for `x`, instead of

- Verification: upstream Julia fixture parity, focused SSA/IR optimizer tests,
  the `ssa_ir_8440_tests` bytecode-shape test, and release `const_prop::`

### Parser default `::Type` argument in where signatures ✅ (Issue #8514)

  defaults (`::Type{T}=Float64`) instead of stopping at the `=`.

- Verification: upstream Julia fixture run, release `sjulia` fixture run,

### DataStructures BinaryMaxHeap public constructors ✅ (Issues #8509, #8516)

- Added the array-backed `BinaryMaxHeap` subset needed by HCubature adaptive
  boxes: empty heap construction, seeded vector construction, `push!`, `pop!`,

  be converted back to `SVector{N,T}` through both inferred and explicit
  constructors.
- Index-LHS broadcast assignment now lowers to `materialize!(view(...), rhs)`,
  so `v[c] .= lambda` with `c::Vector{Int64}` writes through to the parent array

  non-contiguous parent index mapping for linear load/store, covering

  supported in-place mutation behavior.

### Tuple equality for OneTo/UnitRange axes fixed ✅ (Issue #8478)

- Tuple `==` now compares inline `OneTo` struct snapshots and native
  `UnitRange` values by their logical range sequence, matching upstream for
  `(Base.OneTo(2),) == (1:2,)`.
- Regression coverage: focused equality unit test plus the existing
  `iteration_product` fixture axes assertions.

### Iterators.product vararg wrapper recursion fixed ✅ (Issue #8479)

- The embedded `Base.Iterators.product(args...)` wrapper now mirrors the Base
  vararg body by constructing `Base.ProductIterator(args)` directly instead of
  re-dispatching through `Base.product(args...)`.
- Regression coverage: `product([1,2], [10,20], [100,200])` construction and
  the existing `iteration_product` fixture.

### Dict getindex on statically typed Dict slots fixed ✅ (Issue #8480)

- Statically typed `Dict` indexing now emits the shared `IndexLoad` getindex
  path instead of the `get(dict, key[, default])` builtin trampoline.
- Regression coverage: `dict_getbang_writeback_5225` now preserves the
  `get!` counting loop result and subsequent `counts["l"]` access under the
  release fixture harness.

### Built-in irrational constants preserve singleton bindings ✅ (Issue #8481)

- Bare `pi`, `π`, and `ℯ` references now let the registered global const-struct
  bindings win before the legacy Float64 fallback.
- Regression coverage: `mathconstants_irrational_singletons_5133` now sees
  upstream-compatible `Irrational{:π}` / `Irrational{:ℯ}` identities while
  numeric conversions still produce the expected Float64/Float32 values.

### Testset-local varargs tuple slots accept dynamic values ✅ (Issue #8482)

- Tuple-typed slots now accept dynamically typed values without compile-time
  rejection, matching the existing boxed aggregate handling for structs and
  arrays.
- Regression coverage: `splat_tuple_literal_7741` now compiles a
  `@testset`-local `f(xs...) = (10, 20, xs...)` helper and verifies tuple
  splicing.

### Typed varargs fixture restored to upstream parity ✅ (Issue #8483)

- `varargs_typed.jl` no longer assumes `sum(()) == 0`; the empty-varargs
  computation path returns the leading argument before calling `sum`.
- Regression coverage: upstream Julia and sjulia both accept the corrected
  fixture shape while retaining the typed-varargs zero-argument `length` tests.

### Clippy all-targets Function literal build fixed ✅ (Issue #8468)

- Predicate-narrowing integration tests now set `is_runtime_eval: false` on
  their synthetic `Function` values, matching the new IR field introduced by
  the `@eval` world-age implementation.
- Verification: `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and
  `cargo nextest run --release --test issue_3710_predicate_narrowing`.

### `@eval` function world-age semantics ✅ (Issue #8452)

- `@eval f() = ...` inside a function now defines a global method in a newer
  world: the defining frame keeps the old method visibility, while subsequent
  top-level calls see the new method.
- Newly `@eval`-defined function names are bound globally, so
  `Base.invokelatest(h)` can call a method defined by `@eval h() = ...` after
  the older frame correctly raises `MethodError`.
- Regression fixture: `macros_eval_function_world_age_8452`.

### LinearAlgebra in-place factorization fixture parity fixed ✅ (Issues #8411, #8465)

- `linalg_factorization_inplace_values_7464` now returns `true` under upstream
  Julia and the `release-fast` fixture nextest harness.
- `cholesky!` and `isposdef!` now leave the attempted upper-Cholesky work state
  in the input matrix on the same failure path covered by Julia's
  `PosDefException(2)` behavior.
- Regression coverage: existing `linalg_factorization_inplace_values_7464`
  fixture plus the #8465 `cholesky!` / `isposdef!` MWE.

### Where lower/cross-bound static parameter parity fixed ✅ (Issue #8427)

- `where {T>:Int}` and `where {T<:Real,S<:T}` signatures now follow upstream
  Julia when static parameter bindings violate lower or cross-variable bounds:
  value-only method bodies still run, but reading the invalid static parameter
  raises `UndefVarError`.
- Regression fixture: `dispatch_where_bounds_upstream_applicability_8427`.
- Re-verified `dispatch::` fixtures and release lib tests.

### `DataType.name` TypeName identity ✅ (Issue #8451)

- `A.T.name === B.T.name` for same-named types in different modules now returns
  `false`, while `(Vector{Int}).name === (Vector{Float64}).name` returns `true`.
- `TypeName.name` projects the underlying symbol, so `Int.name.name === :Int64`
  works through the same runtime reflection value.
- Regression fixture: `reflection_datatype_name_typename_identity_8451`.

### Core type lattice parity regressions ✅ (Issue #8415)

- Fixed tuple/Array/value-parameter `typejoin`, diagonal tuple
  `typeintersect`, where lower/cross-bound dispatch, nested UnionAll subtype
  solving, and parenthesized UnionAll application parity with upstream Julia.
- Regression fixture: `types_coretype_parity_8415`.
- Re-verified `types_tests::` under release nextest.

### `sjulia -e` include path evaluation fixed ✅ (Issue #7766)

- `println(include("/tmp/file.jl"))` in `sjulia -e` now reaches Base runtime
  file evaluation and returns the included file's last expression value instead
  of failing during lowering with `UnsupportedFeature(IncludeCall(...))`.
- Regression test: `include_tests::test_eval_include_file_path_in_expression_position_7766`.

### Base.retry implemented ✅ (Issue #8371)

- `retry(() -> 42)()` now matches upstream, and retry wrappers support a
  delayed retry, `check=false`, and positional/keyword forwarding through the
  returned closure.
- Function-valued splat calls now fall back to dynamic callable dispatch when
  the callee is not statically known, fixing the captured `f(args...)` path
  needed by `retry` (Issue #8434).
- Regression fixtures: `retry_8371`, updated `hof/variadic_splat`.

### Nested `rethrow()` propagation fixed ✅ (Issue #8435)

- `try; try; error("x"); catch; rethrow(); end; catch; ... end` now reaches
  the outer catch with the original `ErrorException`, matching upstream Julia.
- `retry(f; check=...)` now uses upstream-style `rethrow()` for rejected retries
  instead of the retired W-50 `throw(err)` workaround.
- Regression fixtures: `exceptions_rethrow_nested_8435`, existing
  `exceptions/rethrow.jl`, and `retry_8371`.

### Partial SymTridiagonal constructor fixed ✅ (Issue #8393)

- `SymTridiagonal{Float64}(dv, ev)` now fixes the leading element type
  parameter and infers the vector-storage parameter from the constructor
  fields, matching upstream as
  `LinearAlgebra.SymTridiagonal{Float64, Vector{Float64}}`.
- Regression fixture: `linalg_symtridiagonal_partial_constructor_8393`.
- Re-verified `packages_quadgk_scalar_integrals_8140`.

### Parenthesized UnionAll application fixed ✅ (Issue #8430)

- `(Vector{T} where T){Int}` now evaluates the parenthesized `UnionAll` base
  and applies `Int` at runtime, matching upstream as `Vector{Int64}`.
- Regression fixture: `types_unionall_apply_parenthesized_8430`.

### Distributions truncated sampling path fixed ✅ (Issue #8421)

- `td = truncated(Normal(), lo, hi); rand(td, n)` now keeps `td` typed as
  `Distributions.Truncated`, so sampling dispatches to the package `rand`
  methods instead of the native random-array dimension path.
- Regression fixture re-verified: `distributions_truncated_7325`.

### DataType-return fit_mle call-site regression covered ✅ (Issue #8414)

- Added a regression fixture for the Binomial `fit_mle` call-site that previously
  treated the direct `fit_mle(Binomial, n, data)` assignment as `nothing`.
- Regression fixture: `distributions_fit_mle_datatype_return_8414`.

### Rational power keeps concrete integer field types ✅ (Issue #8418)

- `Rational{T} ^ Int64` now preserves the original rational element type for
  integer-backed rationals, matching upstream for `Rational{Int64}`,
  `Rational{Int32}`, and `Rational{BigInt}` smoke checks.
- Regression fixture: `rational_power_preserves_int64_8418`.

### Struct-backed range indexing by range ✅ (Issue #8416)

- `Base.OneTo(10)[2:4]`, `getindex(Base.OneTo(10), 2:4)`, `slice(r::AbstractRange,
  inds::AbstractRange)`, and `view(::OneTo, range)` now preserve lazy
  `UnitRange`/`StepRange` results instead of materializing `Vector`.
- Regression fixture re-verified: `range_struct_indexed_by_range_5842`.

### Module-private type objects in method bodies ✅ (Issue #8410)

- Module method bodies and the lazy runtime specializer now share the same
  defining-module type-object lookup for unqualified private types such as
  `Hidden`/`AAPerm`.
- Regression fixture: `modules_method_body_private_type_object_8410`.
- Re-verified the original package trigger
  `packages_abstract_algebra_perm_mvp_8306`.

### QuadGK semi-infinite interval cache invalidation ✅ (Issue #8408)

- Invalidated persistent package-loader caches written before the `let` tuple
  destructuring lowering fix, which could leave QuadGK's `handle_infinities`
  path with `si` unbound even on newer binaries.
- Regression fixture: `packages_quadgk_infinite_intervals_8408`.

### Matrix(::SymTridiagonal) eigvals range path ✅ (Issue #8391)

- `Matrix(::AbstractMatrix)` is reachable again for non-dense structured matrix
  values. The compiler keeps the bare `Matrix(x)` array-constructor fast path
  only when `x` is already known to be matrix-like; otherwise it dispatches to
  the public Julia constructor methods.
- Regression fixture: `linalg_symtridiagonal_matrix_eigvals_range_8391`.
- Re-verified the original package fixture chunk containing
  `packages_quadgk_scalar_integrals_8140`.

### Typed Matrix(::SymTridiagonal) constructor fixed ✅ (Issue #8395)

- `Matrix{Float64}(SymTridiagonal(...))` now returns a dense
  `Matrix{Float64}` instead of a `Vector{Float64}`.
- The compiler keeps `Matrix{T}(undef, dims...)` on the allocation fast path but
  lets valid one-argument typed matrix conversions use Julia constructor
  dispatch.
- Regression fixture: `linalg_symtridiagonal_typed_matrix_constructor_8395`.

### Module-qualified @eval exposes runtime module bindings ✅ (Issue #8362)

- `@eval M begin y = ... end; M.y` now matches upstream at top level: the
  module-qualified macro lowers through `Core.eval`, stores the binding in the
  target module, and later module field access can read it dynamically.
- Regression fixture: `macros_eval_module_qualified_8362`.

### QuadGK batched integrand bug closure ✅ (Issues #8373, #8375, #8377, #8378, #8380, #8382, #8383, #8384, #8385, #8386, #8387)

- Added a concrete `ArrayElementType::Nothing` path so `similar(Float64[],
  Nothing)` and sized variants report `Vector{Nothing}` / `eltype == Nothing`
  instead of `Vector{Any}`. The boxed storage keeps zero-length/sized allocation
  working while the logical element tag is preserved through reflection and
  compiler lattice conversion.
- Regression fixture: `array_similar_nothing_eltype_8387`.
- Re-verified the open milestone-52 `bug` MWEs for keyword forwarding/defaults,
  tuple RHS broadcast assignment, `eval(:(println(...)))`, tuple literal
  eltypes, tuple `fieldtypes`, `promote_type()`, and bounded `AbstractVector`
  parametric constructors.

### QuadGK scalar/Gauss support closure ✅ (Issues #8140, #8363, #8364, #8366, #8367, #8368, #8369, #8370)

- The bundled upstream QuadGK source now passes the scalar finite-interval
  integration fixture plus Gauss rule construction/rescaling:
  `quadgk(x -> x^2, 0.0, 1.0)`, `quadgk(sin, 0.0, 1.0)`,
  `cachedrule(Float64, 7)`, `QuadGK.gauss(Float64, 3)`, and
  `QuadGK.gauss(Float64, 3, 0.0, 2.0)`.
- Closed the supporting compatibility gaps with focused regression fixtures:
  numeric coefficient powers, typed comprehensions under runtime `where`
  parameters, `@inbounds` tuple-index assignment, keyword defaults on
  default/vararg/where methods, fused scalar-array broadcast assignment, n-ary
  `*` reduction in untyped keyword frames, and stateful `Iterators.filter`
  over tuples.
- Invalidated stale package-loader caches (version 14) so cached bundled package
  modules are rebuilt with the corrected lowering semantics.

### OrdinaryDiffEq keyword solve dispatch ✅ (Issue #8396)

- Bare exported and qualified `solve(...; kwargs...)` calls now keep enough
  resolved method-table context for runtime dispatch to choose the Tsit5 method,
  including keyword-vararg candidates.
- Covered by `packages_ordinarydiffeq_linear_solve_7363` and the existing
  OrdinaryDiffEq algorithm-dispatch fixture.

### Symbolics Num Dict-key indexing through Any receivers ✅ (Issue #8397)

- `IndexLoad(1)` now routes struct keys against pure-Julia `Dict` receivers to
  Dict dispatch instead of treating them as array indices. This fixes
  `Dict(Symbolics.Num=>...)[x]` in `packages_symbolics_substitute`.
- Extended `dict_indexing_any` with a user `struct <: Real` key regression.

### AbstractAlgebra YoungTableau linear indexing ✅ (Issue #8400)

- Base's local `AbstractMatrix` linear-index fallback now uses `::Integer`, so
  concrete subtype methods such as `getindex(::YoungTableau, ::Integer)` win for
  direct calls and `Y[i]`.
- Covered by `dispatch_abstract_matrix_integer_getindex_specificity_8400` and
  `packages_abstract_algebra_young_tableau_mvp_8302`.

### AbstractAlgebra alias where-bound dispatch ✅ (Issue #8406)

- Type-alias expansion now applies to `where` bounds in lowering and compiler
  method signatures, including uniquely resolvable qualified alias leaves.
- Covered by `dispatch_alias_where_bound_parametric_struct_8406` and the
  polynomial MVP fixture `packages_abstract_algebra_poly_mvp_7491`.

### AbstractAlgebra union-alias typevar binding ✅ (Issue #8409)

- Runtime dispatch now recovers type variables from the selected method pattern
  when a union alias admits a user abstract/concrete struct, preventing the
  `Fraction{T,R}` `UndefVarError` path.
- Covered by `dispatch_union_alias_user_struct_typevar_binding_8409` and
  `packages_abstract_algebra_fraction_residue_7491`.

### Module-private type objects in specialized methods ✅ (Issue #8410)

- Main compilation and runtime specialization now resolve bare module-private
  type names as module `DataType` values, while preserving local variable
  shadowing.
- Covered by `dispatch_module_private_type_object_return_8410` and
  `packages_abstract_algebra_perm_mvp_8306`.

### Dynamic DataType call return inference keeps runtime values ✅ (Issue #8414)

- Call-site body re-inference for `Any`-returning methods no longer narrows the
  result to `Nothing`, which prevented assignments from storing real runtime
  values.
- Covered by `distributions_fit_suffstats_7326`, including
  `fit_mle(Binomial, 5, data)` returning a `Binomial` value.

### DataStructures heap helper validation for QuadGK ✅ (Issue #8365)

- Added `packages_data_structures_heap_validation_8365` to validate the full
  QuadGK dependency slice of bundled DataStructures array-backed heap helpers:
  `heapify!`, `heapify`, `heappop!`, `heappush!`, `isheap`,
  `percolate_down!`, and `percolate_up!`.
- The fixture covers both `Forward` and `Reverse` orderings and the
  QuadGK-style bounded `percolate_down!(xs, i, x, Reverse, len)` active-prefix
  path. Verified against official Julia with DataStructures v0.19.5 and
  `sjulia` fixture chunk `packages::chunk_000`.

### QuadGK finite domains, segment buffers, in-place/batch dispatch ✅ (Issues #8286, #8287, #8288, #8289, #8290, #8401, #8403, #8404, #8405, #8407)

- Added upstream-parity fixtures for `kronrod(Float64, 3)`, finite multi-domain
  `quadgk`, vector/tuple segment inputs, `quadgk_segbuf`/`eval_segbuf`,
  concrete `segbuf=` reuse, `quadgk!`, and direct `BatchIntegrand` calls with
  keyword forwarding.
- Fixed the required compatibility gaps in linalg materialization/eigenvalues,
  `let` tuple destructuring, `NTuple{N}` length binding, expression-position
  `@inbounds` tuple destructuring, partial-parametric struct matching, and
  kwargs runtime dispatch over `kwargs...` wrappers.
- Regression fixtures: `packages_quadgk_domains_segbuf_8288`,
  `packages_quadgk_inplace_batch_8289`, `linalg_symtridiagonal_matrix_eigvals_8401`,
  `dispatch_ntuple_length_where_8404`,
  `dispatch_runtime_kwargs_vararg_partial_param_8407`,
  `let_blocks_tuple_destructuring_8403`, and
  `macros_inbounds_tuple_destructuring_8405`.

### Milestone 56 structural debt inventory ratchet ✅ (Issues #8327/#8329/#8332/#8333/#8334/#8335/#8336/#8337)

- Added `scripts/check_structural_debt_inventory.sh` as a CI-registered ratchet
  for the milestone-56 structural debt categories: hardcoded Julia name
  branches, duplicated configuration strings, panic-prone unwrap/expect sites,
  crate-boundary bypasses, unsafe FFI surface shape, giant files/functions,
  inline tests, and workaround/TODO drift.
- Replaced stale TODO references to closed #1447/#3510 with current follow-up
  Issues #8371/#8372 and removed the remaining active-source `Issue #XXXX`
  placeholder.

### AoT broadcast call-site collection accepts bare function vars ✅ (Issue #8374)

- Lowered `Broadcasted(Var("f"), ...)` forms now feed the same element-wise
  call-site specialization as `FunctionRef`, restoring the
  `mandelbrot_escape.(C, Ref(maxiter))` AoT regression path.
- Covered by the existing AoT inference and e2e mandelbrot broadcast tests.

### Foo{<:Bound} covariant bound type args lower again ✅ (Issue #8352)

- `Foo{<:Bound}`/`Foo{>:Bound}` lowers as a static bounded type expression again
  (was `UnsupportedOperator("<:")` after #8339). Fixed in `is_dynamic_type_arg`
  by classifying `<:`/`>:` shorthands as static. Covered by
  `types/covariant_bound_type_arg_8352.jl`; restores the `types/typeof_*`
  fixtures.

### Val Char / -Inf constructor value params stay concrete ✅ (Issue #8353)

- `Val{'x'}()` and `Val{-Inf}()` now construct instances whose concrete types
  retain the value parameter (`Val{'x'}` / `Val{-Inf}`), matching the bare type
  form instead of falling back to `Val{Any}`. The existing
  `types/value_param_binding_4268.jl` fixture now directly asserts the
  constructed instance type for both regression cases.

### Bare exported parametric inner constructor resolves in scope ✅ (Issue #8313)

- A parametric struct with an inner constructor, exported and brought in via
  `using .M`, is now callable by its bare name even when it collides with a
  bundled same-named struct (`Base.Order.Perm`). `resolve_parametric_struct_name`
  resolves scope-first (current module → `using`-imported modules) before a
  deterministic suffix-match fallback, fixing the `HashMap`-order nondeterminism
  that made `Perm([1,2,3])` intermittently resolve to the wrong struct.
- Covered by `modules/parametric_inner_ctor_using_8313.jl`.

### AbstractAlgebra.Generic Young diagram namespace ✅ (Issue #8302)

- Added the bundled `AbstractAlgebra/src/Generic.jl` submodule for the
  Young diagram/tableau MVP. The upstream-qualified issue MWE
  `AbstractAlgebra.Generic.Partition([4, 2, 1, 1, 1])` now constructs the
  supported partition type and exposes `n` / `part` through the qualified path.
- `packages_abstract_algebra_young_tableau_mvp_8302` now covers both qualified
  `Generic.Partition` / `Generic.YoungTableau` and the top-level aliases.
### Parser: Unicode superscript identifier suffixes ✅ (Issue #8298)

- `dderiv⁻¹` and similar identifiers now parse after infix operators. The lexer
  accepts Latin-1 superscript digits `¹²³` as identifier continuation characters.
- Regression fixture: `milestone55_unicode_superscript_identifier_after_infix_8298`.

### Base: @views in statement position ✅ (Issue #8300)

- `@views y = x[1:2]` now lowers through the existing `@views` expression
  transformation path instead of reporting `unknown macro @views`.
- Regression fixture: `milestone55_views_macro_assignment_8300`.

### Base: @pure compatibility metadata ✅ (Issue #8301)

- `Base.@pure f(x) = ...` is accepted as a no-op compiler metadata annotation in
  statement position.
- Regression fixture: `milestone55_pure_macro_noop_8301`.

### Lowering: field broadcast assignment ✅ (Issue #8303)

- `h.xs .= ys` and `h.xs .+= ys` now mutate the destination field value with
  `materialize!` rather than attempting to reassign the field.
- Regression fixture: `milestone55_field_broadcast_assignment_8303`.

### Parser: multiline return tuple continuation ✅ (Issue #8304)

- `return 1,\n       2` now parses as an implicit return tuple, matching
  upstream Julia.
- Regression fixture: `milestone55_multiline_return_tuple_8304`.

### Base: @. in statement position ✅ (Issue #8305)

- `@. x = x + 1` now lowers through the existing broadcast dotification path.
- Regression fixture: `milestone55_dot_macro_assignment_8305`.

### Base: Matrix constructor ✅ (Issue #8307)

- `Matrix(x)` is available through the public array constructor bridge alongside
  `Array` and `Vector`.
- Regression fixture: `milestone55_matrix_constructor_8307`.

### Compile: imported parametric inner constructors ✅ (Issue #8313)

- Exported parametric inner constructors imported by `using .M` can be called by
  bare name; bare calls now try visible qualified constructor names.
- Regression fixture: `milestone55_imported_parametric_inner_constructor_8313`.
## 最新対応 (2026-06-29)

### Parser: range in ternary else-branch ✅ (Issue #8318)

- An unparenthesized range in a ternary else-branch now keeps its `:` as a range
  operator: `cond ? a : b:c` parses as `cond ? a : (b:c)` (e.g. `true ? 1 : 4:6`
  is `1`, not `1:6`), matching upstream Julia. Fixed by gating the colon-break
  guard on the `in_ternary_then` flag so it applies only to the then-branch.
- Covered by a parser unit test and `ternary/else_branch_range_8318.jl`.

### iOS AbstractAlgebra.jl sample ✅ (Issue #8295)

- Added an iOS app sample for bundled `AbstractAlgebra.jl` covering exact
  polynomial rings over `ZZ`, polynomial quotient rings
  (`ZZ[x] / (x^2 + x + 1)`), residue ring arithmetic modulo 7, small dense
  matrix operations (`identity_matrix`, `det`, `tr`), and permutation group
  operations (`SymmetricGroup`, `Perm`, composition, inverse, powers, sign, and
  cycle type), plus Young diagram/tableau basics (`Partition`, `YoungTableau`).
- Registered the sample in `Resources/Samples/samples.json` and the Swift
  fallback sample catalog so both app resource loading and XCTest fallback paths
  expose it.
- Added a focused catalog regression test that requires the `AbstractAlgebra.jl`
  sample to be present, categorized as Mathematics, and backed by source using
  `using AbstractAlgebra`.

### AbstractAlgebra permutation group MVP ✅ (Issue #8306)

- Added a pure-Julia bundled `AbstractAlgebra/src/PermGroups.jl` slice for the
  iOS-safe permutation group surface: `SymmetricGroup`, `Perm`, `perm`,
  multiplication, `inv`, integer powers, `one`, `isone`, `parent`,
  `elem_type`, `parent_type`, `cycles`, `permtype`, `parity`, `sign`, `gens`,
  `gen`, and display helpers.
- Registered the new package source in the embedded package loader so
  `using AbstractAlgebra` exposes the permutation API without Rust intrinsics.
- Added `packages_abstract_algebra_perm_mvp_8306` to cover cycle display,
  composition, inverse, powers, sign/parity, cycle type, parent metadata, and
  generator count.

### AbstractAlgebra polynomial residue ring MVP ✅ (Issue #8299)

- Added polynomial quotient ring support for bundled `AbstractAlgebra`:
  `residue_ring(P::GenericPolyRing, f::GenericPoly)` returns `Q, alpha`, where
  `alpha` is the image of the polynomial generator.
- Implemented monic-modulus reduction, parent/base/modulus metadata,
  `data`/`lift`, zero/one, equality, scalar coercion, addition, subtraction,
  multiplication, powers, and display for the MVP surface.
- Added `packages_abstract_algebra_poly_residue_ring_8299`, covering
  `ZZ[x] / (x^2 + x + 1)`, the relation `alpha^2 + alpha + 1 == 0`, and
  `alpha^3 == 1`.

### AbstractAlgebra Young diagram/tableau MVP ✅ (Issue #8302)

- Added bundled `AbstractAlgebra/src/YoungTabs.jl` for an iOS-safe Young
  diagram/tableau slice: `Partition([..])`, `YoungTableau([..])`, shape
  metadata, partition fields (`n`, `part`), linear tableau indexing, equality,
  and compact ASCII diagram helpers.
- Registered the source in the embedded package loader and exported
  `Partition` / `YoungTableau`.
- Added `packages_abstract_algebra_young_tableau_mvp_8302`, covering the docs
  examples `Partition([4, 2, 1, 1, 1])` and `YoungTableau([4, 3, 1])`.
### Parser: comparison operator in ternary then-branch ✅ (Issue #8314)

- `cond ? a > b : c` (and `==`, nested ternaries, etc.) now parse: a new
  `in_ternary_then` parser flag makes the whitespace-delimited `:` end the
  then-branch at any operator-recursion depth, while genuine parenthesized ranges
  in the then-branch are preserved (the flag clears on entering any grouping).
- Covered by parser unit tests and `ternary/comparison_then_branch_8314.jl`.

### SpecialFunctions: Hurwitz zeta(s, z) and Dirichlet eta(s) ✅ (Issue #8310)

- `zeta(s, z)` (generalized/Hurwitz zeta) and `eta(s)` (Dirichlet eta) are now
  available from the bundled `SpecialFunctions` package for real arguments,
  completing the zeta family begun in Issue #8297.
- `zeta(s, z)` is a Float64 port of upstream `_zeta(s, z)` covering `z > 0`,
  `z < 0`, and the `z == 1`/`z == 0` reductions; `eta(s)` is derived from the
  Riemann zeta with a Taylor branch near `s == 1`.
- Verified against upstream within `1e-6` via
  `special_functions/special_functions_zeta_hurwitz.jl`.

### Accurate sinpi/cospi/sincospi ✅ (Issue #8309)

- `Base.sinpi`/`cospi`/`sincospi` are now accurate ports of the upstream
  `Base.Math` minimax-kernel algorithm (`julia/base/special/trig.jl`): exact at
  integer/half-integer arguments (`±0.0`/`0.0`/`±1.0`), accurate for large `x`,
  and within ~1 ULP of upstream elsewhere — replacing the naive
  `sin(pi*x)`/`cos(pi*x)`.
- Regression coverage in `math/sinpi_cospi.jl` now asserts exactness and large-x
  accuracy.

### SpecialFunctions: Riemann zeta function ✅ (Issue #8297)

- `zeta(s)` is now available from the bundled `SpecialFunctions` package for
  real `s`, ported from upstream `SpecialFunctions._zeta` (Float64 path):
  reflection + small-`s` Taylor branch for `s < 0.5`, Bernoulli/Stirling
  asymptotic series for `s >= 0.5`.
- Verified against upstream within `1e-6` for positive/negative/fractional `s`,
  the pole at `s == 1`, trivial zeros, and non-finite inputs via fixture
  `special_functions/special_functions_zeta.jl`.

### Public Base stdlib escape-hatch audit ✅ (Issue #8278)

- Closed the remaining `Base.Random.<fn>` public route so `Random` stays a
  stdlib root module loaded by `using Random`, matching upstream Julia's
  `Base.Random` `UndefVarError` behavior.
- Added `scripts/check_no_public_base_stdlib_routes.sh` and registered it in
  the code-audits workflow to prevent compiler/module-call special cases from
  exposing `Base.<stdlib>`, `using Base.<stdlib>`, or
  `Base.<stdlib>.<fn>` routes for stdlib roots.
- Extended integration coverage so `Base64`, `Dates`, `InteractiveUtils`,
  `LinearAlgebra`, `Printf`, `Random`, `Statistics`, and `Test` are rejected as
  public Base submodules.

### LinearAlgebra stdlib module loading and builtin bridge fix ✅ (Issue #8276)

- Matched upstream Julia's module model: `LinearAlgebra` is a stdlib root module
  loaded by `using LinearAlgebra`, not a public `Base.LinearAlgebra` submodule.
- Prevented `Base.LinearAlgebra` from being canonicalized to `LinearAlgebra`;
  user code now sees it as undefined, while real bundled Base submodules such as
  `Base.Order` still resolve.
- Replaced the old public-looking `Base.LinearAlgebra.<fn>` builtin escape hatch
  with a private compiler bridge used only by bundled LinearAlgebra wrappers.
- Added integration smoke tests for `det`, `inv`, `svd`, and `eigen`.

  `heapify!`, `heapify`, `heappop!`, `heappush!`, `isheap`,
  `percolate_down!`, and `percolate_up!`, including `Base.Order.Reverse`
  support.
- Uses the bundled `Base.Order` ordering surface and registers

  QuadGK-like `Segment` ordering by error estimate plus the bounded
  `percolate_down!` path used by batched refinement (Issue #8293).

  が heap 移植 + `type_id` 名前再マップ + frame 0 束縛）。

  `test_repl_odeproblem_global_persists_8260`（実 OrdinaryDiffEq）。

### Symbolics.jl サンプルのロード時推論を短縮 ✅ (Issue #8213)

- バンドル Symbolics の再帰的な式ウォーカー（`_simplify`/`_expand`/
  `substitute`/show/derivative 周辺）と記号行列 `det`/`inv` helper に戻り値注釈を
  付け、`compile.build_method_tables` がロード時に本文推論を展開しないようにした。
- `using Symbolics` の `build_method_tables` は約 9.7s → 88ms。基本サンプルは
  約 9.8s → 1.1s、`Symbolics + LinearAlgebra` 行列サンプルは約 10.3s → 1.7s。
  実行結果は従来通り（変数・代数・微分、行列積・det・inv・solve・3x3 determinant）。

### SubArray view equality を要素比較へ復旧 ✅ (Issue #8240)

- `view(Vector{T}, UnitRange)` の戻り値を call-site で
  `SubArray{T,1,Vector{T},Tuple{UnitRange{Int64}},true}` として推論し、`view(...) == ...`
  が `Any`/identity fallback に落ちないようにした。
- runtime の array equality 正規化に 1D contiguous `SubArray` を追加し、
  `view == view` / `view == Vector` / `Vector == view` が `ArrayValue` logical view の
  要素比較を使うようにした。fixture `subarray/view_equality_8240.jl` と
  `fixture_tests subarray::` で検証。

### Plots: `push!` 3D アニメ（Aizawa/Lorenz）の空フレームを解消 ✅ (Issue #8214)

- `plot3d(1)`+`push!`+`@animate` の 3D アニメが REPL で空の 2D アニメになっていた。`@animate` は
  `frame(_anim, current())` でスナップショットするが、`push!(plt,…)` が `plt` だけ変更しグローバル
  `_CURRENT_*` を更新しないため、`current()` が空のまま（全フレーム空→`extract_series` が空シリーズを
  落とし 2D・traces 空）。in-place `push!` 拡張ヘルパが変更後 `plt` を `current()` に再公開するよう修正
  （`_plots_resync_current!`）。アーティファクトが `scene`+scatter3d+非空フレームに復帰。回帰テスト
  `test_push_based_3d_animation_frames_are_3d_and_nonempty_8214`。memory
  `reference_plots_push_current_sync`。fixture_tests(169)/plot_artifact_mime_tests(31) 全通過。

### iOS REPL: 複数プロット一括ペーストのメインスレッド・レイアウト嵐を解消 ✅ (Issue #8214)

- REPL 履歴の自動スクロール `proxy.scrollTo(...)` を `withAnimation(.easeOut(0.2))`
  から**アニメーション無し**に変更。アニメーション化は行（WKWebView/Plotly を内包しうる）
  の挿入まで毎フレーム再レイアウトさせ、一括ペースト時にアニメーションが積み重なって
  メインスレッドが `CA::Transaction::commit`→`List.applyNodes`/`ScrollViewLayoutComputer`
  で飽和→UI 固まり＋`main.async` eval/描画コールバック枯渇（「3 evals」で停止）していた。
- 実機プロセスの `sample` で根本原因を特定（VM・eval ロックは無実）。iPad (A16) シミュレータ
  で同一ペーストを再実行し、6/6 evals 完了・全プロット描画・メインスレッド idle・履歴スクロール
  正常を確認。memory `reference_ios_swiftui_scrollto_animation_storm` に知見記録。
- 嵐解消に伴い履歴プロットを**再インタラクティブ化**（pan/zoom/hover・3D orbit）。#8235 の
  非インタラクティブ化は「WebView がスクロールを奪う」推定だったが、真因はこの嵐。嵐が消えた
  後はインタラクティブ・プロット上でも履歴は ScrollView が縦パンを取りスクロール可（検証済み）。
### AbstractArray サブタイプの `==`/`isequal` 要素比較 + `::AbstractArray` ディスパッチ ✅ (Issue #8229)
