### `Tuple{}` type-object equality parity ✅ (Issue #4300)

- Kept `Tuple{}` as the concrete empty tuple type (`TupleOf([])`) instead of
  canonicalizing it to the abstract `Tuple` type object.
- This makes `typeof(()) == Tuple{}` and `typeof(()) === Tuple{}` match
  upstream Julia while preserving bare `Tuple` as the abstract tuple family.
- Extended the #4268 value-parameter fixture with `Val{()}()` so empty tuple
  value parameters also check the corrected type-object equality path.

### Keyword default expression preservation ✅ (Issue #4297)

- Extended kwarg default evaluation to recognize simple quoted-symbol defaults
  lowered as `QuoteLiteral(SymbolNew("name"))`.
- `KwParamInfo.default` now stores `Value::Symbol(...)` and
  `KwParamInfo.ty` records `ValueType::Symbol` for defaults like
  `debuginfo=:default`.
- Bool kwarg defaults now store `Value::Bool` / `ValueType::Bool` instead of
  the older `Int64` representation.
- `KwParamInfo` now retains optional default IR, and omitted keyword binding
  evaluates supported default expressions left-to-right in the callee frame.
- Global-name default expressions fall back to the top-level frame at call time,
  so rebinding a global used by a keyword default is observed by later calls.
- Added `kwargs_symbol_default_4297`, covering omitted Symbol defaults after a
  preceding Bool keyword default and explicit Symbol overrides.
- Added `kwargs_default_expression_order_4297`, covering `x=1+2`,
  `b=a+1`, explicit earlier keyword values, explicit later overrides, and
  call-time global Symbol default lookup.
- Extended the supported default evaluator to simple zero-argument calls, so
  representative defaults such as `x=default_num()+1` and
  `debuginfo=default_sym()` now match upstream Julia.
- Extended the same bounded evaluator to simple positional-argument calls whose
  arguments are literal or already-bound default expressions, covering
  `x=default_arg(41)` and Symbol-preserving identity defaults.
- Extended bounded default evaluation to simple keyword calls, covering
  `x=default_kw(x=41)`, calls whose keyword argument references an earlier
  default, and Symbol-preserving keyword call defaults.
- Seeded the abstract-inference environment with keyword default types
  left-to-right, matching upstream `Base.infer_return_type(f, Tuple{})` for the
  same representative numeric and Symbol default-call cases.

### Method-world inference cache invalidation ✅ (Issue #4271)

- Added a conservative `method_world` counter to the abstract inference engine.
- `InferenceEngine::add_method` now invalidates return-type cache,
  PartialStruct return fact cache, tentative recursive results, and
  limited-accuracy markers after every inference-only method-table mutation.
- Added `test_issue_4271_method_replacement_invalidates_return_cache` to lock
  that method replacement advances the conservative world and removes stale
  cached return facts.

### CallMeta numeric exception/effect parity ✅ (Issue #4274)

- Added `Effects::effect_free_may_throw` for deterministic, effect-free
  operations that can throw for some input values.
- Refined `infer_expr_result` for `div` / `rem` / `mod` / `%` and binary
  integer division/modulo using argument lattice types: integer-only calls now
  report `ExceptionType::Known("DivideError")`, while Float-containing numeric
  calls are restored to `nothrow` / `ExceptionType::Bottom`, matching upstream
  representative behavior.
- Extended CallMeta-style unit coverage for `div(::Int64,::Int64)`,
  `div(::Float64,::Float64)`, and binary modulo effects.

### Array `!=` dispatch fallback parity ✅ (Issue #4276)

- Changed the array/memory `BinaryOp::Ne` fallback to compile `==` first and
  then emit `NotBool`, mirroring upstream `!=(x, y) = !(x == y)`.
- Preserved the existing `==` array/memory `BuiltinId::Isequal` fallback for
  cases without a user-defined equality method.
- Added `dispatch_array_ne_uses_user_eq_4276`, proving a user-defined
  `Base.:(==)(::Vector{Int64}, ::Vector{Int64})` affects both `==` and `!=`.
- Documented the current `BASE_FUNCTION_ROUTES` public fallback inventory in
  `docs/vm/PUBLIC_FALLBACKS.md` and extended
  `scripts/check_base_routing_registry.sh` so route names in code and docs stay
  synchronized.

### String/Symbol/Bool/Char/Type{T} equality dispatch fallback parity ✅ (Issue #4298)

- Removed the pre-dispatch String equality short-circuit so
  `Base.:(==)(::String, ::String)` methods can win before `EqStr`.
- Added String/Symbol/Bool/Char/Type{T} equality methods to `CallDynamicBinaryBoth` candidate
  collection, covering `Any`-typed wrappers before the VM fallback.
- Direct Bool/Char equality now takes the same dispatch-first route before Bool
  primitive fallback or Char singleton identity fallback.
- `Any`-typed Bool equality now lets an exact `==(::Bool, ::Bool)` candidate run
  before primitive fallback while preserving primitive-first arithmetic behavior.
- `Any`-typed `Value::DataType(T)` equality now dispatches as `Type{T}` for exact
  type-object equality methods before the DataType identity fallback.
- Routed String/Symbol/Bool/Char/Type{T} `!=` through compiled `==` plus `NotBool` when a matching
  equality candidate exists, mirroring upstream generic `!(==)` behavior.
- Added `dispatch_string_symbol_eq_user_method_4298`.

### AoT const-aware specialization keys ✅ (Issue #4272)

- Added `CodeInstanceArgKey` and `CodeInstanceKey::arg_key` so AoT specialization
  de-duplication can preserve controlled const identity separately from ABI
  `arg_types`.
- Direct user-function call-site collection now records literal Bool, Nothing,
  Symbol, and small Int values in the specialization key while leaving large
  ints, floats, strings, and non-literals widened to their `StaticType`.
- `SpecializationQueue::attach_inference` now attaches final inference results
  to already-enqueued const-aware instances with the same function and ABI
  argument tuple, instead of creating only a generic key instance.
- Added `issue_4272_const_bool_arg_keys_remain_distinct` under the AoT feature
  to lock true/false Bool call-site keys as distinct, plus
  `issue_4272_attach_inference_updates_const_specializations` to verify both
  const-aware instances receive inference metadata.

### PartialStruct return field inference ✅ (Issue #4269)

- Added a cache for PartialStruct-style immutable constructor return facts in
  abstract inference.
- Preserved field value types across one interprocedural return boundary, so
  `getfield(make_box(flag), :b)` and `box = make_box(flag); getfield(box, :b)`
  infer `String` when `make_box` returns `PairBox(flag ? 1 : 2, "x")`.
- Kept the public function return type as the concrete struct (`PairBox4269`),
  matching upstream's visible `Core.Compiler.return_type(make_box, Tuple{Bool})`.
- Added `type_inference_partial_struct_return_field_4269`.

### raw comparison-aware joins before limit_type_size ✅ (Issue #4273)

- Split lattice join into a raw union-building path and the existing bounded
  public `join` path.
- Updated `join_limited` to call raw join before `limit_type_size`, so
  `compare_to` can preserve already-known complexity instead of receiving a
  pre-widened `Top` / numeric abstract type.
- Routed `TypeEnv::update` and PartialStruct field merges through
  `join_limited(..., compare_to = previous_type)`, covering branch and loop env
  convergence with comparison context.
- Added a unit regression for `wide.join_limited(&wide, &wide)` and
  `type_inference_raw_join_limit_type_size_4273`.

### zip5/zip6/zip7 collected tuple eltype parity ✅ (Issue #4281)

- Added `Zip5` / `Zip6` / `Zip7` to the same native collect and iterator-recognition
  paths used by `Zip` / `Zip3` / `Zip4`.
- Added 7-arity zip trait helpers for `IteratorSize`, `IteratorEltype`, and
  promoted `size`, matching the existing fixed-arity helper shape.
- Changed `eltype(::Vector{Tuple{...}})` projection for `ArrayElementType::TupleOf`
  to return canonical `JuliaType::TupleOf(...)` instead of a display-only
  `Struct("Tuple{...}")` wrapper.
- Verified `iteration_zip_nary` now preserves `typeof(result)`,
  `typeof(result[1])`, and `eltype(result)` for six- and seven-iterator mixed
  tuple cases.

### union type-object equality for reflection return joins ✅ (Issue #4287)

- Added `JuliaType::type_eq` so `Union` type objects compare independent of
  member construction order, matching upstream Julia's canonical type
  identity for `Union{A,B}` / `Union{B,A}`.
- Routed VM `DataType` equality through this helper for `==` / `!=`, `===`,
  `isequal`, and the struct-field identity path.
- Added a unit regression for order-insensitive union type equality and
  verified `reflection_return_types_union_split_4287` now passes both
  `Base.return_types` and `_type_union`-backed `Base.infer_return_type`.

### type-stability diagnostic parity fixtures ✅ (Issue #4291)

- Added `type_stability_diagnostic_parity_4291`, a shared source fixture whose
  upstream-facing `Base.infer_return_type` checks cover arrays, tuples,
  generators, local-closure generator bodies, and dispatch.
- Added an API regression that runs the same source through sjulia runtime /
  reflection and then checks `analyze_type_stability` reports matching stable
  lattice return shapes.
- Added a production-backed report path that builds facts with the same shared
  inference engine shape used by code generation, then classifies API/CLI
  type-stability return types from that snapshot.
- `analyze_type_stability_json` now reports
  `"source": "production shared inference snapshot"` and
  `"uses_production_inference": true` for the public report path.
- Bounded production fact collection to user/report targets instead of eagerly
  inferring every Base/prelude function, so a function-only file such as
  `plain_4291() = 41` returns a JSON report instead of timing out.
- Built type-stability production facts with the user struct table and recovered
  representative default-constructor returns, so `make_box() = TSBox(41)` and
  `field_from_box() = make_box().x` no longer report `Top` / unstable.
- Seeded non-parametric inner constructor method return snapshots into the
  production report inference engine, so `TSBoxInner(x) = new(x + 1)` and
  `field_inner() = make_inner().x` are classified as stable in API/CLI
  type-stability reports.

### `getfield(obj, :field)` union field inference ✅ (Issue #4270)

- Treated parser-lowered `QuoteLiteral(SymbolNew("field"))` as a static
  `getfield` field key in abstract inference.
- Added fixture and unit coverage so declared `Union{T,Nothing}` struct fields
  queried through `getfield(obj, :field)` preserve the same union return type as
  upstream Julia.
- Added mutable array index guard parity for `Vector{Union{Int64,Nothing}}`:
  repeated `a[1]` reads are no longer path-narrowed as field aliases, `getindex`
  preserves the union element type, and reflection specialization keeps
  `Nothing` instead of widening it to `Any`.
- Added `type_inference_index_guard_mutable_array_4270`, covering
  `Base.infer_return_type`, `Core.Compiler.return_type`, and runtime results
  against upstream Julia.

### non-const global reader reflection avoids stale precision ✅ (Issue #4285)

- Extended `type_inference_global_binding_invalidation_4285` so a non-const
  global reader reports `Any` through `Base.infer_return_type` /
  `Base.return_types` for single-assignment, late-assignment, and incompatible
  rebinding representatives, matching upstream and avoiding stale concrete
  precision.

### VM-native range collect user-method dispatch ✅ (Issue #4266)

- Narrowed the static/runtime `RangeCollect` boundary so user-defined
  `collect(::UnitRange{Int64})` methods participate in dispatch before the
  VM-native range materialization fallback.
- Preserved the existing typed fallback for ordinary `collect(1:3)`, which still
  returns `Vector{Int64}` when no user method overrides range collect.
- Added `iteration_range_collect_user_method_4266`, covering direct
  `collect(1:3)` and `x::Any` runtime dispatch.
- Extended the same dispatch-before-materialization behavior to user-defined
  `collect(::StepRange{Int64,Int64})`, covering direct `collect(1:2:7)` and
  `x::Any` runtime dispatch with `iteration_steprange_collect_user_method_4266`.
- When a user-defined range collect method exists, VM-native collect dispatch now
  suppresses sjulia-internal range collect bridge candidates for the same
  boundary, so `collect(::AbstractRange)` can override `UnitRange`, `StepRange`,
  and float range collect just as it does upstream.
- Added `iteration_abstractrange_collect_user_method_4266`.
- Runtime `collect(x::Any)` for integer non-unit `StepRange` now includes the
  Base `StepRange` collect bridge in dynamic candidate scoring, shrinking the
  pre-score native range materialization boundary while preserving
  `Vector{Int64}`.
- Added a Base-side `collect(::UnitRange{T})` bridge for the no-user-method direct
  integer UnitRange slice, matching the upstream range collect shape by entering
  `_collect(..., IteratorEltype, IteratorSize)` before VM materialization.
- Added `iteration_unitrange_collect_base_dispatch_4266` plus compile bytecode
  checks that direct `collect(1:3)` and direct integer `StepRange` collection
  use Base dispatch instead of the static `RangeCollect` boundary.
- Extended the direct Base bridge to numeric floating ranges such as
  `collect(1.0:0.5:2.0)`, preserving `Vector{Float64}` while avoiding the static
  `RangeCollect` boundary.
- Kept VM-native integer `StepRange` collection typed as `Vector{Int64}` even
  though the current VM range index operation exposes stepped values as Float64.

### VM-native Base.Generator collect user-method dispatch ✅ (Issue #4265)

- Narrowed the static/runtime `collect_generator` boundary so user-defined
  `collect(::Base.Generator)` methods participate in dispatch before
  VM-native generator materialization.
- Preserved the existing typed fallback for ordinary
  `collect(Base.Generator(f, xs))`, which still returns a `Vector` when no user
  method overrides generator collect.
- Added `generator_collect_user_method_4265`, covering direct
  `collect(Base.Generator(...))` and `x::Any` runtime dispatch.
- Added type-object trait parity for representative `typeof(g)` generator
  values: `IteratorSize(typeof(g))` delegates through the generator input type
  and `IteratorEltype(typeof(g))` returns `EltypeUnknown()`.
- Preserved named generator callables in `typeof(g)` as `typeof(f)` and added
  reflection inference for explicit `Tuple{Base.Generator{I, typeof(f)}}`
  collect signatures, covering `Vector{Int64}` and `Vector{Float64}` results.
- Routed context-aware parametric type lowering through dynamic type
  construction so `Tuple{typeof(g)}` collect signatures infer the collected
  vector type for representative generator values.
- Removed the direct static `RangeCollect` emission for no-user-method
  `collect(Base.Generator(...))`; direct generator collect now goes through the
  collect method table's dynamic sentinel before returning to the VM-native
  `collect_generator` materialization boundary.
- Added a compile bytecode regression for the dynamic sentinel route while
  preserving the existing iOS-safe runtime materialization behavior.
- Added VM-native `Base.Generator` field projection for `f` and `iter`,
  including dotted field access and `getfield` by name/index. The new
  `generator_base_generator_field_collect_4265` fixture verifies that explicit
  `Base._collect(..., ::Generator, IteratorEltype, IteratorSize)` can run for a
  representative non-splat callable generator while public `collect(g)` stays on
  the existing iOS-safe VM materialization boundary.
- Narrowed the runtime public collect sentinel one step further: nonempty
  Vector/Matrix/Memory/Range-backed VM-native generators with a direct lowercase
  function-index callable now enter the generic `collect(::Any)` / `_collect`
  method body instead of immediately materializing through `collect_generator`.
  Empty generators, type constructors, tuple-backed generators, tuple-splat,
  filtered, eager, and unknown iterator shapes stay on the native boundary to
  preserve default eltype and iOS/no-JIT behavior.
- Added `generator_public_collect_nonempty_generic_path_4265`, including same
  call-site checks that a safe generator can use the generic path while
  tuple-splat, filtered, and empty generator cases keep their existing behavior.
  The fixture now covers shape-preserving Matrix direct/runtime public collect.
- Evaluated local DataType aliases in type expressions, so
  `T = typeof(g); Tuple{T}` now matches upstream and drives the same collect
  reflection inference.
- Added `generator_typeof_trait_infer_collect_4265` and updated the older
  `generator_typeof` fixture away from the pre-parametric `Base.Generator`
  string expectation.

### while-loop exit narrowing for loop-carried state ✅ (Issue #4267)

- Intersected while-loop fixpoint output with the condition false-branch
  environment on normal loop exit.
- This keeps loop-carried assignments precise for representative cases like
  `x = 1; while x isa Int64; x = "s"; end; x`, where upstream Julia infers
  `String` rather than `Union{Int64,String}`.
- Added `type_inference_while_exit_narrowing_4267`, covering runtime,
  `Base.infer_return_type`, and `Base.return_types` parity.

### representative CodeInfo objects for reflection APIs ✅ (Issue #4288)

- Replaced the previous `nothing` placeholder in `Base.code_lowered` and
  `Base.code_typed(...)[i][1]` with a structured `CodeInfo` record carrying
  the matched `Method` and return-type snapshot.
- Added a representative `.code` field to the sjulia `CodeInfo` record so
  `code_typed(...)[1][1].code` and `code_lowered(...)[1].code` can be accessed
  like upstream `Core.CodeInfo.code`; full SSA statement materialization remains
  out of scope.
- Replaced the empty `.code` placeholder with a small non-empty `Expr` vector
  carrying representative call/return entries, so supported scalar reflection
  now exposes inspectable code-like statements while still not claiming full
  upstream SSA parity.
- `code_lowered` now returns a non-`nothing` CodeInfo-like object, while
  `code_typed` returns `Pair(CodeInfo(...), rettype)` so `typed[1][2]` remains
  the inferred return type and `typed[1][1].rettype` is inspectable.
- Matched representative `code_typed` keyword boundaries from upstream
  `julia/base/reflection.jl`: `optimize=false` and `debuginfo=:source` are
  accepted without changing sjulia's single snapshot result, while unsupported
  `generated=false` is rejected instead of being silently ignored.
- Matched the upstream `debuginfo` argument check for both `code_typed` and
  `code_lowered`: `:default` is normalized to `:source`, `:source` / `:none`
  are accepted, and unsupported symbols throw `ArgumentError`.

### unparameterized Array/Vector eltype reflection parity ✅ (Issue #4299)

- Added exact `eltype(::Type{Array})` and `eltype(::Type{Vector})` methods that
  return `Any`, matching upstream Julia for unparameterized array type objects.
- Preserved the parametric `eltype(::Type{Array{T}})` /
  `eltype(::Type{Vector{T}})` paths for bound element types such as
  `Vector{Int64}`.
- Extended `typevar_unionall_reflection` with `eltype(Array) === Any` so the
  fixture catches unbound-TypeVar regressions.

### reflection world keyword compatibility for typed code ✅ (Issue #4290)

- Matched upstream's representative world-keyword behavior where
  `Base.code_typed(f, Tuple{...}; world=w)` is accepted and returns the same
  typed return snapshot in sjulia's single-world runtime.
- Made `Base.code_lowered(...; world=w)` reject the unsupported keyword instead
  of silently accepting it, matching upstream's unsupported surface for this
  call shape.

### user-struct branch narrowing through local aliases ✅ (Issue #4270)

  identities.

  field access: `if x isa A; y = x; return y.n; end`.

  `Base.infer_return_type`, `Core.Compiler.return_type`, and runtime behavior.

### tfunc metadata completion and `abs_float` reflection ✅ (Issue #4275)

- Migrated production tfunc registrations away from the legacy

  `Core.Compiler.return_type` coverage.

### union-split method return joins ✅ (Issue #4287)

- Synchronized newly built `MethodSig`s into the shared `InferenceEngine`, so

- Added ternary expression branch joining to abstract inference and preserved

- Added a world-age-free `Base.invokelatest(f, args...; kwargs...) =
  f(args...; kwargs...)` compatibility wrapper for the supported single-world

### keyword-parameter arrow functions ✅ (Issue #4294)

- Added parser support for semicolon-separated keyword parameter lists in arrow
  function heads, including `(; y=1) -> ...` and `(x; y=1) -> ...`.
- Lowered arrow keyword defaults, `kwargs...`, and positional `args...` into
  normal `Function.kwparams` / varargs metadata for lifted lambdas, assigned
  lambda functions, and immediately invoked lambdas.
- Added upstream-compatible coverage for keyword splat calls, keyword forwarding,
  vararg forwarding, keyword-only arrows, and IIFE arrows.
- Added `kwargs_splat_arrow_kwparams_4294`.

### Val and NTuple value-parameter binding ✅ (Issue #4268)

- Added compile-time marking for `NTuple{N,T}` length parameters so runtime
  method entry binding treats `N` as a value parameter.
- Added VM method argument binding for `NTuple{N,T}` tuple values, binding
  `N` from tuple length and `T` from homogeneous element types.
- Confirmed `Val{3}()` and `Val(3)` both bind `N == 3` and return an `Int64`
  value, matching upstream Julia.
- Extended `Val{N}` runtime method binding to ordinary Float64 value
  parameters, so `f(::Val{N}) where N = N` returns a `Float64` value for
  `Val{1.5}()`.
- Added fixture coverage for non-finite Float64 value parameters
  `Val{Inf}()`, `Val{-Inf}()`, and `Val{NaN}()`, which already bind as
  runtime `Float64` values through the same path.
- Extended the same binding path to simple Char value parameters, so
  `Val{'x'}()` binds `N` as a runtime `Char` value rather than a type object.
- The Char value-parameter binding now uses the same escaped character forms as
  character literals, covering representative `Val{'\n'}`, `Val{'\''}`, and
  `Val{'\\'}` cases, plus hex and Unicode escapes such as `Val{'\x41'}` and
  `Val{'\u03B1'}`.
- Added representative tuple value-parameter binding for `Val{(1, 2)}()`,
  empty/singleton tuple values, mixed `Bool`/`Symbol` tuple values, and nested
  tuple values, so `f(::Val{N}) where N = N` returns runtime `Tuple` values
  for these upstream-compatible cases.
- Extended static `Val` value-parameter handling to constructor-form numeric
  bits values such as `Val{UInt8(1)}()`, `Val{Int32(2)}()`, and
  `Val{Float32(1.5)}()`, preserving the original runtime value type when
  binding `N`.
- Added typed constructor elements inside tuple value parameters, covering
  `Val{(UInt8(1), Int32(2))}()`.
- Fixed `ntuple` index argument preservation so `ntuple(f, 3)` calls `f` with
  `Int64` indices, not widened `Float64` values.
- Allowed non-capturing arrow lambdas lowered as nested function references to
  drive `ntuple(i -> i, N)`, covering the upstream `Val{N}` size example.
- Routed `ntuple` calls with lowered arrow `LetBlock` callables or local
  callable variables through the runtime callable path, preserving closure
  captures for `ntuple(i -> i + a, 3)` and `f = i -> i + a; ntuple(f, 3)`.
- Added abstract-interpretation transfer for `ntuple(f, const_n)`, so the
  captured-arrow representative cases also report `Tuple{Int64, Int64, Int64}`
  through `Base.infer_return_type`.
- Added `types_value_param_binding_4268`.

### global binding reassignment widening ✅ (Issue #4285)

- Global type collection now widens a top-level binding to `Any` when the same
  non-const global is assigned incompatible storage types.
- Functions compiled against such globals now use runtime loads/dispatch instead
  of stale typed global loads.
- Single-assignment const globals remain precise for both runtime execution and
  `Base.infer_return_type` / `Base.return_types` in the representative case.
- Top-level `const` rebinding such as `const x = 1; x = 1.5` now raises an
  invalid-assignment `ErrorException` and preserves the original value.
- Added `type_inference_global_binding_invalidation_4285` and a unit test for
  mixed global reassignment widening.

### full @generated function syntax for type/value-parameter bodies ✅ (Issue #4284)

- Added lowering support for full-form `@generated function ... end`
  definitions and one-line `@generated f(...) = ...` definitions as
  compatibility wrappers.
- Representative generated bodies that directly return already-bound
  type/value parameters now work through the existing method binding path.
- Simple quoted generated bodies such as `:(x + 1)` and `return :(x * x)`
  are unquoted into normal function bodies during lowering, including
  one-line generated definitions.
- Preserved `Type{T}` return snapshots for direct generated returns when the
  supplied signature binds `T` to a concrete type. `Base.return_types`,
  `Base.infer_return_type`, and `Core.Compiler.return_type` now match upstream
  for `Tuple{Int64}`, while abstract signatures such as `Tuple{Integer}` fall
  back to `Any` like upstream generated-function reflection.
- Added `generated_full_syntax_type_params_4284`.

### inference metadata annotation compatibility slice ✅ (Issue #4286)

- Added parser support for module-qualified macro calls in the `Base.@macro ...`
  form and for macro arguments that are long-form function definitions.
- Added lowering pass-through for `@inline`, `@noinline`,
  `@nospecializeinfer`, and `@propagate_inbounds` as no-op compatibility
  wrappers around definitions or expressions.
- Added lowering pass-through for upstream inference metadata annotations
  `Base.@constprop :aggressive function ... end`, `Base.@constprop :none f(x)=...`,
  `Base.@assume_effects :foldable function ... end`,
  `Base.@assume_effects :terminates_locally f(x)=...`, metadata-only statement
  markers, and callsite `Base.@assume_effects :foldable f(x)`.
- Added a representative `@inbounds` / `@boundscheck` runtime slice:
  statement and expression `@inbounds` forms mark the wrapped call context, and
  `@boundscheck` blocks are skipped inside the callee frame for that context.
- Propagated the same `@inbounds` frame context through Lazy AoT
  `CallSpecializeInbounds` so specialized calls suppress lowered
  `@boundscheck` blocks consistently with direct calls.
- Covered long-form `@inline function ... end`, short-form `Base.@inline f(x)=...`,
  and nested `Base.@propagate_inbounds @inline f(x)=...` wrapper combinations.
- Added parser pass-through for parameter-position `@nospecialize x` and
  `@specialize(x)` annotations.
- Added statement-position metadata marker compatibility for
  `@nospecialize x y` and `@specialize`, and fixture coverage for callsite
  `@inline f(x)` / `@noinline (expr)` wrappers.
- Added metadata-only statement marker compatibility for upstream-accepted
  bare `@inline` / `@noinline` statements inside function bodies.
- Added explicit lowered IR retention for statement-position and wrapped-target metadata:
  `Stmt::Meta` now carries supported `@inline` / `@noinline` /
  `@nospecialize` / `@specialize` / `Base.@constprop` /
  `Base.@assume_effects` markers before the wrapped statement while VM/AoT
  execution treats them as no-op.
- Added the first metadata semantic-consumption slice: function-body `@inline` /
  `@noinline` `Stmt::Meta` markers are converted into
  `AotFunction.inline_policy`, and the AoT inliner now honors `@noinline`
  before size/score heuristics and lets non-recursive `@inline` callees cross
  the automatic size limit. `Stmt::Meta` is skipped during AoT statement
  conversion so metadata does not become a synthetic `nothing` statement.
- Moved wrapped top-level definition annotations such as
  `@inline function ... end` / `@noinline function ... end` from sibling
  `Stmt::Meta` blocks into the annotated function body, then hoisted those
  functions into `Program.functions`. This matches upstream `pushmeta!` shape
  closely enough for AoT `inline_policy` conversion to see wrapped definition
  metadata.
- Added a representative callsite inline/noinline semantic slice:
  expression-position `@inline f(x)` / `@noinline f(x)` now lower into retained
  `#__sjulia_inline__` / `#__sjulia_noinline__` wrappers. VM execution treats
  them as no-op wrappers, while AoT IR conversion maps direct static calls to
  per-call `CallStatic.inline_policy`; the AoT inliner uses that callsite policy
  ahead of definition policy and preserves upstream's innermost nested
  annotation precedence.
- Extended that callsite slice across wrapped expressions: `@inline (f(x) + g(x))`
  recursively marks direct static calls inside the AoT expression tree, while
  explicit inner policies such as `@noinline f(x)` keep innermost precedence.
  Outer callsite policy is not propagated into lambda bodies.
- Added `macros_inference_meta_noop_4286`, including a Julia-compatible
  `@boundscheck return 1` / `@inbounds caller()` elision case for direct and
  specialized calls, plus representative `@constprop` / `@assume_effects`
  definition and callsite annotations.

### reflection return type APIs for single-method cases ✅ (Issue #4288)

- Added `Base.return_types(f)` / `Base.return_types(f, types)` using existing
  `methods` reflection and VM `FunctionInfo.return_type` snapshots.
- Added `Base.infer_return_type(f)` / `Base.infer_return_type(f, types)` as a
  typejoin over the returned method snapshots.
- Added `Core.Compiler.return_type(f, Tuple{...})` as an alias to the same
  representative return-type reflection surface.
- Matched upstream's no-method concrete signature result:
  `return_types(...) == Any[]` and `infer_return_type(...) == Union{}`.
- Added minimal `Base.code_lowered` / `Base.code_typed` representative surfaces
  backed by method matches and return type snapshots.
- Added representative `CodeInfo.code` field access for both lowered and typed
  reflection results.
- Matched representative `code_typed` `interp` keyword behavior:
  `interp=nothing` is accepted, while non-interpreter values such as `interp=1`
  raise `Expected AbstractInterpreter`.
- Preserved parametric direct-parameter return snapshots such as
  `f(xs::Vector{Int64}) = xs`, so return reflection reports `Vector{Int64}`
  instead of the erased `Array` boundary.
- Matched upstream method filtering for concrete signature reflection: when
  querying `Tuple{Int64}`, only the most specific applicable method contributes
  to `methods` / `return_types`, while broader abstract queries can still return
  multiple methods.
- Fixed `Type{T}` return binding for `f(::Type{T}) where T = T`, avoiding the
  previous `Type{Type{Int64}}` over-wrap and matching upstream `Type{Int64}`.
- Added representative support for `Core.Compiler.return_type(Tuple{typeof(f), Args...})`
  by expanding signature tuples through `_methods_by_ftype`.
- Added a builtin tfunc reflection slice for `+ :: Tuple{Int64,Int64}`, so
  `Base.return_types`, `Base.infer_return_type`, and `Core.Compiler.return_type`
  report `Int64` for that representative primitive call.
- Extended the builtin reflection slice with representative `string(::Int64)`,
  `length(::Vector{Int64})`, and `getindex(::Vector{Int64}, ::Int64)` results,
  matching upstream return-type reflection for those Base builtin calls.
- Preserved `Vector{T}` reflection snapshots for production inference's
  representative `map` and generator `collect` paths, so `return_types`,
  `infer_return_type`, and `code_typed` report `Vector{Int64}` instead of the
  erased `Array` / `Any` boundary for those cases.
- Preserved anonymous-arrow tuple `map` reflection snapshots by resolving the
  nested callable stored in the lowered `LetBlock`, so `map(x -> x + 1,
  t::Tuple{Int64,Float64})` reports `Tuple{Int64,Float64}`.
- Added small Union argument splitting for reflection method lookup, so
  `Base.return_types(f, Tuple{Union{Int64,String}})` returns the branch method
  snapshots and `infer_return_type` / `Core.Compiler.return_type` preserve
  `Union{Int64,String}` instead of widening to `Any`.
- Preserved `JuliaType::Union` annotations in abstract inference input
  environments, allowing Union-annotated callers to use method-table union
  splitting and report `Union{...}` snapshots.
- Added conditional narrowing for ternary expressions, so `isa` guards over
  small Union parameters refine each branch before joining the result.
- Added `reflection_return_types_basic_4288` and
  `reflection_code_typed_lowered_basic_4288`.

### type-stability report inference provenance ✅ (Issue #4291)

- Added `inference_provenance` to type-stability reports so JSON consumers can
  tell which inference source produced the report.
- Added text output for the inference source and whether production inference
  snapshots are used.
- Shared production global type collection with the standalone analyzer, so
  const-global readers such as `const x = 41; f() = x + 1` now report an
  `Int64` stable return instead of drifting to `Any` / unstable.
- Fixed report line numbers to use source lines instead of byte offsets.
- Seeded the standalone analyzer with inference-only method tables, and enabled
  non-Union precise argument dispatch in abstract inference, so overloaded
  callees such as `f(::Integer)` / `f(::Number)` no longer make callers such as
  `caller(x::Int64) = f(x)` report `Top` / unstable.
- Registered qualified nested functions in the standalone analyzer and
  production reflection inference tables, and inferred local closure calls with
  the caller environment so generator bodies such as `f(x)` retain captured
  variable types.

### untyped method `return_types` specialization ✅ (Issue #4296)

- Added representative reflection-time inference for Lazy AoT specializable
  untyped methods when `Base.return_types(f, Tuple{...})` supplies concrete
  argument types.
- Registered specializable nested function IR under the fallback qualified
  function name so untyped parent methods can also re-infer generator bodies
  that call captured local functions.
- `foo(a) = a + 1; Base.return_types(foo, Tuple{Int64})` now reports `Int64`
  instead of the generic method snapshot `Any`.
- Added coverage to `reflection_return_types_basic_4288`.

### kwargs... Pairs eltype and collect type preservation ✅ (Issue #4282)

- Added `Value::Pairs` support for `eltype` / `_eltype` so homogeneous keyword
  values preserve `Pair{Symbol, T}`.
- Extended runtime `Pairs` value typejoin for representative heterogeneous
  kwargs: numeric `Int64`/`Float64` values now report `Pair{Symbol, Real}`,
  non-numeric mixed values report `Pair{Symbol, Any}`, and empty kwargs report
  `Pair{Symbol, Union{}}`.
- Added native iteration / collection support for runtime `Pairs` values,
  including `Vector{Pair{Symbol, Int64}}`, `Vector{Pair{Symbol, Real}}`,
  `Vector{Pair{Symbol, Any}}`, and `Vector{Pair{Symbol, Union{}}}` logical
  element tags.
- Added runtime `typeof(kwargs)` projection to the upstream-shaped
  `Base.Pairs{Symbol,V,Nothing,@NamedTuple{...}}` display for representative
  single, empty, and mixed numeric keyword values.
- Added `Pairs` field projection for `data` / `itr` so existing Pure Julia
  `keys`, `values`, and `length` methods continue to work with VM-native
  kwargs values.
- Added `kwargs_splat_pairs_eltype_collect_4282`.

### zip5/zip6 collect type preservation ✅ (Issue #4281)

- Added `Zip5` with `iterate`, `length`, iterator traits, `eltype`, `size`, and
  `axes` support for `zip(a, b, c, d, e)`.
- Added representative `Zip6` support for `zip(a, b, c, d, e, f)` with the same
  iteration, trait, `eltype`, `size`, and `axes` surface.
- Extended `zip_nary.jl` to verify 5-input and 6-input collection preserve
  precise tuple element types and shortest-input length semantics.
- Fixed Array `eltype` projection for `TupleOf` fields beyond the old
  `Int64`/`Float64`/`Bool`/`String` subset.

### hcat 4+ typed vector type preservation ✅ (Issue #4280)

- Added a typed varargs path for `hcat(args...)` that preserves
  `Matrix{Int64}`, `Matrix{Int8}`, `Matrix{Float64}`, `Matrix{Float32}`,
  `Matrix{Bool}`, `Matrix{String}`, and `Matrix{Char}` when every argument is
  a vector with the same supported concrete element type.
- Added representative `Int64`/`Float64` mixed promotion to `Matrix{Float64}`
  for both varargs and 2-argument generic fallback paths.
- Kept non-promotable mixed vector arguments on the existing `Matrix{Any}` fallback.
- Added `array_hcat_varargs_type_preservation_4280`.

### tuple map type preservation ✅ (Issue #4283)

- Added tuple-specific `map(f, t::Tuple)` methods in Pure Julia Base so tuple
  mapping preserves shape and per-slot result types instead of materializing a
  `Vector{Any}` through the generic iterator path.
- Added 2-tuple, 3-tuple, and representative 4-tuple-input `map` support with
  shortest-length semantics for small arities, matching upstream representative
  behavior.
- Added `tuple_map_type_preservation_4283`.

### closure capture through representative HOF and Generator callables ✅ (Issue #4289)

- Kept local callables on runtime/general collection paths when building
  `map` / `Generator`-style collections, so nested functions preserve captured
  values instead of being lowered to bare function indexes.
- Confirmed `map(f, [1, 2, 3])` and `collect(Base.Generator(f, 1:3))` with
  `f(x) = x + a` match upstream representative `Vector{Int64}` behavior.
- Embedded anonymous arrow functions used as full-form function call arguments
  as nested `FunctionDef` values, so `map(x -> x + a, [1, 2, 3])` preserves the
  captured `a` and returns `Vector{Int64}`.
- Reused the nested-arrow lowering path for assigned anonymous functions, so
  `f = x -> x + a; map(f, [1, 2, 3])` also preserves the captured value.
- Collected nested functions embedded in `Expr::ModuleCall` arguments, so direct
  anonymous generator construction `Base.Generator(x -> x + a, 1:3)` registers
  the closure before runtime collection.
- Added coverage for multi-iterator `Base.Generator(f, xs, ys)` and filtered
  generator expressions preserving captured values.
- Routed unfiltered local-callable generator expressions through runtime
  generators so non-empty `collect(f(x) for x in 1:3)` preserves
  `Vector{Int64}`.
- Extended abstract inference / reflection for the same unfiltered generator
  expression path, so `Base.return_types` and `Base.infer_return_type` report
  `Vector{Int64}` rather than `Vector{Any}`.
- Added first-class abstract closure values carrying captured value types.
  `make_adder(a)(x)`, `f = make_adder(offset); f(x)`, returned named nested
  functions, simple composed functions, and returned composed closures now
  report `Int64` through `Base.return_types` / `Base.infer_return_type` for the
  representative upstream-compatible cases.
- Captured local functions with fully typed parameters but free captured values
  are now retained in the reflection-time specialization function table, fixing
  `f(x::Int) = x + a; f(2)` to report `Int64` for the representative
  `Base.return_types` / `Base.infer_return_type` path.
- Reflection APIs now accept runtime closure values directly, so
  `Base.return_types(f, Tuple{Int64})` and `Base.code_typed(f, Tuple{Int64})`
  for `f = x -> x + a` use the captured environment and report `Int64`, matching
  upstream representative behavior.
- Added explicit unsupported diagnostics for upstream opaque closure entry
  points. `Base.Experimental.@opaque ...` now reports opaque closures as
  unsupported under Issue #4289 rather than generic `unknown macro @opaque`,
  and `Core.OpaqueClosure` reports the same unsupported feature rather than
  falling through to `Unknown module: Core`.
- Added a static callable-type alias bridge for Issue #4309. Top-level
  `T = typeof(f)` aliases for known callable values now let `(::T)(...)`
  methods participate in calls to `f`, matching the upstream representative
  closure object method case without relying on runtime JIT/world-age machinery.
- Added collect-style runtime typejoin for filtered local-callable
  generator/comprehension bodies, including all-filtered-out `Vector{Union{}}`.
- Added `closures_hof_capture_4289`.
- Added `closures_callable_closure_method_4309`.

## 最新対応 (2026-05-19)

### collect fallback inventory ✅ (Issue #4052)

- Added `CollectFallback:` ownership tags to the retained native collect
  fallback boundaries across compiler routing, runtime dynamic dispatch, and
  VM materialization.
- Documented the inventory in `docs/vm/COLLECTIONS.md` and registered
  `scripts/check_collect_fallback_inventory.sh` in CI / `CODE_AUDITS.md`.
- Split the remaining VM-native generator and range representation-boundary
  reductions out to #4265 and #4266.

### base function audit stale exemption cleanup ✅ (Issue #4264)

- Removed stale `BuiltinId` registration audit exemptions for `isnumeric`,
  `unescape_string`, `bitstring`, `codeunits`, and `codepoint` after full
  release nextest exposed that those names are already registered in
  `is_base_function()`.

### binary fallback inventory ✅ (Issue #4262)

- Documented the `CallDynamicBinaryBoth` fallback owner surface in
  `docs/vm/BINARY_DISPATCH.md`, classifying each retained Rust branch as
  bootstrap intrinsic, compatibility fallback, or Pure Julia ownership
  candidate.
- Added `BinaryBothFallback:` tags to `binary_both.rs` and registered
  `scripts/check_binary_both_fallback_inventory.sh` in CI so code and docs must
  stay synchronized.

### runtime Any collect enumerate/rest dispatch ✅ (Issue #4052)

- Extended the existing collect dispatch-first fixture to cover
  `collect(x::Any)` where `x` is `Enumerate` or `Rest`.
- This verifies user/Pure Julia `collect(::Enumerate)` / `collect(::Rest)`
  methods win before the Rust native collect compatibility boundary.

### runtime type-object typeof kind projection ✅ (Issue #3909)

- Added a `RuntimeTypeObject::runtime_type_projection()` helper that maps the
  registry object kind to `DataType`, `UnionAll`, or `TypeVar`.
- Routed `typeof(::Type)` and `typeof(::RuntimeTypeVar)` through the
  registry-backed kind projection instead of always returning `DataType`.
- Added upstream-verified fixture coverage for primitive/concrete parametric
  types, built-in and user parametric schemas, projected TypeVars, and fresh
  `TypeVar(:T)` objects.
- Kept this as a projection over existing `Value::DataType(JuliaType)` values;
  stable heap handles remain future #3909 work.

### CallDynamicBinaryBoth fallback policy ✅ (Issue #3910)

- Centralized the `CallDynamicBinaryBoth` primitive fallback preemption rule so
  non-primitive pairs use shared resolver scoring before Rust fallback.
- Kept primitive numeric and BigInt/BigFloat intrinsic arithmetic as an explicit
  compatibility policy to avoid promotion recursion and preserve primitive
  arithmetic semantics.
- Added fixture coverage for both-`Any` binary operands proving exact and
  fallback user/Pure Julia methods are selected through the shared resolver.

### Generator DataType callable dispatch ✅ (Issue #3910)

- Routed DataType callables used by `Generator` / `Iterators.map` through
  `RuntimeValue(DataType)` so collection applies shared callable dispatch before
  primitive conversion fallback.
- Kept the legacy `TypeObject` generator variants as compatibility wrappers that
  delegate to the runtime callable path during collection.
- Added fixture coverage for user-defined `Float64(::Custom)` methods through
  both direct and runtime-typed generator callables.

### IterateDynamic full-signature dispatch ✅ (Issue #3910)

- Changed `IterateDynamic` candidate encoding to carry full runtime method
  signatures while preserving the existing instruction field shape.
- Runtime matching now scores `iterate(collection, state)` with both argument
  types and caches by the full argument-type signature.
- Added fixture coverage proving `iterate(::Custom, ::Int64)` and
  `iterate(::Custom, ::String)` are selected correctly through `Any`-typed calls.

### DataType callable shared dispatch ✅ (Issue #3910)

- Removed the pre-dispatch primitive DataType conversion shortcut from
  `CallFunctionVariable`, so user/Pure Julia constructor methods such as
  `Float64(::Custom)` win before Rust conversion fallback when called through
  dynamic `T(x)`.
- Routed legacy `CallTypeConstructor` execution through
  `call_runtime_callable_value`, keeping the instruction compatible while

- Extended `dynamic_callable_datatype.jl` coverage for user-defined primitive

### GlobalRef callable shared dispatch ✅ (Issue #3910)

- Routed sjulia's callable `GlobalRef(Base, :f)(args...)` extension through

### Vector arraymath dispatch ✅ (Issue #4019)

### rank Pure Julia dispatch ✅ (Issue #4020)

### Full nextest timeout and reshape Complex storage ✅ (Issues #3972/#3973/#3974)

- Added a process-shared persistent Base cache under `target/sjulia_base_cache_<prelude-hash>.bin` so `cargo nextest` fixture processes no longer recompile Base independently.
- Added a process-shared lowered prelude `Program` cache under `target/sjulia_prelude_program_<prelude-hash>.bin` so fresh test processes do not repeatedly parse/lower Base before compilation.
- Batched generated fixture tests into per-category `chunk_NNN` tests of 16 fixtures each so a full nextest run does not launch one process per fixture while category-targeted workflows still work.
- Set the default nextest profile to 16 test threads and prioritized late heavy integration/iOS chunks so the full release command avoids both over-parallel Base cache restoration and end-of-run stragglers.
- Preserved explicit embedded cache precedence (`SJULIA_BASE_CACHE`) and existing version/hash validation, with stale persistent caches deleted and regenerated automatically.
- Added a lock-file path so the first process writes the cache and concurrent fixture processes wait/read instead of racing into duplicate Base compilations.
- Reconstruct `RuntimeCompileContext` when loading serialized Base cache so warm-cache Lazy AoT still specializes parametric Base methods without bloating the persistent cache payload; this fixes the warm-cache `rational_bigint_mixed_promotion_diagonal` runtime error from #3973.
- Fixed reshaped interleaved Complex mutation so `set_complex` writes through to shared parent storage, matching the storage-sharing expectation from upstream `julia/base/array.jl` reshape behavior and the broadcast materialization path in `julia/base/broadcast.jl`.
- Reduced diagnostic Mandelbrot/randn tests to checksum-style VM executions instead of repeated parse/lower/compile/output probes.
- Validation passed for first-writer/no-cache and warm-cache `generator::`, chunked `generator::` / `rational::`, cold/warm-cache `rational_bigint_mixed_promotion_diagonal`, Mandelbrot grid regressions, reshaped Complex parent-storage unit coverage, and full `timeout 1200 cargo nextest run --release` (`2557/2557 passed`, `1170.167s`).

## 最新対応 (2026-05-11)

### AoT: native call boundary classification ✅ (Issue #3723)

- `subset_julia_vm/src/aot/native_calls.rs` を追加し、`ccall`, `llvmcall`, `Core.Intrinsics.llvmcall` を AoT native-call boundary として分類。
- 現状は full Julia-compatible `ccall` を実装せず、unsupported `ccall` / `llvmcall` を AoT Core IR conversion で span 付き diagnostic として拒否する。これにより Rust/Cranelift codegen に ordinary call や placeholder として流れない。
- named pass verifier に脱出防止を追加し、手組み AoT IR の `CallStatic/CallDynamic { function: "ccall" | "llvmcall" | "*.ccall" | "*.llvmcall" }` も `InvalidIR` にする。
- future supported path は `AotNativeCallSupport::Supported { abi: AotCallAbi }` を使い、typed ABI data なしの ad-hoc native call 受理を禁止する設計にした。
- ドキュメント: [AOT_NATIVE_CALLS.md](./AOT_NATIVE_CALLS.md)
- 検証: `cargo test --release -p subset_julia_vm --features aot --lib aot::native_calls` 4/4 pass、`cargo test --release -p subset_julia_vm --features aot --lib test_program_to_aot_ir_rejects` 2/2 pass、`cargo test --release -p subset_julia_vm --features aot --lib aot::pass_pipeline` 6/6 pass、`cargo nextest run --release --lib` 1676/1676 pass（ローカルに `timeout` が無いため unwrapped）。

### AoT: rooting and safepoint contract ✅ (Issue #3722)

- `subset_julia_vm/src/aot/rooting.rs` を追加し、runtime `Value` の ownership/rooting state を `Native`, `RuntimeOwned`, `RuntimeBorrowed`, `Rooted`, `Temporary` に分類。Rust backend の現状は dynamic `Value` を owned として扱う契約に固定した。
- runtime/helper call effect を `NonAllocating`, `AllocatingSafepoint`, `UnknownSafepoint` に分類し、dynamic dispatch や allocation-like builtin を safepoint として verifier が扱えるようにした。
- named pass verifier から `verify_aot_rooting_obligations` を実行し、borrowed/temporary runtime value が unrooted のまま safepoint をまたぐ constructed case を `AotError::InvalidIR` で拒否する回帰テストを追加。
- Cranelift backend は runtime `Value` / managed pointer support を満たすまで `Any`, `Unknown`, string/array/tuple/struct を unsupported として拒否し、raw `i64` placeholder 化を避ける。
- ドキュメント: [AOT_ROOTING_SAFETY.md](./AOT_ROOTING_SAFETY.md)
- 検証: `cargo test --release -p subset_julia_vm --features aot --lib aot::rooting` 5/5 pass、`cargo test --release -p subset_julia_vm --features aot --lib aot::pass_pipeline` 5/5 pass、`cargo test --release -p subset_julia_vm --features cranelift --lib aot::codegen::cranelift` 10/10 pass、`cargo nextest run --release --lib` 1676/1676 pass（ローカルに `timeout` が無いため unwrapped）。

### AoT: named pass diagnostics and verifiers ✅ (Issue #3721)

- `subset_julia_vm/src/aot/pass_pipeline.rs` を追加し、AoT compiler boundary を `AotPassStage` として centralize。stage list は `AfterLowering`, `AfterDCE`, `AfterInference`, `AfterAotIrConversion`, `AfterAbiLowering`, `AfterOptimization`, `BeforeBackendCodegen`。
- `AotPassDiagnostics` が stage ごとの `AotPassStats` (functions/statements/dynamic_calls/structs/globals) と optional dump を保持する。dump は CLI から `--dump-aot-stage=<name|all>` で出せる。
- `verify_aot_program(stage, program)` を追加し、malformed AoT IR を backend codegen より前で止める hook を用意。空の function/parameter/variable/call target/field name、array shape mismatch、index なし index expression を `AotError::InvalidIR` で報告する。
- `src/bin/aot.rs` の source/Core IR compile path は `AfterAotIrConversion`, `AfterOptimization`, `BeforeBackendCodegen` で verifier を実行し、指定 stage の pretty AoT IR dump を出力する。
- 回帰テスト: stage parser/dump selection、stats+dump recording、malformed array shape/call target verifier failure、CLI flag parse を追加。
- 検証: `cargo test --release -p subset_julia_vm --features aot --lib aot::pass_pipeline` 5/5 pass、`cargo test --release -p subset_julia_vm --features aot --bin aot` 4/4 pass、`cargo nextest run --release --lib` 1676/1676 pass（ローカルに `timeout` が無いため unwrapped）。

### AoT: generated runtime multidispatch dispatchers ✅ (Issue #3720)

- AoT Rust codegen の multidispatch dispatcher をコメント出力から実関数生成に変更。`method_table` は return type も保持し、同名 method 群ごとに `pub fn f(arg0: Value, ...) -> RuntimeResult<Value>` を emitted artifact として生成する。
- dispatcher arm は `Value` pattern (`I64`, `I32`, `F64`, `F32`, `Bool`, `Char`, `Str`, `Nothing`, `Any`) を specialized ABI に unbox し、`f_i64_i64(...)` などの mangled specialization を呼んで `Value::from(...)` で runtime value に戻す。unsupported param/return type の arm は生成せず、no-match は `RuntimeError::method_error`。
- `AotExpr::CallDynamic` は overloaded function の場合、引数を `Value` に box して生成 dispatcher へ routing。fully static call は引き続き exact method に direct call する。
- 回帰テスト: dispatcher 関数生成、static multidispatch call の direct specialization 維持、dynamic call の `Value` 引数 routing を追加。
- 検証: `cargo test --release -p subset_julia_vm --features aot --lib aot::codegen::aot_codegen` 92/92 pass、`cargo nextest run --release --lib` 1676/1676 pass（ローカルに `timeout` が無いため unwrapped）。

### AoT: backend-neutral ABI value boundary ✅ (Issue #3719)

- `subset_julia_vm/src/aot/abi.rs` を追加し、AoT IR と backend/codegen の間に `AotAbiClass` / `AotAbiValue` / `AotCallAbi` を導入。値表現を `UnboxedScalar`, `NativeAggregate`, `NativePointer`, `RuntimeBoxed` に分類する backend-neutral な境界を固定した。
- 既存 Rust backend の型 spelling は互換維持のため `StaticType::to_rust_type()` と一致させつつ、`AotCodeGenerator::type_to_rust` は ABI layout 経由で型を取得するよう変更。`Any` / multi-variant `Union` は runtime `Value` boundary、single-variant `Union` は inner ABI class として扱う。
- `AotFunction::call_abi()` を追加し、CodeInstance-like specialization (#3718) の後続で各関数 specialization の params/return ABI を参照できるようにした。
- 回帰テスト: primitive scalar, native heap value, struct aggregate, single/multi `Union`, `Any`, call ABI の native/runtime boxed 判定を追加。
- 検証: `cargo test --release -p subset_julia_vm --features aot --lib aot::abi` 8/8 pass、`cargo test --release -p subset_julia_vm --features aot --lib call_abi` 2/2 pass、`cargo test --release -p subset_julia_vm --features aot --lib aot::codegen::aot_codegen` 89/89 pass、`cargo nextest run --release --lib` 1676/1676 pass（ローカルに `timeout` が無いため unwrapped）。

### AoT: CodeInstance-like specialization units ✅ (Issue #3718)

- `subset_julia_vm/src/aot/specialization.rs` を追加し、`CodeInstanceKey` / `CodeInstance` / `SpecializationQueue` を AoT 共通の特殊化単位として導入。関数名 + 引数型 tuple、source IR、推論済み signature / return type、dependency edge、emitted artifact slot、state を 1 箇所で保持できるようにした。
- `TypeInferenceEngine` の `call_sites: HashMap<String, Vec<Vec<StaticType>>>` を `SpecializationQueue` に置き換え、root call-site と関数本体内の nested call を同じ queue に enqueue。関数本体を走査するときは active owner を立て、`outer(Int64) -> inner(Int64)` のような依存 edge を記録する。
- 既存の call-site specialization 挙動は `observed_args_for(function)` 経由で維持しつつ、final analyze pass で source `Function` と `FunctionSignature` / return type を該当 CodeInstance に attach する。
- 回帰テスト: queue dedupe / dependency enqueue / display の unit test と、nested call の CodeInstance dependency を検証する inference test を追加。
- 検証: `cargo nextest run --release --lib` 1676/1676 pass（ローカルに `timeout` が無いため unwrapped）。`aot` feature 下の新規/関連 test は `cargo test --release -p subset_julia_vm --features aot --lib code_instance`, `call_site_array`, `dependency_edges`, `display_uses`, `mandelbrot_escape` で pass。`cargo nextest run --release -p subset_julia_vm --features aot --lib` 全体は既存 `aot::analyze::tests::test_convert_function_flattens_let_block_assign_expr` で fail。

### Lowering: statement `_with_ctx` 重複 sweep ✅ (Issue #3639)

- `subset_julia_vm_lowering/src/lowering/stmt/` の statement lowering 主要ペアを `Option<&LambdaContext>` の共通実装へ統合。`assignment`, `for`, `if`, `try`, `while`, statement/block entrypoint, `return`, `global`, `local` の context 版と非 context 版で同じロジックを二重保持しない構造にした。
- public API と既存 call sites の互換性を保つため `*_with_ctx` wrapper は残し、wrapper から共通実装に `Some(lambda_ctx)` を渡す。非 context 版は `None` を渡す。
- `if @generated ... else ... end` の既存 semantics 差分は維持。通常 lowering は Phase 3 の quote unquote を試し、lambda context 版は従来通り fallback branch 実行のみ。
- 差分は pure refactor。`cargo check --release -p subset_julia_vm` pass（ローカルに `timeout` が無いため unwrapped）。

### Lowering: `lower_const_statement` / `_with_ctx` 重複解消 pilot ✅ (Issue #3639)

- `subset_julia_vm_lowering/src/lowering/stmt/mod.rs` の `lower_const_statement` / `lower_const_statement_with_ctx` / `lower_const_statement_impl` の 3 関数を `lower_const_statement(walker, node, lambda_ctx: Option<&LambdaContext>)` 一本に統合。`_impl` ヘルパは廃止、呼び出し側 (`lower_stmt`, `lower_stmt_with_ctx`) は `None` / `Some(lambda_ctx)` を渡す形に更新。
- Issue #3639 が指摘する 30 ペアの先行 pilot として最小スコープで着地。pure refactor のため挙動は不変。残り 29 ペアは別 PR で sweep 予定。
- 検証: `cargo nextest run --release --test fixture_tests constants::` 9/9 pass、`cargo nextest run --lib` 1676/1676 pass、`cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean。

## 最新対応 (2026-05-10)

### Prevention: 128-bit / Float16 type-drift の体系的監査 ✅ (Issue #3699)

- **Type-preservation matrix** フィクスチャ 6 本を `subset_julia_vm/tests/fixtures/type_preservation/` に追加。`{+, -, *, /, ÷, %, ==, <, <=, >, >=}` × `{Int128, UInt128, Float16}` × `{same-type, mixed-with-Int64, mixed-with-Float64}` × `{inline-from-constructor, variable-bound}`。Issue 本文の指定通り inline / variable-bound の両形式を併記しており、`UInt128 == UInt128` の i64::MAX 超 (Issue #3696 の元バグ) を含む。
- マトリクスが捕捉した実バグを修正: `vm/dynamic_ops/mod.rs::dynamic_div` に F16/F16 ほか F16 系 9 アームを追加 (`dynamic_mod` の F16 アームと完全対称)。これにより `div(::Float16, ::Float16)` (= `floor(::Float16 / ::Float16)`) が runtime fallback で `Cannot divide F16 and F16` を出さず Float16 を保つ。
- **静的解析スクリプト** `scripts/check_div_specializations.sh` を新設。`base/int.jl` の `function div(x::TN, y::TN)` を Int8/16/32/64/128, UInt8/16/32/64/128 の 10 種すべてについて確認。`.github/workflows/ci.yml` の `code-audits` ジョブに登録 (shellcheck + run step)。bash 3.2 互換、`docs/vm/CODE_AUDITS.md` Audit Policies bullet 追加。
- **ドキュメント**: `docs/vm/TYPE_PRESERVATION.md` の Part 3 に **4 層モデル** (L1 inference → L2 early-route → L3 method-table → L4 runtime fallback) と各 primitive × 各層の責務テーブルを追加。**Option A vs Option B** (`WidePrimitiveOp` instruction) の設計選択を文書末尾に記録。`docs/vm/CHECKLISTS.md` に "New Primitive Type / New Operator Method" チェックリストを追加。
- 検証: `cargo nextest run --release --test fixture_tests type_preservation::` 6/6 pass、`numeric::` 17/17 pass、`promotion::` / `arithmetic::` / `types::` 57/57 pass、`cargo nextest run --lib` clean、`cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean、`bash scripts/check_div_specializations.sh` / `check_audit_scripts_bash3_compat.sh` / `check_fixture_test_names.sh` / shellcheck すべて pass。

### Set algebra Pure Julia migration ✅ (Issue #3724)

- `union`/`intersect`/`setdiff`/`symdiff`/`issubset`/`isdisjoint`/`issetequal` および mutating 変種 (`union!` ほか) について、Set/Vector/mixed Set+Vector 形の Pure Julia method を `subset_julia_vm/src/julia/base/set.jl` に集約。Vector 経路は線形検索 (`_vec_contains`) で `isequal` ベースのため Float64 など DictKey 非対応要素もカバー。
- `BuiltinId::Set{Union,Intersect,Setdiff,Symdiff,Issubset,Isdisjoint,Issetequal}` と `SetUnionMut`/`SetIntersectMut`/`SetSetdiffMut`/`SetSymdiffMut` を enum・`from_name`・`name` から削除し、`vm/builtins_sets/set_ops.rs` のハンドラを撤去。`shared.rs` の未使用ヘルパも削除。
- `compile_builtin_set` (`compile/expr/builtin_set.rs`) と `compile_builtin_call` の短絡呼び出しを撤去。`is_base_function` / inventory test からも該当名を除去したため Set 代数呼び出しは必ず method dispatch を経由する。
- `_set_push!`, `_set_delete!`, `_set_in`, `_set_empty!`, `_set_length` 等の内部 intrinsic は維持。`SetNew`/`SetPush`/`SetDelete`/`SetIn`/`SetEmpty` の public-name route も既存の Pure Julia wrapper 経由で維持。
- 新フィクスチャ `sets/test_pure_julia_dispatch.jl`: Set/Vector/mixed 形の代数操作と user override (`Base.union(::Set, ::Set) = Set([99])`) によるディスパッチ到達検出を回帰検証。

### Pure Julia migration: 残存 string helper ✅ (Issue #3726)

- `isvalid(::String, ::Integer)`, `findall(::String, ::String)`, `findall(::Char, ::String)`, `count(::String, ::String)`, `count(::Char, ::String)` を `base/strings/basic.jl` / `base/strings/search.jl` に追加。Rust `BuiltinId::IsvalidIndex` / `BuiltinId::StringFindAll` / `BuiltinId::StringCount` への compile-time routing を `compile/expr/call/mod.rs` と `compile/expr/builtin_string.rs` から外し、method dispatch にフォールスルー。
- `parse(Float64, ...)` / Regex builtin / `isnumeric(::Char)` は意図的な Rust 例外として `BUILTIN_REMOVAL.md` に明記。
- 新フィクスチャ: `strings/strings_pure_dispatch_helpers.jl`。`strings::` 89/89 pass、`cargo nextest run --lib` 1676/1676 pass、`cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean。

### Pure Julia migration: getindex / setindex! Struct dispatch ✅ (Issue #3729)

- 公開 `getindex` / `setindex!` の `compile_call` 早期ルート（`compile_builtin_call` への無条件フォールバック）を緩和。receiver の inferred type が `JuliaType::Struct(_)` かつ method table に対応 arity の候補がある場合は、method dispatch を最初に走らせるようにした。
- これにより `base/pair.jl::getindex(::Pair, ::Int64)`, `base/range.jl::getindex(::LinRange/StepRangeLen/OneTo/LogRange, ::Int64)`, `base/broadcast.jl::getindex(::Broadcasted, ::Int64/::CartesianIndex)`, `base/subarray.jl::getindex/setindex!(::SubArray{Float64/Int64/Bool}, ::Int64)` / `(::MatrixView{...}, ::Int64)`, `base/iterators.jl::getindex(::CartesianIndex/::LinearIndices, ::Int64)`, ユーザー定義 `Base.getindex(::MyStruct, ...)` / `Base.setindex!(::MyStruct, ...)` の Pure Julia 実装が正しく選択される。
- プリミティブな `Value::Array` / `Value::Tuple` / `Value::Str` / `Value::Range` / `Value::Memory` / `Value::Dict` の indexing は引き続き `compile_builtin_call` 経由で fast `IndexLoad` / `IndexStore` / `DictGet` / `DictSet` 命令を出すため、native コンテナの性能・互換性は維持される。
- 新フィクスチャ: `pure_julia/getindex_setindex_struct_dispatch.jl`（mutable user struct `Slot` の `Base.getindex` / `Base.setindex!` Pure Julia dispatch を確認）, `pure_julia/getindex_pair_range_dispatch.jl`（`Pair`, `Base.OneTo`, `LinRange` の `getindex` / `p[i]` syntax dispatch + primitive Array 経路の sanity）。
- 検証: `cargo nextest run --release --test fixture_tests pure_julia:: array:: arrays:: tuple:: range:: dict:: sets:: subarray:: broadcast::` 273/273 pass、`collections:: comprehension:: dispatch:: closures:: hof:: iteration::` 148/148 pass、`strings::` 92/93 pass（残る 1 件 `strings_findfirst_non_ascii` は PR #3800 由来の pre-existing 障害で本 PR とは無関係）、`cargo nextest run --lib` 1676/1676 pass、`cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean。

### Pure Julia migration: 述語 HOF reducer ✅ (Issue #3728)

- `any(f, arr)`, `all(f, arr)`, `count(f, ::Array)`, `findall(f, ::Array)`, `sum(f, ::Array)` を `base/reduce.jl` に新規追加。`findfirst(f, ::Array)` / `findlast(f, ::Array)` は既存メソッドが `base/array.jl` に存在。
- `compile/expr/builtin_hof.rs` の `findall` / `findfirst` / `findlast` / `count` / `sum` / `any` / `all` ハンドラを `Ok(None)` フォールスルー化。
- `compile/expr/call/mod.rs` の関連 routing を整理し HOF 形式は method dispatch にフォールスルー。`findall(::String, ::String)` / `count(::String, ::String)` は Issue #3726 で Pure Julia 化されるまで Rust `BuiltinId::StringFindAll` / `StringCount` 経路を保持。
- `sum(x -> x, [1, 2, 3])` の戻り値が Float64 から Int64 (公式 Julia 挙動) に訂正される副次効果あり。
- VM 命令 `FindAllFunc`, `FindFirstFunc`, `FindLastFunc`, `AnyFunc`, `AllFunc`, `CountFunc`, `SumFunc` は cache 互換のため残置するが新規 IR では生成されない。
- 新フィクスチャ: `hof/hof_predicate_reducers_pure_dispatch.jl`。`hof::` 29/29 pass、`array::` / `collections::` / `reduce::` 182/182 pass、`strings::` 88/88 pass、`cargo nextest run --lib` 1676/1676 pass、`cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean。

### Mutating collection dispatch: push!/pop!/delete! ✅ (Issue #3739)

- `lowering/expr/helpers.rs::map_builtin_name` から `push!` / `pop!` / `delete!` を撤去し、lowering で `Expr::Builtin` に直接変換される shortcut を解除。public mutating call は method table dispatch を経由するようになり、`base/set.jl` の `push!(s::Set, x)` や `base/dict.jl` の `delete!(::Dict{K,V}, key)` などが Rust 組み込みに shadow されない。
- `compile/expr/call/mod.rs::compile_call` に明示ルートを追加：第 1 引数の compile-time 型が `Array` / `ArrayOf` / `Memory` の `push!` / `pop!` および `Value::Dict`（Rust HashMap）の `delete!` / `pop!` は従来どおり `BuiltinOp::Push` / `Pop` / `DictDelete` を直接出力して in-place mutation を保つ。残りの type (`Set` / `Dict{K,V}` struct / `Struct` / `Any`) は method dispatch にフォールスルー。
- `base_function_to_builtin_op` の対応エントリは保持。method dispatch が見つからない場合は `is_base_function` 経路の fallback で従来同様 `BuiltinOp` に到達する。
- 新フィクスチャ: `sets/test_mutating_dispatch.jl`（Set push!/delete!/empty! が Pure Julia 経路を通る確認・Array push!/pop! が引き続き builtin 経由・Char[] へ string char を push する loop の regression 検証）、`dict/test_pure_julia_mutating_dispatch.jl`（Pure Julia `Dict{K,V}` の delete!/empty! と legacy Dict（Rust HashMap）の delete! 双方）。
- 既知の限界: `SetValue` が value-typed (`Clone`) のため、`push!(s::Set, x)` の Pure Julia 経路は新しい Set を返すが元の binding は更新されない。`BuiltinOp::Push` の Set 経路でも事前から同じ挙動だった共通バグ。Issue #3739 のコメントで `Rc<RefCell<SetValue>>` 化を follow-up として登録。

### `include_string` / `evalfile` を Pure Julia method dispatch に移行 ✅ (Issue #3738)

- `lowering/expr/helpers.rs::map_builtin_name()` から `include_string` / `evalfile` を撤去。public な直接呼び出しは `base/meta.jl` の Pure Julia overload (`Meta.parse` + `eval` を合成) にフォールスルーする。
- `BuiltinOp::IncludeString` / `BuiltinOp::EvalFile` は `compile/base_functions.rs::dead_but_kept` に移動。VM handler は `vm/builtins_macro/mod.rs` に温存するが新規 IR からは生成されない。
- `mapexpr` overload (`include_string(mapexpr, m, code, filename)`) が method table から到達するため、API 互換性が Rust builtin の 2/3 引数限定よりも広がる。
- whitespace-only 入力時に scope 推論が `result` を未定義扱いする問題を Pure Julia 側で hoist によって回避。
- 新フィクスチャ: `metaprogramming/include_string_pure_dispatch.jl`。`metaprogramming::` 41/41 pass、`cargo nextest run --lib` 1676/1676 pass、`cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean。

### Pure Julia migration: iterate / collect ✅ (Issue #3735)

- 公開 `iterate` / `collect` の呼び出しが `BuiltinOp::Iterate` / `BuiltinOp::Collect` 経路に常時変換され、`base/iterators.jl` (Enumerate/Zip/Take/Drop/CartesianIndices/...), `base/range.jl` (LinRange/StepRangeLen/OneTo/LogRange), `base/generator.jl` (Generator), `base/dict.jl` (Dict iter), `base/channels.jl` (Channel), `base/subarray.jl` (SubArray collect) などの Pure Julia method や user-defined struct method を shadow する問題を解消。
- `lowering/expr/helpers.rs::map_builtin_name()` から `"iterate"` / `"collect"` を除去し、`Expr::Call` 経由で method dispatch が最初に走るよう変更。`compile/base_functions.rs::base_function_to_builtin_op()` には `iterate` / `collect` を残し、method dispatch がマッチしない場合の primitive container 用 fallback として `BuiltinOp::Iterate` / `BuiltinOp::Collect` を返す。`is_base_function` リストにも引き続き含める。
- `test_all_builtin_ops_reachable` の `map_builtin_variants` から `BuiltinOp::Iterate` / `BuiltinOp::Collect` を除き、`base_function_to_builtin_op` 経由で reachable であることに統一。`map_builtin_name` のユニットテストにも `"iterate"` / `"collect"` が `None` を返すアサーションを追加。
- `compile/expr/call/mod.rs` の `has_any_arg && args.len() == 1` フォールバック分岐に `"iterate" | "collect"` を追加し、引数型が compile-time に Any の場合は method-table candidates の `CallDynamic` ではなく `compile_builtin` 経由で BuiltinOp に落とす。`has_any_arg && args.len() >= 2` ブランチでは `iterate(coll, state)` のみ同様の fallback を追加。
- `collect(::Range)` / `collect(::Any)` 用の早期分岐を `compile_call` の先頭に追加し、`BuiltinOp::Collect` 経由で element-type を保持する。これは、`Value::Range` の `get_type_name` が parametric 名 `"StepRangeLen{Float64, Base.TwicePrecision{Float64}, ..., Int64}"` を返すため、`CallDynamic` の score-based 一致で Pure Julia の `collect(::StepRangeLen)` メソッドが選ばれ、その body の `r.start` 等の field access で "GetField: expected struct, got Range" エラーが発生する不具合を回避するため。`BuiltinOp::Collect` ハンドラは Struct/Any 型に対して method dispatch を試行しつつ、primitive Range には `BuiltinId::RangeCollect` を呼ぶ既存ロジックを保つ。
- 新フィクスチャ: `pure_julia/iterate_collect_struct_dispatch.jl`（user-defined `Counter` struct への `iterate(c)` / `iterate(c, state)` / `collect(c)` Pure Julia dispatch）と `pure_julia/iterate_collect_pure_julia_iterators.jl`（`Iterators.take` / `Iterators.drop` / `enumerate` の Pure Julia iterator method dispatch + primitive Array/Range/Tuple/String の BuiltinId fallback）。
- 検証: `cargo nextest run --release --test fixture_tests pure_julia:: iteration:: range:: array:: arrays:: tuple:: dict:: sets::` 266/266 pass、`collections:: comprehension:: dispatch:: closures:: hof:: subarray:: broadcast::` 158/158 pass、`cargo nextest run --lib` 1676/1676 pass、`cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean、`bash scripts/check_fixture_test_names.sh` clean。

### Pure Julia migration: length / size / ndims ✅ (Issue #3736)

- 公開 `length` / `size` の呼び出しが `BuiltinOp::Length` / `BuiltinOp::Size` 経路に常に変換され、Pure Julia `length(::SubArray)`, `length(::Set)`, `length(::Dict)`, `length(::Broadcasted)`, `length(::Generator)`, `length(::CartesianIndices)`, `length(::LinRange/StepRangeLen/OneTo/LogRange)`, `size(::SubArray)`, `size(::CartesianIndices)`, `ndims(::SubArray)`, `ndims(::Broadcasted)` などのメソッドや user-defined struct method を shadow する問題を解消。
- `lowering/expr/helpers.rs::map_builtin_name()` から `"length"` / `"size"` を除去。`ndims` は元から `map_builtin_name` には無かったが、`compile_call` 経路で method dispatch を最初に試すフローに統一。
- `compile/base_functions.rs::base_function_to_builtin_op()` には `length` / `size` / `ndims` を残し、method dispatch がマッチしなかった場合の primitive container 用 fallback として `BuiltinOp` を返す。`is_base_function` リストにも引き続き `length` / `size` / `ndims` を含める。`test_all_builtin_ops_reachable` の `map_builtin_variants` から `BuiltinOp::Length` / `BuiltinOp::Size` を除き、`base_function_to_builtin_op` 経由で reachable であることに統一。
- `compile/expr/call/mod.rs` の `has_any_arg && args.len() == 1` フォールバック分岐に `"length" | "size" | "ndims"` を追加し、引数型が compile-time に Any の場合は method-table candidates の `CallDynamic` ではなく `compile_builtin` 経由で BuiltinId へ落とす（runtime ハンドラが Struct/StructRef に対しては method dispatch を試み、それ以外は primitive 経路を実行）。`has_any_arg && args.len() >= 2` ブランチでも `size` のみ同様の fallback を追加し `size(arr, dim)` の混乱を回避。
- 新フィクスチャ `pure_julia/length_size_ndims_struct_dispatch.jl` で user-defined struct への `length` / `size` / `size(_, dim)` / `ndims` Pure Julia dispatch を、`pure_julia/length_size_ndims_collections.jl` で `Array` / `Tuple` / `String` / `Range` / `Dict` / `Set` / `LinRange` の primitive・Pure Julia fallback 動作を検証。
- 検証: `cargo nextest run --release --test fixture_tests pure_julia::` 22/22 pass、`array:: arrays:: tuple:: range:: dict:: sets:: subarray:: broadcast:: iteration::` 293/293 pass、`collections:: comprehension:: dispatch:: closures::` 74/74 pass、`sets:: dict:: broadcast:: subarray::` 80/80 pass、`strings::` 87/88 pass（残る 1 件 `strings_findfirst_non_ascii` は PR #3800 でランドした `first(arr) = arr[1]` の generic が `1:0` (空 Range) を扱えない pre-existing 問題で、本 PR とは無関係）。`cargo nextest run --lib` 1676/1676 pass、`cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean。

## ifelse Pure Julia migration ✅ (Issue #3733)

- `ifelse(condition, x, y)` の lowering / dispatch を `BuiltinOp::IfElse` から外し、`subset_julia_vm/src/julia/base/essentials.jl` の Pure Julia 実装にフォールスルーするよう修正。`BuiltinOp::IfElse` ハンドラは選択されなかった分岐を短絡評価しており、これは Julia の strict-evaluation セマンティクス（通常関数呼び出しなので両方の引数が事前評価される）に違反していた。
- 変更点 3 つ:
  1. `subset_julia_vm_lowering/src/lowering/expr/helpers.rs` の `map_builtin_name()` から `"ifelse" => BuiltinOp::IfElse` を削除し、コメントで Pure Julia 移行済みを記録。
  2. `subset_julia_vm_compile/src/compile/base_functions.rs::base_function_to_builtin_op()` から `"ifelse"` の arm を削除。
  3. `test_all_builtin_ops_reachable` の `map_builtin_variants` / `base_fn_inputs` から `IfElse` / `"ifelse"` を抜き、`dead_but_kept` 配列に `BuiltinOp::IfElse` を追加（ハンドラコードは `compile/expr/builtin.rs` に残置；公開 dispatch path からは到達不可）。
- `is_base_function("ifelse")` は残置。値として渡せる必要があるので。
- 新フィクスチャ `subset_julia_vm/tests/fixtures/essentials/ifelse_strict_evaluation.jl`（manifest 登録済み）: グローバル `Vector` への `push!` を side-effect probe として使い、`ifelse(true, 1, bump!())` 等で両分岐が評価されることを `length(PROBE) == 1` で検証。upstream `julia 1.12` と全件一致。
- 落とし穴: 当初 issue body にある `println("side")` を side-effect として使うフィクスチャは、別の VM スタック不整合バグ（Issue #3780）に当たる。`my_ifelse(true, 1, f_with_println())` 形は本 PR の修正前から baseline で同様に壊れているため、Pure Julia ifelse の責務外として #3780 で別途追跡する。
- 既存テスト 1467 fixture（新フィクスチャ追加で 1466 → 1467）は無回帰で通過。

## similar() dispatch and Size inference fix; repeat() migration ✅ (Issue #3777, #3761 follow-up)

- **根本原因 1**: `subset_julia_vm_compile/src/compile/expr/infer/mod.rs` の `Expr::Builtin` 推論テーブルで `BuiltinOp::Size` の arm が抜けており、デフォルトの `_ => ValueType::F64` に落ちていた。`size(arr, k)` を `similar(arr, size(arr, 1), size(arr, 2))` 等の引数として渡すと dim 推論が F64 になり、`compile/expr/call/mod.rs` の `is_int` ガードを通らずメソッド dispatch にフォールバックして "No method matching similar([Any, Any, Any])" で失敗。`size(arr, k) → I64`、`size(arr) → Tuple` を argc で分岐するよう修正。
- **根本原因 2**: `length(arr) * n` のように `I64 × Any` 演算結果は `Any` に推論される。`similar` 側の dispatch を `is_int_or_any` に緩和し、Any-dim も builtin にルートする。runtime 側 `vm/builtins_arrays.rs::BuiltinId::Similar` は既に `pop_value()` 時点で integer variant をチェックして TypeError を返すので、非整数値の検証は runtime に委譲できる。
- **`repeat(::Array, ::Int)` 移行**: 上記 2 つが直ったので `result = []; push!(result, x)` workaround を `similar(arr, len * n)` + index 代入に置換。返却型が `Vector{Any}` から `Vector{T}`（本家準拠）に改善し、`repeat([1, 2], 3)` が `Vector{Int64}` を返すようになる。
- 新フィクスチャ `subset_julia_vm/tests/fixtures/array/similar_dispatch_any_dims.jl`（manifest 登録済み）: inline `size(...)` ケース、`length × Any` ケース、ローカル `total = ...` ケース、`repeat` 戻り値の型保存をすべて upstream `julia 1.12` と突合。
- 既存テスト 1466 fixture + lib は無回帰で通過（新フィクスチャ追加で 1466 に増加）。
- これで Issue #3761 の `repeat` 部分（前 PR #3778 で scope-out した分）も完了。

---

## rotl90 / rotr90 / rot180 cleanup ✅ (Issue #3761)

- `subset_julia_vm/src/julia/base/array.jl` の rotation 系 (`rotl90` / `rotr90` / `rot180`) が、PR #3746 (Issue #3648) 当時 1D `similar` しかなかったため `T[]` + `push!` + `reshape` の workaround を抱えていた問題を整理。PR #3757 (Issue #3751) で多次元 `similar(arr, n, m)` が利用可能になったので、内部ヘルパ `_rotX_into!` を「flat 1D buffer + reshape」から「pre-allocated Matrix への直接 index 代入」に置き換え、各 dispatch エントリは `_rotX_impl(mat) = _rotX_into!(similar(mat, n, m), mat, m, n)` の薄いラッパに集約。
- 既存の型特化 (`Vector{Int64}` / `Vector{Float64}` / `Vector{Bool}` / `Vector{String}` / `Vector{Char}`) は compile-time のヒントとして残置し、本体は generic fallback と同一実装。`typeof(rotl90([1 2; 3 4]))` 等の `Matrix{Int64}` 結果は `similar(mat, n, m)` の runtime 型保存で得られる。
- 落とし穴: `similar(mat, size(mat, 1), size(mat, 2))` のように `size(...)` を call dispatch の引数にインライン展開するとコンパイル時推論が `Any` を返して dispatch が落ちる。`m = size(mat, 1); n = size(mat, 2); similar(mat, n, m)` のように先にローカル変数へ取り出すと I64 として記録され通る。フォローアップは Issue #3777 で別途追跡。
- `repeat(::Array, ::Int)` の `[]` + `push!` workaround は `total = length(arr) * n` が `Any * Any` 推論で落ちるため本 PR では対象外（Issue #3777 の解決後に着手）。
- 既存テスト (`array::array_matrix_rotation` / `array::array_rotation_type_preservation` / `array::array_similar_multidim` / `array::array_repeat_type_preservation` / `arrays::arrays_repeat` / `iteration::iteration_repeated` を含む 1465 fixture + 1673 lib) は無回帰で通過。

## `isprimitivetype` Pure Julia migration ✅ (Issue #3767)

- `subset_julia_vm/src/julia/base/reflection.jl`: 15 個の組み込み primitive 型を `===` で列挙していた `isprimitivetype` 実装を `_isprimitivetype(T)` 呼び出しに置換。`isabstracttype` / `isconcretetype` / `ismutabletype` と同じ薄いラッパーパターンに統一。
- `subset_julia_vm/src/builtins.rs`: `BuiltinId::_Isprimitivetype` を `_Ismutabletype` の隣に追加（enum・name 解析・逆引き name の 3 箇所）。
- `subset_julia_vm_compile/src/compile/base_functions.rs`: 内部 intrinsic リスト 2 か所に `"_isprimitivetype"` を登録。
- `subset_julia_vm_compile/src/compile/expr/call/mod.rs`: `_ismutabletype` の隣に `_isprimitivetype` の 1-arg 呼び出しコンパイルを追加し、`BuiltinId::_Isprimitivetype` を emit。
- `subset_julia_vm_vm/src/vm/builtins_types.rs`: `_Isprimitivetype` ハンドラを追加。`Value::DataType(jt)` の name を Bool / Int{8,16,32,64,128} / UInt{8,16,32,64,128} / Float{16,32,64} / Char の 15 種にマッチ（`isstructtype(String)` を `true` のままに保つため `String` は含めない、本家 Julia 1.12 の挙動に一致）。
- フィクスチャ `subset_julia_vm/tests/fixtures/types/types_isprimitivetype.jl` を拡張: 全 15 primitive 型, `String`, abstract 型 (`Number`/`Real`/`Integer`/`AbstractFloat`/`Any`), ユーザ定義 immutable / mutable 構造体を網羅。`julia 1.12 -e isprimitivetype(T)` と全件一致。

- `subset_julia_vm_compile/src/compile/expr/builtin_array.rs` の `similar` ハンドラ：`args.len() == 1 || args.len() == 2` ガードを撤去し、任意 arity を受け付ける。第 2 引数が DataType（`Int` などの builtin type 名 or `eltype(x)` の戻り型）の場合は typed form（`similar(a, T[, dims...])`）として識別。
- `subset_julia_vm_compile/src/compile/expr/call/mod.rs`: `Any` 型の第 1 引数（関数パラメータなど）に対しても multi-dim shape / typed form を builtin に route。Pure Julia の `similar(::Broadcasted, ::Type)` は引き続き method dispatch に委ねる。
- `subset_julia_vm_vm/src/vm/builtins_arrays.rs` の `BuiltinId::Similar`: 任意 argc を受理し、第 2 引数が `Value::DataType` のときは eltype を上書き、残りを dims として収集して `MemoryValue::undef_typed` で uninit 配列を確保。
- 新フィクスチャ `subset_julia_vm/tests/fixtures/array/similar_multidim.jl`：2D / 3D / 4D 形、typed `similar(arr, Int, n, m)`、関数内 (Any-typed param) からの呼び出しを網羅。

## BigInt/BigFloat coercion: 全プリミティブ数値オペランド対応 ✅ (Issue #3743 / #3748 / #3749)

- **#3743** `BigInt + Float64` (および `Float32` / `Float16`) が `Runtime error: expected BigInt, got "Float64"` を出していた問題を修正。`compile/expr/binary/mod.rs` の BigInt 早期ルート (上下 2 か所) で「BigInt + Float*」を検出し、BigFloat 算術 (`AddBigFloat` 等) にルーティング。`pop_bigfloat` で BigInt → BigFloat 昇格。
- **#3748** `BigInt + UInt8/16/32/64/128` および `Int8/16/32` が `expected BigInt, got UIntN` を出していた問題を修正。`vm/stack_ops.rs::pop_bigint` を全プリミティブ整数 Value variant (Bool, I8/16/32/64/128, U8/16/32/64/128) を受理するよう拡張。
- **#3749** `BigFloat + Float32 / Float16 / Int128 / UInt*` 等が `expected BigFloat, got X` を出していた問題を修正。`vm/stack_ops.rs::pop_bigfloat` を全プリミティブ数値 Value variant (Bool, 全整数幅, F16/F32/F64, BigInt) を受理するよう拡張。
- 公式 Julia 挙動に一致: 「任意の整数 + BigInt → BigInt」「BigInt + Float* → BigFloat」「任意の数値 + BigFloat → BigFloat」。
- add/sub/mul/div と比較 (`==`, `!=`, `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`) すべての二項演算に適用。
- 新フィクスチャ: `bigint/coercion_narrow_integers.jl`, `bigint/coercion_bigint_float.jl`, `bigint/coercion_bigfloat_primitives.jl` (manifest 登録済み)。

## Float16+Float32 mixed-type promotion ✅ (Issue #3750)

- **#3750** untyped generic function (`f(a, b) = a + b`) で F16 と F32 を渡したとき結果が `Float64` になるバグを修正。Julia の昇格格子では Float32 が Float16 を支配するため `Float32` を返す必要がある。
- 原因: `+(::Number, ::Number)` の body `px + py` を `promote(F16, F32) = (F32, F32)` の後で再 dispatch する経路で、`vm/exec/binary_both.rs::execute_binary_both` の primitive fallback catch-all が `both_f32` を扱わず F32 → F64 widening をかけていた。
- 修正: `has_f32 && !both_f32` ガードを `has_f32` に変更し、`both_f32` も既存の F32 専用パス (line 791-922) に入るようにした。`F32+F64` mixed は先行する `if has_f64` で分岐、`both_f16` は line 579 で先行捕捉されるため変更不要。Add/Sub/Mul/Div/Mod/IntDiv/比較 すべてが F32 を保持。
- 新フィクスチャテスト: `arithmetic/float16_float32_promotion.jl`。
- 検証: `cargo nextest run --release --test fixture_tests arithmetic::` 17/17 pass、`cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean。

---

## 128-bit シフト演算子 ✅ (Issue #3747)

- **#3747** `UInt128(1) << 1` / `UInt128(8) >> 1` / `UInt128(8) >>> 1` を含む UInt128 上の `<<` / `>>` / `>>>` が `Dispatch(NoMethodFound)` を出していた問題を修正。PR #3565 で narrow integer + Int128 用 bitwise/shift メソッドを `subset_julia_vm/src/julia/base/int.jl` に追加した際、UInt128 専用エントリが抜けていたため UInt128 LHS だけ method 解決に失敗していた。
- 追加: `Base.:(&)`, `Base.:(|)`, `xor`, `Base.:(⊻)`, `Base.:(~)`, `Base.:(<<)(::UInt128, ::Int64)`, `Base.:(>>)(::UInt128, ::Int64)`, `Base.:(>>>)(::UInt128, ::Int64)` を `int.jl` の Int128 ブロック直後に追加。
- runtime intrinsics (`ShlInt` / `LshrInt` / `AshrInt`、`subset_julia_vm_vm/src/vm/intrinsics_exec.rs`) は既に `Value::U128` / `Value::I128` を保存する分岐を持っていたため、Rust 側の変更は不要。
- 新フィクスチャテスト: `numeric::numeric_int128_shifts`（UInt128 × `<<`/`>>`/`>>>`、Int128 リグレッション、変数バインド、`UInt128(1) << 64` 桁あふれの 21 アサーション）。公式 Julia 1.12.6 で事前検証。
- 残課題（任意・別 issue 化）: dispatch error formatter が LHS=Int128 でも `UInt128` と表示していたという issue 文の指摘は、Int128 のシフトは元から動作していたため今回の修正範囲では再現しなかった。Int128/UInt128 ともに dispatchable になった現在では発火経路が無いため、cosmetic 観点のみ継続観察対象。
